### 1.1.1.1 Warnings and Precautions
`geely_coolray_en_c1eacf7a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Definition of “warning”, “notice” and “prompt”

The diagnosis and maintenance procedures in the maintenance manual include general and concrete “warning”, “notice” and “prompt”. Geely is committed to providing maintenance information to help diagnose of technicians and repair systems of after-sales service to enable the vehicle to run normally. However, certain procedures may pose a risk to the technician if the technician does not follow the recommended methods.

“Warning”, “notice” and “prompt” are prepared to prevent above risks but not all of risks can be foreseen. Such information is prominently placed in the maintenance manual. Such information is prepared to prevent following situations:

Serious injury to personnel.
– Vehicle damage.
Unnecessary vehicle maintenance.
Unnecessary components replacement.
Improper repair or replacement of vehicle parts.

Definition of “warning”

When a “warning” occurs, it asks you to take the necessary or prohibited measures. Ignoring “warnings” can result in the following consequences:

Serious injury to personnel. – If the vehicle is not repaired properly, it will cause serious personal injury to the driver or passenger of the vehicle.

Definition of “notice”

“Notice” requires special attention to necessary or prohibited measures. Ignoring “notice” can result in the following consequences:

Vehicle damage.

Unnecessary vehicle maintenance.

Unnecessary components replacement.

Abnormal operation or performance of the system or component being maintained.

Damage of related systems or components.

Damage of fastener tightening, basic tools or special tools. Leakage of engine coolant, lubrication oil and other major oil

Definition of “prompt”

The “prompt” statement emphasizes the necessity of a diagnostic or maintenance procedure. The purpose of the “prompt” statement is as follows:

– Define the procedures. – Provide additional information to complete a procedure. Explain the reasons for following the recommended procedures.

Provides information that helps complete the procedure more efficiently.

Provide the technician with information on past experiences to make the procedure easier to complete.

### Warnings regarding fuel and EVAP pipe
`geely_coolray_en_4dde1e7b` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Warning！

To reduce the risk of fire and personal injury, please observe the following:

– All fuel pipes that are scored, scratched or damaged during installation should be replaced, and no attempt should be made to repair the fuel pipe. -When installing a new fuel pipe, do not directly knock on the fuel pipe clamp with a hammer.

When a welding torch is used near the fuel steam pipe, the fuel steam pipe must be covered with the wet towel. Besides, do not expose the vehicle to temperatures above 115°C (239ºF) for more than 1 hour, and do not park it at temperatures above 90° C (194ºF) for long periods of time.

Before connecting the fuel pipe connectors, be sure to apply a few drops of clean engine oil to the male pipe connector to ensure correct reconnection and prevent possible fuel leakage. (During normal operation, the O-ring in the female connector may swell, and if it is not lubricated, it cannot be reconnected correctly)

### Warning regarding halogen bulb
`geely_coolray_en_c5566024` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

Warning！

Halogen bulbs contain high-pressure gas, which can explode into the broken glass if not handled properly. To avoid personal injury:

Before replacing the bulb, turn off the light and allow the bulb to cool.

Keep the light off until the bulb is replaced.

Wear goggles when replacing the halogen bulb.

When holding the bulb, only hold the lamp holder to avoid touching the glass.

The bulb should avoid dust and moisture.

Scrap the old bulbs correctly.

Keep halogen bulbs away from children.

If the reaction torque of the timing chain cannot be avoided, it will cause the timing drive chain to fail.

Notice of exterior trim logo removal

Caution

When the badges/nameplates are removed, flat-edged plastic tools are used to prevent damage to the paint.

The fastener tightening is used in the right position and the replaced number of replaced fastener tightening must be right. The replaced fastener tightening or fastener tightening that requires thread lock nut glue or sealant is specified in the maintenance procedure that paint, lubrication oil or corrosion inhibitors should not be used on fastener tightening or the connection surface of fastener tightening unless otherwise specified. These coatings affect the torque and clamp force of the fastener tightening and damage the fastener tightening. When the fastener tightening is installed, make sure that the sequence of fastening and fastening torque are correct to avoid damage to components and system.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a090d735` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Electro-static discharge (ESD) may damage many solid-state electrical components. Components susceptible to ESD are not always marked with ESD symbols. Handle all electrical components carefully. Please follow the following safety instructions to avoid damage of electrostatic discharge:

Before servicing any electronic components, touch the metal ground points to discharge static electricity from your body (especially after sliding on the vehicle seat).
Do not touch exposed terminals, which may be connected to circuits easily damaged by electrostatic discharge.
The tools are not allowed to touch exposed terminals when connectors are repaired.
The components should not be removed from the protective shell unless required.
Avoid the following operations unless specifically required by the diagnostic procedures:
Bridging and ground of components or connectors

The test device probe is connected to the component or connector. When the test probe is used, the ground lead should be connected first.

Before the protective shell of components is opened, it should be grounded. Solid components are prohibited to place on the metal workbench or on the top of the television, radio, and other electrical equipment.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_6227324e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Do not remove the lead of the heating oxygen sensor (HO2S). Removing the lead or harness connector will affect the operation of the sensor.

![](images/d21e4caffd6e6380dfbb044d1346e1b6001501d4bb7e5a5bf1be3a42c5b0dbd3.webp)

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_8b83179a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Please take care of the oxygen release sensor and do not let it fall off. The in-line electrical connector and the grille cooling end should be kept free of grease, dirt or other pollutants. Do not use any type of cleaner.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_3670a0f9` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Do not repair the wires, harness connectors or terminals of the oxygen sensor. If the lead, harness connector or terminal is damaged, the oxygen sensor must be replaced.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_7a984054` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The outside clean air reference is obtained by signals and heater wires. Attempts to repair wires, harness connectors, or terminals may block the air reference and reduce oxygen sensor performance.

Caution

The following principles must be followed when heating oxygen sensors are repaired:

Do not smear contact cleaners or other materials on the sensor or harness connectors of the vehicle, as these materials may enter the sensor and cause poor performance.

Do not damage the lead and harness of the sensor, exposing its internal lead, which will provide access to the sensor with foreign matters and performance fault.

The sensor and the lead of the vehicle must not be bent or kinked. Large bends or kinks will blank plug the air reference channel through the leads.

Make sure that the outer of harness connector is sealed to avoid damage due to water ingress.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_1b07c469` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Be sure to put the starting switch in the OFF position, whenever connecting or disconnecting battery cables, battery chargers, or jumper cables. Otherwise, the control module or other electrical components may be damaged.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_6b03e9b3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The inlet and outlet hoses must not be twisted during the installation process. The hoses must not be bent or distorted for ease of installation, otherwise it will damage the components.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_6728c7f9` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The sealing surface must not be cut, scratched or damaged. As the sealing surface is machining surface, its damage will lead to leakage.

`geely_coolray_en_6ba27ab3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Caution

Do not touch the connector pins or welding components on the circuit board to prevent electrostatic discharge from damaging the electronic control module on the vehicle.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_7723d4cc` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Never pry the gear ring off the differential housing, as prying the gear ring off the differential case will damage the gear ring and/or the differential housing.

`geely_coolray_en_14e9a72f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The sealant cured at room temperature must not enter the thread blind holes. It will also make it unable to get the correct clamp force of fastener tightening when tightening, resulting in incorrect tightness of fastener tightening, loose or separation of components and serious damage to the engine and other components.

### 1.2.1.1 Items to be checked while operating the vehicle
`geely_coolray_en_1446a1d1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Horn operation

It is needed to press the horn occasionally to ensure that it operates normally and check the positions of all buttons.

Operation of brake system

When braking, it is needed to keep alert to the signs of the abnormal sound of the brake system, the increase of brake pedal problems or the repetitive brake running deviation. In addition, if the brake warning lamp is on or flashing, there is fault on a part of the brake system probably.

### Operation of exhaust system
`geely_coolray_en_9cd3ecd3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1

It is important to be alert for sound changes of the system or smoke odor, which are signs that the system may be leaking or overheating. It is needed to check the system and repair it immediately.

Operation of tyres, vehicle and orientation

Be alert to steering wheel or seat vibration when driving at normal highway speeds, which indicates that a certain wheel may need to be balanced. In addition, running sideways on straight roads indicates that it may be necessary to adjust tire pressure or wheel alignment.

Operation of steering system

Be alert to the change of steering action. When the steering wheel is difficult to turn or the free travel is too large, or when there is abnormal noise when turning or parking, it needs to be checked.

Operation of headlamp light adjustment

It is important to observe the headlamp light occasionally towards the light. If the headlamp light is not correct, it is needed to adjust it.

### 1.2.1.2 Inspection items should be checked during each refueling
`geely_coolray_en_4eef9763` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The loss of oil and fluid in any system (except the windscreen washer) indicates a possible system fault and should be checked and repaired immediately.

Check the oil level of engine oil

Check the oil level of engine oil and add engine oil when necessary. In addition, it is best to check the engine oil when it is warm.

1. Turn off the engine and wait for 10 minutes for engine oil to return to the oil pan.

2. Unplug oil level gauge.

3. Wipe the oil level gauge with a clean cloth and then insert it completely back to the bottom.
4. Unplug the oil level gauge again and check the oil level shown above.
5. Add engine oil when necessary to keep oil level of BHE15– EFZ engine oil between the MIN (lowest) line and MAX (highest) line.
6. After reading, insert the oil dipstick completely back into the engine. When checking the oil level when the engine oil is cold, do not start the engine first, because the cold engine oil will not flow back to the oil pan quickly, so the correct oil level reading cannot be indicated.

Check the fluid level and condition of engine coolant

Check liquid level in the expansion tank and add engine coolant when necessary. Then check engine coolant and replace the smudgy engine coolant.

Check the liquid level of front windshield washer fluid and the fluid level of the washer fluid in the fluid tank. In addition, add washer fluid when necessary.

### 1.2.1.3 Check the items at least once a month.
`geely_coolray_en_f490ea11` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

Tire and wheel and air pressure check

Check whether the tire is abnormal worn or damaged. Check whether the wheel is damaged. Check the cold state pressure and the spare tire. Maintain the recommended pressure on the tire label.

Operation of the vehicle lamp

Check the operations of license plate lamp, headlights (including high and low beam), parking lamps, fog lamps, tail lights, brake lamps, turn signals, reversing lamps and warning flashlights.

Oil and fluid leak check

After the vehicle has been parked for some time, check whether water, engine oil, fuel oil or other liquid remain on the ground under the vehicle regularly. Dripping after the use of the air-conditioning system belongs to the normal phenomenon. In case the fuel leakage or fume is found, find out the reason and remove the fault immediately.

### 1.2.1.4 Items should be inspected at least twice a year
`geely_coolray_en_c332b057` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Lubrication of doors and windows sealing strip grease

Use a clean rag to apply the sealing strip with silicone grease film.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_92e2f306` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

A low brake fluid level may indicate that the brake pads of the disc brake are worn and need to be replaced. Also, if the brake system warning lamp does not go out or turn on, the brake system may have faults. If the antilock brake system warning lamp does not go out or turn on, the anti-lock brake system may have faults. The check should be completed when the wheels are removed for transposition. Check whether the pipeline and hose connection is correct, and whether there is catching, leakage, crack or scratch. Check the disc brake pads for wear. Check the surface condition of the brake disc and other brake parts, including brake wheel cylinder, parking brake, etc.

### Inspection of steering system, suspension and front drive axle shield and sealing elements
`geely_coolray_en_1dc64bb2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1

Check the front and rear suspension and steering system for damaged, loose or missing parts, and signs of wear or insufficient lubrication. Clean and check the drive axle shield and seals for damage, cracking or leakage. If necessary, replace the seals.

### Exhaust system check
`geely_coolray_en_4c2210da` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Check the entire system, including catalytic converters, the body parts close to the exhaust system for breaking, damage, missing or misplacing of parts, and for cracks, holes, loose connections or other conditions that cause poor floor heat dissipation or allow exhaust to enter the trunk or passenger compartment.

### Inspection of electric throttle
`geely_coolray_en_18837fbe` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1

In the status of stalling of engine, turn the power supply switch to ACC mode, step on the accelerator pedal and observe whether the throttle operates normally. Turn the throttle by hand and observe whether the throttle is blocked or caught. If the throttle is found dirty and blocked, remove the throttle assembly and clean it with cleaner, with the focus on cleaning the throttle body chamber, throttle and throttle shaft until there is no dirt.

Engine drive belt

Check all drive belts for cracks, fray, wear and proper tensile force, and adjust or replace drive belts as necessary.

Operation of engine trim cover latch

When the engine trim cover is opened, observe the operation of the auxiliary latch. When the primary latch is released, the auxiliary latch should be able to prevent the engine trim cover from fully opened and the engine trim cover must be able to be closed tightly.

### 1.2.1.6 Items to be inspected at least once a year
`geely_coolray_en_1c465436` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Condition and operation of seat belt

Check the safety belt system, including braided belt, lock actuator, lock plate, retractor, guide ring and fixing device.

Maintenance of key lock

Lubricate key lock core.

Lubricate and maintain body

Lubricate all door hinges, including engine trim cover, fuel filler cap, trunk (tail gate) hinges and latches, glove box, console cap and any parts of the folding seat.

Flush body rear

First, it is needed loose the sediment that has accumulated in the enclosed area of the vehicle. Then, it is needed to flush body rear with clean water. It is important to flush body rear at least once a year after winter. Flushing body rear can clear up corrosive substances used to remove snow, ice and dust.

Engine cooling system

Warning！

It is important to avoid touching with moving parts and hot surfaces when working around a running engine to prevent injury.

Check the engine coolant If the engine coolant becomes dirty or rusts, it is needed to discharge and flush the engine cooling system and refill with new engine coolant. It is needed to maintain appropriate engine coolant concentration to ensure the correct anti-freezing, anti-boiling, anti-corrosion performance and engine operating temperature. Check hoses and replace hoses that have cracked, expanded or aged. Fasten the clamp, clean the externals of the radiator assembly and A/C system condenser and clean the filler cap and filler neck. It is needed to implement pressure test for the cooling system and cap to ensure the system is in normal operation .

### 1.4.2.1 Regular Maintenance
`geely_coolray_en_2d89eda0` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Normal use of the vehicle

The maintenance items given in the maintenance schedule assume that the vehicle is used for the following purposes:

– The transport of passengers and goods is under the restriction conditions indicated by the tire label at the edge of the driver door.

Driving on appropriate road surface and within legal operation restrictions.

Description of Planned Maintenance Items

The details of the maintenance items listed in the maintenance schedule are as follows. When carrying out maintenance of the following items, be sure to replace all parts and complete all necessary repairs before driving on the road. Be sure to use appropriate oil and lubricating oil.

Inspection of the Drive Belt

Check all drive belts for cracks, fray, wear and proper tensile force, and adjust or replace drive belts as necessary.

Replacement of engine oil and oil filter element

Use SP 0W-20 for BHE15-EFZ engine oil.

Engine oil

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a4992fa7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Using engine oil with viscosity other than the recommended viscosity will damage the engine.

The viscosity (consistency) of engine oil will affect fuel economy and the operation under cold weather conditions. The lower the viscosity of engine oil, the better the performance under cold weather and the fuel economy of vehicle. However, engine oil of higher viscosity must be used in high-temperature weather to achieve an ideal lubricating effect. If the engine oil with viscosity other than the recommended viscosity is used, the engine will be damaged.

Cooling system maintenance

Drain the engine coolant, flush, and then refill with new engine coolant.

Inspection and rotation of tires and wheels

Check whether the tires are abnormally worn or damaged. To make the tires wear evenly and prolong the service life of the tires, the tires should be rotated. If abnormal or premature wear occurs, check the wheel alignment before checking the wheel for damage.

### Caution

It is recommended to check the balance of both tire and wheel assemblies if the tire is rotated.

1. Tire rotation is also recommended when performing brake checks on tires in accordance with the maintenance schedule described or when the difference in tread depth between the front wheel tire and the rear wheel tire is 1.5mm

2. To lift and support a vehicle, please refer to Lifting and Jacking of Vehicle

### 1.6.1.1 Description
`geely_coolray_en_b9d82a0c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Many operations related to vehicle maintenance and repair will affect personal safety or bring health problems. This section lists some of the relevant hazardous operations and materials and equipment, as well as safety rules to avoid such hazards.

This section does not include all matters related to health and safety, so all operations, procedures and material handling should be conditional on safety and health. Before using any products, consult the product instruction manual provided by the manufacturer or the supplier.

### Refer to 1.6.1.8 Battery Acid Fluid
`geely_coolray_en_ecfba3bf` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Such as sodium carbonate and vitriol that are corrosive.

Used for cleaning the battery and other materials.

Irritant or corrosive to eyes, skin, olfactory and throat, which will burn the human body and damage common protective clothing.

Avoid splash on eyes, skins, and clothing. Wear appropriate protection suits, gloves and goggles to avoid the inhalation of spray.

Please provide flush equipment nearby, such as an eye flush bottle, shower nozzle and soap to facilitate timely rescue at any time in case of a splattering event. Place a mark indicating eye danger in a prominent position

### 1.6.1.3 Airbag
`geely_coolray_en_ba764691` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1

Refer to 1.6.1.10 Chemicals 1.6.1.15 Fire

Highly flammable and explosive comply with the non-smoking rules.

Airbags are installed in steering wheel, front passenger seat, passenger front instrument panel and A-pillar, B-pillar and Cpillar as assist safety system.

There is a gas of high temperature when high energy propellant is ignited in airbag explosion device (2500ºC/4532℉).

This propellant is sealed in enclosed unit. When the airbag works, the gas will fill whole air pocket. The airbag should not be deployed during maintenance, because it will cause propellant contact and danger. If gas generator is found broken, one should wear protective clothing which can cover whole body when dealing with spilled material.

After normal detonation of airbag, one should wear safety goggles and gloves in dealing process.

Detonated airbag should be disposed in accordance with local relevant laws and regulations.

Measure should be taken after contacting the gas derivative directly:

– Flush thoroughly with clean water at the contact point Seek medical care depending on the situation

Airbag operation should be executed (please wear safety device as well as possible for your safety; make sure that the power mode of start and stop button of vehicle is in “OFF” status. Unplug the key and disconnect battery negative cable. Wait for 90s, then the removal work can be operated).

– Store the airbag unit in vertical position.
Keep the airbag unit dry in storage.

– Notice not to touch electrode with hands. Keep your body away from airbag as far as possible when carrying airbag unit.

Place the protecting cover upwards when airbag unit is placed.

Check carefully whether the airbag unit is damaged.

Disconnect the battery negative cable first when connecting airbag. Wait for 60s, and stand on the side of airbag unit.

Accurate correction and maintenance of all equipment.

– After disposing detonated airbag, make sure to wash hands.

Airbag operations to be avoided

Flammable materials and the unit or gas generator cannot be stored together.

Airbag assembly should not be immersed in water or contact other fluid.

The temperature of places where the gas generator is stored should not exceed 80ºC/176ºF.

The unit should not be stored upside down.

Do not try to open the shell of gas generator.

The gas generator should be away from open flame or sources of intense heat.

Do not place other items on the unit cover.

Damaged unit should not be used.

Do not touch the airbag unit or gas generator within 10min of detonation of unit.

Do not use any electric probe on the circuit.

### Refer to 1.6.1.10 Chemicals
`geely_coolray_en_b623abb4` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Skin contact can cause frostbite.

It is needed to follow the manufacturer’s descriptions, avoid naked lights and wear proper goggles and protective gloves.

If skin or eyes come into contact with refrigerant, it is necessary to wash the exposed area with water immediately. The eyes shall be flushed with appropriate flush solution and shall not be rubbed. Medical assistance shall be sought according to the specific situation

A/C refrigerant operations to be avoided

Do not store refrigerants in the places with sunlight or heat sources.

When filling, it is improper to keep the refrigerant bottles upright and keep their valves downward.

– It is forbidden to expose the refrigerant bottle to frost and snow.

– Do not drop the refrigerant bottle.

– Do not discharge the refrigerant directly into the atmosphere under any circumstances.

Do not mix the refrigerants. For example: R12 (dichlorodifluoromethane) and R134a (tetrafluoroethane).

### 1.6.1.5 Adhesive and sealant
`geely_coolray_en_225a7c4e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Note warning on the use of the adhesive and sealant

Before the adhesive and sealant are used, make sure that the surface of the sizing part is clean and it must be wiped with the special cleaner, so as not to affect the adhesive effect. The sealants cured at room temperature should not enter the thread blind holes when using the sealant. If the sealant cured at room temperature enters the thread blind holes, fastener tightening will have a hydraulic lock up effect when it is tightened. The hydraulic lock up of fastener components causes the damage to fastener tightening and other components. It will also make it unable to get the correct clamp force of fastener tightening when tightening, resulting in incorrect tightness of fastener tightening, loose or separation of components and serious damage to the engine and other components.

Health and safety

Since there are harmful substances in the materials used in adhesive and sealant, long-term exposure will cause some diseases, such as acute and chronic poisoning, career diseases and skin diseases. The ventilation device is used to maintain the ventilation of the workshop when applying glues; protective gloves, face mask, protective clothing, etc. should be worn during operation; hands should be washed carefully and the workshop should be clean, tidy and sanitary after working.

Waste glues and wastes polluted by the solvent should be promptly cleaned up, and not be accumulated for a long time.

Products should normally be kept in non-smoking areas. When used, they must keep clean and construction is carried out with applicators or containers as far as possible.

Maintenance of adhesive and sealant

In the event of fault or accidents of vehicle, it will cause body distort, cracking of steel plates and getting adrift of welding joint and part damages to the engine, chassis and other assembly components, causing the some adhesive/sealant products to be adrift and damaged. In the process of vehicle maintenance, the adhesive with the same performance should be selected according to the material and functional requirements of components. The following is a list of adhesives/ sealants that can be used during automobile maintenance, which can be selected in the automobile maintenance.

Body repair

If the body interior trim and steel plates distort or crack and the adhesive on the body get adrift or cracked, the parts with adhesive should be repaired in the process of maintenance.

– Firstly, remove the adhesive on the body surface with a knife and wipe the remaining adhesive with alcohol.

Wipe the adhesive parts with special cleaners to avoid residual impurities such as remaining adhesive on the sizing surface;

– Then apply the repair adhesive to the original sizing parts to achieve the adhesive and sealing effect.

`geely_coolray_en_d184e289` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Glue for component maintenance sealant is applied, the adhesive surface should be cleaned to avoid burrs and cracks affecting the adhesive effect.

Other maintenance materials

### Construction cautions
`geely_coolray_en_988d475e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

The role of adhesive/sealant is to prevent water and dust from entering the vehicle, but also has the function of anticorrosion. The original sealing joints are obvious and should be resealed if they are damaged. High consistency fillers should be selected when open joints are sealed with adhesive/sealant. Follow the descriptions for the selected materials.

When adhesive/sealant materials are sprayed, precautions must be taken to avoid spraying into component openings (such as door locks, window trays, window adjusters and seat belt retractors) and any moving or rotating components, especially parking brake cables. After the adhesive/sealant is sprayed, make sure that all body bleed holes are opened.

Special protective glasses and gloves should be worn during construction to prevent personal injury.

When the vehicle is delivered, the body metal plates have been coated. After maintenance and/or replacement of components, all exposed metal surfaces must be treated with the rust-proof primer before glue is applied.

– After gluing maintenance, part of the adhesive/sealant needs to be dried and cured. The baking condition is (70 \~ 80) ℃ for 20 \~ 30min.

Such as isopropanol, ethyleneglycol, glycol and methyl alcohol.

Highly flammable combustibles.

Used in engine coolant circulation system of vehicles.

Engine coolant (glycol) may produce steam in case heated to high temperatures. Inhalation of this steam should be avoided.

After directly contacting the engine coolant, the amount of engine coolant absorbed directly through the skin may reach toxic or harmful levels. If accidentally swallowing the engine

coolant, it could be life-threatening and you should be sent to the hospital immediately for medical assistance.

These products cannot be handled in conjunction with common food or connected with the drinking water supply system

### 1.6.1.9 Chemical materials
`geely_coolray_en_ed073e97` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

Great care should be given to the use, storage, and disposal of chemical materials of solvents, sealants, adhesives, coatings, resin foam, battery acid fluid, engine coolant, brake fluid, fuel, lubrication oil, and grease. They may be toxic, harmful, erosive, irritant, or highly combustible and with high dangerous odor and dust.

The influence of long-term overexposure to the chemical substances in the environment may be immediate or chronic, transient or permanent, accumulative, superficial, life-threatening, or may affect lifespan.

Chemical materials required operations

Carefully read and follow the warnings and notices on the raw material container and any accompanying leaflet, poster, and other instructions. The health and safety data form of raw materials can be obtained from the manufacturer.

– After being exposed to chemical materials, remove them from your skin and clothes immediately, and change heavily immersed clothing and wash it thoroughly.

Strictly follow instructions and wear protective clothing to avoid direct contact of the materials with the skin and eyes.

– In case of dealing with chemical materials, clean before resting, eating, smoking, or using toilet facilities.

– Keep the tidiness and orderliness of the working area, and do not spill the chemical materials.

Chemical materials operations that should be avoided

– Unless specified by the manufacturer, chemical materials cannot be mixed. Some chemical substances will form other toxic or harmful chemical substances and release other toxic and harmful gases during the mixture and cause an explosion or other accidents.

Spraying chemical materials in an enclosed environment is not allowed.

– Unless specified by the Manufacturer, chemical materials cannot be heated, because some chemical materials are highly combustible and others may release toxic and harmful gases.

Do not keep the chemical material container open. Released gases may accumulate to be toxic, harmful, or explosive. Some gases are heavier than the air and can be accumulated in an enclosed space.

– Putting chemical materials in containers without labeling is not allowable.

Cleaning hands or clothing with chemical materials is not allowable. Chemical medicines, especially solvents and fuels, will dry out the skin and may cause allergies, scytitis, or the direct absorption of toxic and harmful substances, influencing the health of the body.

Do not store other chemical materials in an empty container arbitrarily unless the container is cleaned under supervision.

Do not sniff or smell chemical materials. Brief exposure to gases with high concentrations may still cause poisoning or injuries.

### 1.6.1.10 Dust
`geely_coolray_en_4429f571` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Powder, dust, and dirt may be irritating, harmful, or poisonous. Avoid inhaling powdery chemicals or dust raised by dry friction operation. If ventilation is insufficient, it’s required to wear a breathing mask and protective device to prevent inhalation of dust.

Fine dust of combustible material may have the risk of explosion. Avoid explosion and combustion source.

### 1.6.1.11 Electric shock
`geely_coolray_en_8b224384` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:electrical | p:1

Incorrect use of electrical equipment without following instructions or abuse of equipment in good condition may cause electric shocks.

Be sure to maintain the electrical equipment within the specified time and test it frequently. Faulty equipment should be marked and it’d better to move it outside the working area.

Do not wear, kink, cut, crack or otherwise damage wires, cables, plugs and sockets, and do not make electrical equipment and wires contact with water.

Ensure that electrical equipment is protected by correct fuses.

Misuse of electrical equipment is prohibited, and equipment with any hidden trouble must not be used, otherwise the result may affect personal safety.

The cables of mobile electrical equipment shall be guaranteed not to be clamped and damaged.

Basic first aid training must be carried out for specialized electrical appliance operators.

In the event of an electric shock:

Turn off the power before contacting the victim.

– If the power supply cannot be turned off, the victim’s power supply should be removed with dry insulator material.

Those who have received special first aid training should immediately carry out on-site first aid.

Request medical assistance.

### 1.6.1.12 Waste gas
`geely_coolray_en_7efcae65` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The waste gas contains toxic and hazardous chemical substances, for example, carbon oxide, nitrogen oxide, acetaldehyde, lead and aromatic hydrocarbons. The engine can operate only when it is in a proper waste gas exhaustion equipment or common ventilation equipment and in an open space.

### 1.6.1.13 Fiber isolation
`geely_coolray_en_67f0071e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Refer to 1.6.1.11 Dust

Used to isolate noise and sound.

The fibrous nature of its surface and sharp edges can cause skin allergies.

Follow the operating procedure instructions and wear gloves during operation to avoid excessive skin contact with the fibers.

### 1.6.1.14 Fire hazard
`geely_coolray_en_5cc7fda0` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Many materials related to vehicle maintenance are highly flammable. Many materials will produce poisonous and harmful gases after burning.

Please make certain to follow the fire control safety standards in storing and disposing flammable materials or solvents, especially in places near to electrical equipment and where a welding operation is taking place.

Before using electrical and welding equipment, no potentials of the fire must be confirmed firstly.

In case of welding or using the heating equipment, it is needed to prepare a suitable fire extinguisher around the operation area.

### 1.6.1.15 Emergency
`geely_coolray_en_b01ebd42` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

It should not only comply with the law, but also have professional first aid coaching personnel in the working place.

If the eyes are splashed, they should be rinsed with water for at least 10 minutes.

f the skin is contaminated, wash the contaminated area with soap and water。

If suffered from frostbite, soak the frostbitten area in ice water or cold water.

The personal inhaling toxic gases should be immediately moved to the area with fresh air, if adverse reactions continue to occur, the injured personal should immediately be sent to a hospital for medical assistance.

In case of accidental ingestion of liquid, inform the physician of the information on the container or coil label, and do not blindly induce vomiting unless instructed to do so by the coil label.

### 1.6.1.16 Foam polyurethane
`geely_coolray_en_65c5546c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Refer to 1.6.1.15 Fire

The cured foam is used as a buffer pad between the seat and decoration.

Manufacturer instructions are followed.

Components that do not produce chemical reactions are irritating and may be harmful to skins and eyes, gloves and goggles are needed to worn for operations.

For persons with problems of chronic respiratory diseases, asthma, and bronchus or with hereditary allergy, they should not handle or be close non-cured materials.

Spare parts, vapor, or spray of non-cured materials will cause direct stimulus and anaphylactic reactions that may be toxic and harmful.

Do not inhale vapor or spray. Such materials must be used under the condition of good ventilation and that breathing is protected. It is not allowable to remove the mask immediately after spraying, and it can be removed until the complete dissipation of vapor and spray.

The combustion of non-cured components and cured foam will produce poisonous and harmful gases. During the period of foam operation, unless vapor and spray have been completely cleared out, and smoking, open fire, and electric equipment are prohibited. The thermal cutting for any foam materials or special foam materials should be operated in a well-ventilated environment.

### 1.6.1.17 Fuel
`geely_coolray_en_44c2fa55` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Reduce direct skin contact with the fuel. When exposing to the fuel, immediately use soap and clear water to wash the skin that directly contacts the fuel.

### Gasoline
`geely_coolray_en_2ebc12de` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

The usage of inflammable gasoline should conform to the smoking banning regulations.

If someone ingests, she/he will suffer from the stimulation of mouth and throat.

Besides, if the stomach absorbs it, she/he will suffer from general weakness and obnubilation. Children's life safety will be influenced by a small quantity of gasoline. Therefore, it will be very dangerous if the liquid enters the lungs.

The gasoline will cause dry skin and cause skin allergy and dermatitis if the gasoline is contacted for a long time or frequently. The liquid will cause severe pain when entering the eyes.

Motor gasoline contains a large quantity of benzene. Inhalation of it will lead to poisoning. Therefore, the concentration of the gasoline vapor should be maintained at a low level. Gasoline vapor in high concentration will trigger illnesses such as irritation, nausea, headache, depression and inebriation. The gasoline vapor with extremely high concentration will cause fast consciousness loss.

When the gasoline is treated, good ventilation should be maintained. In particular, when the operation is conducted in a confined space, it is needed to pay attention to the danger of gasoline vapor inhalation caused by splashing.

Special attention should be paid when gasoline storage equipment is cleaned and maintained.

The gasoline should not be used as detergent and should never be inhaled by mouth.

### 1.6.1.18 General workshop tools and equipment
`geely_coolray_en_4fff433c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Always keep good working condition of all tools and equipment, and right operations during use, which are all significant.

Bear in mind that do not use tools or equipment applied for the purposes contrary to its design function. Do not make equipment such as crane, jack, axle, chassis bracket and sling bear the load exceeding the maximum limit it can bear. Damage caused by overload does not always appear immediately, and it may cause serious accidents in the next use.

Do not use tools or equipment that have been damaged or in poor working condition, especially some high-speed equipment such as grinding wheel. Damaged grinding wheel can shatter without warning and cause serious damage.

At the time of using grinding wheel, chisel or sandblasting equipment, appropriate eye protection equipment should be worn.

When operators use sandblasting equipment, handle materials containing asbestos or use spray equipment to conduct operation, appropriate breathing mask should be worn.

Ventilation equipment that can control the amount of dust, spray, and smoke in the environment must be equipped.

### 1.6.1.19 Lubricants and lubricating grease
`geely_coolray_en_03387a1a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Avoid long time and repeated contact with mineral grease. All lubrication oils and lubricating greases are irritating to eyes and skin.

Used engine oil

Long time and repeated contact with mineral grease will give rise to the loss of natural skin oil, and cause dryness, irritation and dermatitis. Besides, it is highly likely that there is harmful substance that may cause skin cancer in the used engine oil. Skin protection equipment, as well as flushing equipment, should be used.

Do not use the used engine oil as ubrication oil, or any other usage that may contact skin directly.

Heath protection safety rules

– Long time and repeated contact with engine oil should be avoided, especially the used engine oil.

– Wear protective clothing, including impermeable gloves.

Do not put wiping cloth stained with engine oil intopockets.

Prevent the engine oil contaminating clothing, especially those clothing that can touch human body.

– Do not wear clothing or shoes highly contaminated with engine oil. Working clothing must be cleaned regularly and kept clean.

First aid treatment of open wound should be given without delay.

– In working, apply the protection cream to your skin as long as possible, so as to prevent your skin directly contacting engine oil.

Use soap and clean water to flush and eliminate all engine oil. Apply protective agent which contains wool grease. This will help replace natural oil removed from your skin.

If skin lesion occurs, seek for medical treatment immediately.

– Eliminate the residual grease on components as much as possible before working.

If direct contact to eyes is possible, please wear protective goggles such as goggles or masks that are protective against chemicals and drugs. Besides, eyes flushing equipment is also needed.

### Environment notices:
`geely_coolray_en_14ae1f0a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Used waste engine oil and oil filter element should be recycled and handled by authorized or licensed waste processors, or waste engine oil recyclers. If you have any doubt, contact the relevant departments of the local competent authority in a timely manner.

It is prohibited by law to pour the used waste engine oil directly into the ground, sewer or drainage or water pipe directly is illegal.

### 1.6.1.20 Noise
`geely_coolray_en_e5b7924f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

High-decibel noise may be produced during the process of some operations, and it may cause harm to hearing. At this moment, the appropriate hearing protection equipment should be worn.

### 1.8.1.2 Vehicle identification number (VIN) descriptions
`geely_coolray_en_c72c8d34` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Composition of VIN:

The VIN consists of three parts (17 digits in total), including world manufacturers identifier (WMI), vehicle descriptor section (VDS) and vehicle identifier section (VIS), as shown in the figure below:

![](images/a87908a5cae3923cbbf29d812180b95b01a3e2c2e34ec672de68a82febed4c8a.webp)

Taking the VIN LB37622ZXNX800068 as an example, the meaning of each digit is shown in the table below:

![](images/b8b457cd5849e7a04ec06cb06a00ac5b4f16e660c56f546e7fa196640e47e99a.webp)

The world manufacturer identification code (WMI) is located in the first part (1-3 digits) of the vehicle identification number. Where:

LJU-Zhejiang Geely Automotive Co., Ltd. (Imperial Hua)

LB3-Zhejiang Haoqing Automobile Manufacturing Co., Ltd. The fourth digit code regulation

L6T-Zhejiang Geely Automotive Co., Ltd.
LJ2 ― Shanxi New Energy Vehicle Industry Co., Ltd.
L10 ――Chengdu Plateau Automobile Industry Co., Ltd.

The fifth digit code regulation
![](images/50453221e32914ae021755ddd71d015d49e2d5f314cd044647c510b0abfbec75.webp)

![](images/059236d6e3afdd0d6bcdc050933b94862c81a96630b86d56fa85fba380bce600.webp)

The sixth and seventh digit code regulations

![](images/61ceae32173818c5cc3c67358059901f6ab764dde31756ec1e7ae9321760ee1c.webp)

![](images/e1fcd43c5d723867908a55b44f4745939ead969d9c00e3d6e9911b6f3d8f3717.webp)

The eighth digit code regulation
![](images/23dc48f9bcb46d3d9c31f26b4d09a7a572a9849bf3d6444336f49c19eb438f9e.webp)

![](images/9c78b959c0f3dcd9ad8881efb201d0695011434a6e8c38c83f7958e0ef884a71.webp)

The ninth digit code regulation

This digit is for verification. The value is calculated by the manufacturer through a formula according to the values of the remaining 16 digits. This code should be any number from 0 to 9 or the letter "X", which is used to verify the authenticity of the VIN and ensure the uniqueness and validity of the VIN.

The tenth digit code regulation
![](images/fb19b1901664d0bc81f6f0eb908b214055fc9b25ab964b130cd73586bd850934.webp)

The eleventh digit code regulation

![](images/a9772290869b6948921f5a1a164e3d5b531e097744ffefbfe0f3dc46fab93bd9.webp)

![](images/7a809090c55eca79ecb48a1574d68c7f8ad1ca8f9041492c189afe0ce2062892.webp)

![](images/0a483df34625a3616bc3b85a91a9b7b42fd54f22a961e2911bf01ae0bac7df5e.webp)

The twelfth to the seventeenth digits code regulations

The twelfth to the seventeenth digits are the production sequence number. The code is arranged according to the sequence of vehicles produced in the same year and in the same assembly station, and from 000001 every year.

### 2.1.1.1 Warnings and Precautions
`geely_coolray_en_74cf807d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Warnings regarding battery disconnection

Warning！

Before maintaining any electrical component, the start and stop button power mode should be in the OFF status and all electrical loads must be “OFF” (switch off) unless otherwise stated in the operational program. If tools or equipment are easily accessible to exposed live electrical terminals, disconnect the negative battery cable. Violating these safety instructions may result in personal injury or damages to the vehicle or vehicle components.

Warnings regarding exhaust system maintenance

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_74af5388` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

To avoid burns, do not repair the exhaust system when it is hot. Please perform maintenance after the exhaust system has cooled down.

Warnings regarding fuel and EVAP pipe

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_352365bb` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

To reduce the risk of fire and personal injury, please observe the following:

All fuel pipes that are scored, scratched or damaged during installation should be replaced, and no attempt should be made to repair the fuel pipe.

When installing a new fuel pipe, do not directly knock on the fuel pipe clamp with a hammer.

When operating a welding torch near the fuel vapor pipe, be sure to cover the fuel vapor pipe with a wet towel. In addition, do not expose the vehicle to temperatures above 115°C (239ºF) for more than 1 hour, and do not park it at temperatures above 90° C (194ºF) for long periods of time.

Before connecting the fuel pipe connectors, be sure to apply a few drops of clean engine oil to the male pipe connector to ensure correct reconnection and prevent possible fuel leakage. (During normal operation, the O-ring in the female connector may swell, and if it is not lubricated, it cannot be reconnected correctly.)

Warnings regarding fuel gauge leak

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_06d42ada` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

Wrap a rag around the fuel pressure gauge joints to reduce the risk of fire or personal injury. The rag will absorb the leaking fuel when connecting the fuel pressure gauge. After connecting the pressure fuel gauge, the rag should be put in an appropriate container.

Warnings regarding fuel pipe connectors

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_6da12a18` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before connecting the fuel pipe connectors, be sure to apply a few drops of clean engine oil to the male pipe connector to reduce the risk of fire or personal injury. It also ensures correct reconnection and prevents possible fuel leakage. During normal operation, the Oring in the female connector may swell, and if it is not lubricated, it cannot be reconnected correctly.

Warnings regarding fuel storage

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_69197afa` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Do not drain fuel into an open container. Do not store fuel in open containers, otherwise there is a risk of fire or explosion.

Warnings regarding fuel vapor in EVAP components

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_003fcd29` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Do not inhale the air in the EVAP pipe or hose. The fuel vapor in the EVAP components may cause personal injury.

Warnings regarding gasoline/gasoline vapor

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_a2b63aab` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Gasoline or gasoline vapor burns very easily. It may cause fire if there is a fire source. To prevent fire or explosion, never drain fuel to or store fuel in an open container. Please provide a dry-chemical fire extinguisher nearby.

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_c284a6ea` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

To avoid burns, do not remove the radiator assembly cap until the engine cools down. If the radiator assembly cap is removed before the engine and radiator assembly cool down, the cooling system will release scalding high-pressure liquid and steam.

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_8a540390` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If the pressure cap is opened and cooling system maintenance is performed when the engine is not cooled and the pressure is still high, the engine coolant will immediately boil and may be sprayed on the person who opens the radiator pressure cap, causing severe burns.

Warnings regarding fuel pressure release

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_10f8536a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

Before servicing the fuel system, remove the fuel tank cap and release the pressure of the fuel system to reduce the risk of personal injury. After the pressure of the fuel system is released, a small amount of fuel will overflow when servicing the fuel lines, fuel injection pumps, or joints. To reduce the risk of personal injury, cover the fuel system components with a rag before disconnecting. The rag can absorb fuel leaked out of the components. After disconnecting, place the rag in a suitable container.

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_abfdc850` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Road test should be conducted under the premise of ensuring safety and observing all traffic regulations. Do not try any operation that may endanger the control of the vehicle. Violating the above safety instructions can cause serious personal injury and damage the vehicle.

### 2.2.2.1 General
`geely_coolray_en_0fb13f9e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Basic system principles

The engine control system uses a joint electronic control system, which is mainly composed of an engine control module (ECM), ECM working circuit, system input and output components. ECM is the control center of the engine control system. It continuously monitors signals from various sensors and controls various systems that affect vehicle performance. The engine control module also performs the function of system diagnosis. It can identify operation troubles, and remind the driver through the fault indicator lamp and save the DTC indicating the fault location for the maintenance personnel to perform repair work.

The engine management system usually consists of three parts: a sensor, an electronic control module (ECM), and an actuator. It controls the air intake amount, fuel injection quantity, and ignition advance angle during engine operation. The basic structure is shown in the figure:

![](images/5d06d65a061604b5ad58153994d9ea78d5fbe65d0c269a9fd1bb3e4a47f40801.webp)

In the engine electronic control system, the sensor is used as an input component to measure various physical signals (temperature, pressure, etc.) and convert them into corresponding electrical signals; the role of ECM is to accept the input signal of the sensor and perform calculation according to the set program to generate the corresponding control signal and output it to the power drive circuit. The power drive circuit drives various actuators to perform different actions, making the engine operate according to the established control strategy; at the same time, ECM's trouble diagnosis system monitors each component or control function in the system. Once a trouble is detected and confirmed, the DTC will be stored and the "Limp

Home" function will be activated. When the detected trouble is eliminated, the normal value will be restored.

The biggest feature of the engine electronic control management system is the use of torque-based control strategy. The main purpose of the torque-based control strategy is to link a large number of different control objectives together. This is the only way to flexibly choose to integrate various functions in different variants of ECM according to the engine and vehicle model.

If the engine control module is damaged, no single part inside the module can be repaired separately. ECM must be replaced as a whole.

### 2.2.2.2 Component description
`geely_coolray_en_ded9447c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1

Crankshaft position sensor (CKP)

Crankshaft position sensor is used to measure the speed and position of engine crankshaft. The sensor outputs the corresponding voltage signal to ECM by detecting the crankshaft, and determines the engine speed and top dead center information. Crankshaft position sensor is mainly used to monitor the position and speed of crankshaft. The true value will be transmitted to ECM. Crankshaft position sensor is an important sensor of engine. When the crankshaft position sensor is faulty, the engine cannot be started or stopped.

Camshaft position sensor (CMP)

As the camshaft rotates, the camshaft position sensor outputs the corresponding voltage signal by judging the convex and concave teeth of the signal wheel on the camshaft, and judge the position and speed of the camshaft by outputting the signal. The voltage signal is eventually input to ECM and calculated by ECM software to determine the engine ignition timing. Camshaft position sensor is mainly used to monitor the position of camshaft. The true value will be transmitted to ECM. The engine control module will determine the position and speed of camshaft through the camshaft position sensor signals. Moreover, it will coordinate with the crankshaft position sensor to judge the compression top dead center and the exhaust top dead center, indicating the piston position in Cylinder No.1 during the work stroke. Then the actual fuel injection order can be calculated by ECM.

![](images/dd1c7398bc8fa510bea04ac0b5040125ca307d9b9deb06b5bb8671512dd235be.webp)

Knock sensor (KS)

Knock sensor is mainly used to detect the actual value of cylinder knock. There is a piezoelectric element in the knock sensor, which can record the actual value of each cylinder knock and transmit it to ECM. Through the piezoelectric ceramics in the sensor, it detects the vibration of the engine, outputs the voltage signal to ECM, and determines whether the engine has a knock through software calculation to prevent the engine from being damaged due to the knock.

### Air intake pressure and temperature sensor
`geely_coolray_en_4e66582f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

The air intake pressure/temperature sensor chip can provide a "load signal" to the controller according to the difference between atmospheric pressure and intake manifold pressure. The controller provides a 5V voltage and feeds the voltage back to the controller according to the intake pressure, so as to measure the absolute pressure of the intake manifold and provide engine load information. The NTC thermistor changes with the change of temperature. It accurately and timely measures the temperature change of the environment and its output resistance value, that is, it reflects the temperature of the contacted air.

![](images/b7f642bc86f45db2596ff8b0895358bcc7a0b75558b54cd0f808e6f3ae40d276.webp)

### Water temperature sensor
`geely_coolray_en_b4486c11` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The NTC thermistor is enclosed in the temperature sensor, and its resistance value changes with the temperature. It accurately and timely measures the temperature change of the environment, and its output resistance value, that is, it reflects the temperature of the contacted medium. The water temperature sensor is used to monitor the coolant temperature of engine. On the one hand, it outputs the resistance signal to ECU for it to judge the operating condition of the engine, and corrects the fuel injection and ignition. On the other hand, it outputs the signal to the relevant instrument to allow the driver to visually view the coolant temperature state of the engine.

![](images/958faa7f0a67e3bddb8799abf7f0c173a41881dab6a75f524639c4cf2a73e9bb.webp)

![](images/c622960f6ee35817fcdf2401be5ea6b029cd0f35ab7ad0928cd121aee9f21393.webp)

### Oxygen sensor
`geely_coolray_en_51e562b5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:fuel_ev | p:1

They are located in front and behind the GPF catalytic converter assembly respectively. The oxygen sensor measures the oxygen content in the exhaust gas and sends the measured value to ECM. The sensing element (zirconia oxide) in the sensor can work only when the operating temperature is 300℃. When the engine burns the rich gas mixture, the exhaust gas has a small oxygen content and the voltage is about 0.8V-1V. When the lean gas mixture is burned, the exhaust gas has a large oxygen content and the movable ability of oxygen in the zirconia pipe is weakened. It only generates a voltage of 0.1V. ECU judges the fuel injection quantity according to this principle, keeping fuel injection quantity fluctuates around the ideal air-fuel ratio (14.7:1) to meet the requirements for the ideal air-fuel ratio.

Oil pressure alarm

The oil pressure alarm is a pressure switch installed on the main oil circuit behind the engine oil filler. When the engine system oil pressure is lower than the set value, this switch is turned on and the engine oil pressure alarm lamp lights up. When the oil pressure is higher than the set value, this switch is turned off and the engine oil pressure alarm lamp goes off.

A

Fuel pressure sensor

The fuel pressure sensor is installed on the high-pressure fuel rail, which is composed of sensing elements, connectors, terminals, metal housings, etc. When the internal pressure of the fuel rail acts on the sensing element, the resistance in the sensing element changes, causing the bridge output voltage to change. Through the processing by amplifying circuit, the theoretical output (0.5-4.5) V voltage of the sensor is transmitted to ECU, and ECU determines the fuel pressure according to the voltage result.

Fuel injector

The fuel injector coil controls the armature to rise according to ECU commands. It controls the needle valve to move to switch the fuel injector on and off, and fuel is injected into the combustion chamber through the injection hole on the valve seat.

![](images/29b3d6be80f397866df57151c8acded967a2c6c1210b46a47cd3ab7a280cdd22.webp)

![](images/e07864c300c9fef091b59153b9f7927a6ceb157a707e3310aa6c823ccc684c57.webp)

CAN information input

ECM can collect or send relevant information of vehicle operation through CAN network to control the normal operation of engine.

### 2.2.2.3 Output Components
`geely_coolray_en_81d56e9c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1

Electronic throttle body

The electronic throttle is installed in the intake system of the engine. Its opening is not completely controlled by the driver, but according to the electronic accelerator pedal position signal and engine operating condition, water temperature, oil temperature and other sensor signals combined by ECU. The angle of the throttle valve plate is controlled by established commands to control the air volume entering the engine.

Ignition coil

The ignition coil supplies high voltage to the spark plug. The ignition coil has an integrated voltage amplifier. ECM controls the ignition coil to ensure that the spark plug generates sparks at the right time. The ignition coil is directly connected with ECM and spark plug.

Performance judgment failure mode: The ignition performance of the ignition coil can be detected: Connect all system lines and run the engine to detect the ignition performance. If there is no fire in the spark plug, it needs to be replaced; if there is yellow fire, check the capacitor itself and its circuit; if there is blue and white fire, it is normal.

![](images/0b9078cf10053389facc4f955e08452a6b7d34f08f06372fdea5e5a139e90226.webp)

Ignition coil is used to receive the ECM ignition signal and provide the spark plug with the high voltage for ignition in the electronic control fuel injection system. The ignition coil operates according to the principle of electric induction. Two magnetically coupled copper coils including the primary coil and the secondary coil form an induction circuit. Instantaneous induced voltage is generated through disconnection of the primary circuit switch. After amplification of the induction coil, instantaneous high voltage is generated in the secondary coil circuit. Then the high voltage ignites the gas mixture through the spark plug. In order to make the ignition coil work normally and have good electromagnetic compatibility performance, the supply lines and signal wires for the coil should be as far away as possible from the wires of other parts. The ignition module should not share a grounding wire with other vehicle electrical components. The grounding wire should be as short as possible. Because the ignition coil can produce a high voltage, when it is powered on, do not remove the ignition coil or the spark plug by hand. Do not contact any metal part or the high-voltage extension rod directly, otherwise you may be hurt by the high voltage.

![](images/c953d0f5240026055919c48de0658e34bbad7acd38e959820f00065f150c386a.webp)

High-pressure oil pump

When the plunger of the oil pump goes down, the flow control valve opens (no power), and the high-pressure oil pump draws in certain fuel.

When the oil pump plunger goes up, the flow control valve opens (no power), the high-pressure oil pump discharges excess fuel on demand.

### Oil control valve
`geely_coolray_en_3e972b31` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1

When the oil pump plunger continues to move upward, the flow control valve closes (energized), the high-pressure oil pump compresses the fuel in the oil chamber, and delivers the compressed fuel to the fuel rail.

Control the valve element according to the ECU duty cycle signal and move the reversing lever up and down to realize the opening and closing of port A and port B of the oil channel, and the oil enters the corresponding cavity of VVT from port A or port B to realize VVT rotation.

When the difference between the pressure in the fuel rail and that in the high-pressure oil pump is greater than 39.9-41.4 MPa, the pressure relief valve opens, and the fuel in the fuel rail will return to the low-pressure oil way to ensure that the pressure in the fuel rail is within a reasonable range.

净

![](images/dc0be322013c12da624dc5d41471da9eb1925b1306245b7e93fa542b13e7c026.webp)

Electronic water pump

The electronic water pump is a speed adjustable water pump integrated with an electronic module, its motor is driven by a controller to rotate.

When the water pump operates normally, it receives ECU commands through the LIN bus signal; when the LIN bus signal is disconnected abnormally, the PWM duty cycle signal is used to adjust the water pump speed. In addition to basic functions, it also has corresponding protection functions. When abnormal rotations, dry running, overcurrent and other abnormalities are detected, the water pump can feed the corresponding DTC back to ECU through LIN.

The water pump is not affected by the engine crankshaft speed, and adjusts its own speed by receiving the ECU signal, so that the cooling system runs more efficiently and flexibly.

![](images/6649fd927650cc184192bfba2b3aeefc25b2ff0a688c728131c87ced557a284d.webp)

Engine control module (ECM)

![](images/e966919f76c67c000b149e717dd2ff098d87add1dfe4021632e7ad462fc187a6.webp)

By collecting sensor data such as temperature and pressure, ECM can control throttle valve, fuel injection quantity, ignition timing and other parameters so as to control the engine to run. The main functions are shown in the table below:

![](images/f5c3509501e07f335bc468f7b75f32c56e65e7c49ba3438353439955caf37fad.webp)

![](images/56474a5133fe0857924ee91816578aa9154281bf820aacbdd2b7751e314d98a4.webp)

CAN information output:

ECM can transmit relevant information of the engine through CAN network to realize network sharing.

### 2.2.5.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_e69a41bb` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before diagnosing faults in the control system, refer to System Operating Principles to understand and be familiar with the operating principle of control system, and then start system diagnosis, which helps to determine the correct fault diagnosis steps when a fault occurs. More importantly, it helps to determine whether the condition described by the customer is normal. Any trouble diagnosis of the control system should start with the "control system check". The "control system check" will guide maintenance personnel to take the next logical step for diagnosis. Understanding and using the diagnosis flow chart correctly can shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of parts.

### 2.2.5.2 Control system check
`geely_coolray_en_656e7426` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before checking the control system, perform the following initial inspection:

Check the battery terminal voltage to ensure that the power supply is sufficient and the voltage is stable.
Check the battery cables. Clean and tighten them.
Check easily accessible or visible system components, such as vacuum pipes, harness connectors, for obvious damage or conditions that could lead to failure.
Check that the position of the control module and the main ground wire connecting points of the battery are normal, and there should be no signs of looseness in the ground wire connecting point copper.
• Check the after-sales installations of the control system to ensure that they do not interfere with the normal operation of the system.

2. Diagnosis steps:

### 2.2.5.2 Control system check
`geely_coolray_en_f2fe6f05` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Find a normal vehicle, connect the fault diagnosis instrument, and check whether the fault diagnosis instrument can be turned on normally.

### 2.2.5.5 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the start and stop button to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a2f6e3c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic apparatus.

### 2.2.5.6 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_8f6753c4` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:electrical | p:1

Clear DTC.

Conduct simulation tests.

Check and shake the harness, connector box terminals.

When the fault cannot be confirmed through the DTC check, the symptom only appears occasionally in use. All circuits and components that may cause faults should be confirmed. In many cases, the fault location can be quickly and effectively found by performing the basic checks shown in the following flow chart. Especially for faults such as poor contact of the harness connector. Fault definition: The fault does not currently occur, but the historical fault diagnosis code record indicates that the fault has occurred. Or the distributor reported the fault for repair, but because the fault is not related to the fault diagnosis code, the fault symptoms cannot be reproduced currently.

Diagnosis steps:

![](images/8ac8112bc00c5cf85702ea06b6c2a167c1272bed28b7443e5fcde5357682133c.webp)

A. Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "OFF".
B. Measure the battery voltage.
C. According to the measured value, enter the corresponding diagnosis steps.

![](images/6c82dd3b91b5fd6961058b6ee97a0785093e49683227d37b04bd6f93757cf918.webp)

Check the battery, refer to Battery description and operation

![](images/1967bcd58626091c2547fb5efa3c1aac6b43c623f73a16225b6f60d91cec4aba.webp)

A. If the following phenomena exist, priority will be given to the maintenance and repair work for the fault, otherwise the subsequent fault diagnosis and repair work will be affected. Check whether the harness is damaged, whether there are symptoms such as wear and tear. • Examine the fuel pipes for leakage. Check whether the harness is arranged improperly. It is strictly forbidden to for the harness to approach the following high-voltage or high-current devices: ignition coil, ignition wire, starting motor, alternator and other motor components. When these components operate, they will produce large electromagnetic interference, which will affect the correct transmission of signals and cause that the system does not operate. Check whether the high-voltage line system is aged, broken, squashed or damaged. Check the vacuum hose for cracks, damage or twists. Confirm that the wiring and arrangement are correct. • C heck the engine control module (EMS) grounding point and the body grounding point for oxidation, looseness, position error, etc. The position of the grounding point of the control system must not be changed at will. This will affect the normal operation of the control system. Check whether the positive and negative cables of the battery are connected reliably and whether there is any looseness, oxidation, corrosion, etc.

Next step

![](images/b2b9af24bd3ca8cf2c371faaad03cd2d88b94ab24d91843789e899c7ac0a5b17.webp)

A. Many intermittent faults are caused by vibration, twisting, uneven roads, or movement of harnesses and connectors caused by the component operation.
B. If the circuit resistance is too large, the part does not operate. Use the fault diagnosis instrument to force the actuator to drive. If it does not operate, check whether the related circuit has circuit faults such as excessive resistance.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_d6d4b8d1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:electrical | p:1

Next step

![](images/6844e30d1ec2924fbbfbb1466a1e9d515e7f747616120b997d5332b7c0a3264e.webp)

A. Connect the vehicle fault diagnosis instrument and use the data recording function of the fault diagnosis instrument to record the data when the intermittent fault occurs on the vehicle for a road test. After the button of the vehicle data recorder is pressed down, the engine control module data can be recorded when intermittent faults occur, and this data can be used to find out the fault location.
B. Another diagnostic method is to connect the digital multimeter to the suspicious circuit while the vehicle is driving. The abnormal reading value of the digital multimeter may indicate the fault location.

Next step

![](images/45e450fd09fc8ec452499b58d0cceac40bfd71367df8d681729fc7d2800ac707.webp)

A. The following conditions may cause the fault indicator to light up intermittently, but the system will not set the fault diagnosis code: Electromagnetic interference caused by malfunctioning relays, solenoid valves, or switches controlled by the engine control module. Non-original or after-sales accessories, for example: car phones, alarms, car lights, or radio equipment, are installed incorrectly. The fault indicator control circuit is intermittently shorted to GND. The grounding point of the engine control module is loose.

Next step

![](images/b60fd8226ce4496732b49ad6d7fc2b52150a5d5ee67dd22acec9aab414e9b1fb.webp)

A. Test whether the diodes at both ends of the A/C compressor clutch and other diodes are circuit open.
B. Check the charging system for the following conditions: The fault of the alternator rectifier bridge may cause AC signal interference in the electrical system. Whether the alternator output voltage is correct. If the alternator output voltage is lower than 9V or higher than 18V, repair the charging system.

Next step

![](images/19c8bbdbbecbc21efc3db34f0aecc84b1b7531de10a7cb90e2c29ba930a0bdfa.webp)

### 2.2.5.11 Motion test table
`geely_coolray_en_49919ba0` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Engine control module (ECM)

By reading the “motion test” on the fault diagnostic apparatus, working statuses of the relay and the actuator controlled by ECM can be checked with no need to remove any part and component. Before diagnosing the related faults of the control system, the motion test is the prerequisite for troubleshooting, which can shorten the troubleshooting time.

### Note
`geely_coolray_en_3a2fd8db` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Data under normal condition is listed in the following table only for reference. Do not merely judge whether some part is faulty based on these reference values. Under normal conditions, a vehicle operating normally can be used to be compared with a vehicle being diagnosed in the same status to confirm whether the data of the vehicle being diagnosed is normal in current status.

a.Engine should be at normal operating temperature.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "OFF".

c. Connect the diagnostic apparatus.

d.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

e.Select “EMS”/“motion test”.

f. Refer to the following table and conduct active test.
