### 2.11.5.9 Alternator Noise Diagnosis
`geely_coolray_en_67abf122` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:electrical | p:1

Diagnostic tip: alternator noise may be caused by electrical or mechanical noise. Electrical noise (electromagnetism whines) usually changes with the electrical load applied to the alternator. This is the normal operating characteristic of all alternators. Pay attention to distinguish them during maintenance and diagnosis, otherwise it will cause unnecessary complaints from customers. When diagnosing an alternator with mechanical noise, you should first check whether the parts around the alternator are loosened, interfering with each other, and so on. some cases, even if the sound in the cabin is very light, it can be heard in the passenger cabin. If this is the case, replacing the alternator will not solve the problem, which will cause misjudgment.

Diagnosis steps:

![](images/39b27a768d6bcfeac3f5cc0182d288dacf1bbeae5aec5acd554c65940798dca4.webp)

A. Start the engine and confirm that noise can be heard.
B. Shut down the engine.
C. Disconnect the alternator harness connector EN14n.
D. Start the engine E. Confirm whether the noise disappears.
A. Shut down the engine.
B. Dismount the drive belt.
C. Turn the alternator pulley by hand.
D. Is the alternator rotating smoothly without stagnation and grinding noise?

![](images/c1a85397e622afe90dd00f1329e357e241af3598c796171d6ee0dc3c42fcc36c.webp)

![](images/f6d35f291aa2d3ee4d61f6810c49b5170611439f2d39cc3894465998d87ebb5f.webp)

No

![](images/48f1f292b1bff1b70de81e77fbd5e4c928c01e648a2e1bd2ffb8ea32adaabb62.webp)

Yes

![](images/37a1ac838d57d5e0ff2a852af796dfccd5a98a874e35f89dd4493a3134c3d409.webp)

A. Reinstall the alternator, and tighten the alternator mounting bolts to such an extent that the specified torque is reached. Please refer to Replacement of Alternator
B. Whether the noise disappears after the engine is started.

![](images/4223f050ed58834ca018fd891f88b8aacc5784afa44b1329484fb33f58090461.webp)

![](images/9283d27f61995a61621b1868352b0752c2592e80a4adee46ff33c2e855ea3050.webp)

![](images/778cf5bd3f82bfd27d51f7a2d213f7605f1c400ddac35cdbe7a1a8d1df86f360.webp)

![](images/5654bb04585d7ebd4f067f256c1a22ef542106a51c1a5e7febfc970f0a3a89bc.webp)

No

![](images/6a6523133f1ba57406f0591f6b8dc12d7de33fa6718949dbaee57cd7b361d765.webp)

Warning！

If no specific alternator trouble is found, all other possible noise sources must be eliminated before the alternator can be replaced. If the noise is made due to the normal characteristics of the alternator, the noise will not disappear after replacing the alternator.

Next step

![](images/9aaaedbcfe1dc3d7c26225e273645ebb0ddf63b180a9a63cb49fae1ddbb66ef4.webp)

### 2.11.6.1 Battery Cable Disconnection and Connection Procedures
`geely_coolray_en_db70483d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Disconnect program

![](images/f8a0285693b2124fd38324198f22224425c0dab25184dbc452e938b7912cae8d.webp)

![](images/6ce3565a4198a88c79f5f056e2e68d710d5a1085108890322f56e2bf613adf0e.webp)

1 Open the engine compartment cover
2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery a. Turn off all electrical equipment, and operate the starting button to set the power in OFF mode. b. Remove the right blanking cover of the ventilation cover plate.

c. Unscrew the fastening nut of battery negative cable and disconnect the battery negative cable.

d. Open the dust cover of battery positive cable. e. Unscrew the fastening nut of battery positive cable and disconnect the battery positive cable.

![](images/d42697d4671b3b96fa01c84f3ce833546ee3639f518e10d1285c08f625539f1e.webp)

![](images/4b0e0180586c91e34a45d218e249cd2a5886ce50a013773c04b68562d303f8a0.webp)

1 Connect the battery cable.

a. Connect the battery positive cable and tighten the fixing nut. Torque: 9 N·m (metric system) 6.6 lb-ft (British system) b. Close the dust cover of battery positive cable.

a. Connect the battery negative cable and tighten the fixing nut. Torque: 9 N·m (metric system) 6.6 lb-ft (British system)

d. Install the right blanking cover of the ventilation cover plate.

2 Close engine compartment cover

### 2.11.6.2 Replacement of battery (Type I)
`geely_coolray_en_2a8fb692` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Disconnect the positive and negative cables of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

2 Remove the air filter assembly. Refer to Replacement of air filter assembly

![](images/78b40896ba31223c444976fa62bde9c4ae50e854f90ca357414666f4e787df10.webp)

3 Remove the battery.

a. Remove the 2 fixing bolts 1 connecting the battery pressing plate and the battery tray, and remove the
battery pressing plate.
b. Remove the fixing bolt 2 connecting the engine
harness and the battery tray.
c. Remove the fixing bolt 3 connecting the engine
harness and the battery tray, and move the harness away.

d. Move the battery in the direction of the vehicle front end and disconnect the fixing slot between the battery and the battery tray.

![](images/888f0fef5eae97fed8d8c93504d8e9d84e78369ad7a9508e8b98f11b6aae60ed.webp)

e. Remove the battery heat shield.

f. Remove the battery.

Installation procedure Battery installation a. Move the battery to the installation position. b. Install the battery heat shield.

![](images/0c42eed1c1fc06fe6570234c9e221e186d3c9ec2f36895acab5b4e335d562cb9.webp)

![](images/35da24d05c7f2a4a0ab6ed4b84d37b1012ca7f8cf0363b52ce49dc0d263e60e3.webp)

c. Move the battery in the direction of the vehicle rear end, and fix the battery in the fixing slot of the battery tray.

d. Install and tighten the fixing bolt 3 connecting the engine harness and the battery tray.
Torque: 6 N·m
e. Install and tighten the fixing bolt 2 connecting the engine harness and the battery tray.
Torque: 6 N·m
f. Move the battery pressing plate to the installation
position, install and tighten the 2 fixing bolts connecting the battery pressing plate and the battery tray.
Torque: 10 N·m

2 Install air filter assembly.
3 Install the air filter intake pipe.
4 Connect the positive and negative cables of the battery.

`geely_coolray_en_a4fb46e3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1 Disconnect the positive and negative cables of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

### 2.11.6.4 Replacement of battery tray
`geely_coolray_en_5cebfc1a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Disconnect the positive and negative cables of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
2 Remove the battery. Refer to Replacement of battery
3 Remove the battery tray. a. Pry open the double-pipe clip A, and disconnect the lower floor ventilation pipe and lower floor oil supply pipe from the double-pipe clip A.
b. Disconnect the fixing clip B connecting the engine harness and the battery tray. c. Remove the 1 fixing bolt connecting the battery tray and the battery mounting bracket.
d. Remove the 1 fixing bolt 2 connecting the battery tray and the vehicle body.
e. Remove the 3 fixing bolts 3 connecting the battery tray and the left vibration isolator.
f. Remove the battery tray.

### 3.1.1.1 Warnings and precautions
`geely_coolray_en_87c225ab` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Warnings regarding battery disconnection

Warning！

Before maintaining any electrical components, the start and stop button must be in the power supply mode or OFF status, and all electrical loads must be “OFF” (switch off) unless otherwise stated in the operational program. If tools or equipment are easily accessible to exposed live electrical terminals, disconnect the negative battery cable. Violation of these safety instructions may result in personal injury and/or damage to the vehicle or vehicle components.

Warning regarding moving components and hot surfaces

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_d251b0aa` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Avoid contact with moving components and hot surface when working around a running engine to prevent persona injury.

Warning regarding goggles and gloves

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_b21df5dd` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Goggles and gloves must be worn when exhaust system components are removed, otherwise rust and sharp edges that fall from worn exhaust system components will cause serious personal injury.

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_abfdc850` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Road test should be conducted under the premise of ensuring safety and observing all traffic regulations. Do not try any operation that may endanger the control of the vehicle. Violating the above safety instructions can cause serious personal injury and damage the vehicle.

Fastener tightening notice

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_5675df36` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Please use the correct fastener tightening in the correct position, replace the fastener tightening with the correct part number, and the fastener tightening that need to be replaced or the fastener tightening that require lock glue or sealant are specially pointed out in the maintenance procedure. Paint, lubrication oil or corrosion inhibitor shall not be used on fastener tightening or on the joint surfaces of the fastener tightening unless otherwise described. In case these paints affect the torque and clamp force of the fastener tightening, they will damage the fastener tightening. When installing the fastener tightening, make sure to use correct tightening sequence and tightening torque to avoid damaging parts and systems.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_80133ee4` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Do not allow room temperature hardening sealant to enter the tapped blind hole. If the room temperature hardening sealant enters the tapped blind hole, the fastener tightening will produce hydraulic lock effect when tightened. Hydraulic lock of fastener tightening will cause damage to fastener tightening and/or other components. In addition, the correct clamp force will not be obtained when fasteners are tightened. Incorrect clamping force can prevent components from getting the correct seal, which can lead to leakage. Failure to tighten fastener tightening properly can cause components to come loose or separate, leading to serious engine damage.

### 3.2.2.1 Instructions and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_74ddda17` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

DCT is the abbreviation of Dual Clutch Transmission, which is translated as “双离合变速器” in Chinese. The vehicle is subjected to an advanced 7-speed wet dual clutch transmission.

Wet dual clutch means that the dual clutch is a multi-disc clutch that is coaxially installed in 2 groups, one large and one small. They are all installed in a closed oil chamber filled with hydraulic oil. The wet clutch structure provides better adjustment ability and an excellent hot melt and can transmit relatively large torque.

The working principle of dual clutch transmission is that one clutch corresponds to odd-numbered gears and the other clutch corresponds to even-numbered gears. When the vehicle is engaged in gear, the other clutch and the corresponding next gear are already in the standby state. As long as the previous gear of the dual clutch transmission (DCT) is disengaged, the next gear can be engaged immediately. Therefore, the gear shift speed of the transmission is faster than that of a normal automatic transmission or even a manual transmission, so that there is no interruption in the power output during the gear shift.

The drive shaft of DCT is divided into two, one is a solid drive shaft placed inside, and the other is a hollow drive shaft covered on the outside. The inner solid drive shaft connects 1, 3, 5, 7, and reverse, while the hollow outer drive shaft connects 2, 4, and 6 gears. Each of the two clutches is subject to the meshing action of a drive shaft.

In addition, although the interior of the dual clutch transmission is complicated, the actual volume and weight are smaller and lighter than the automatic transmission.

There are also a variety of driving modes of DCT, such as sports mode. With the help of an electronic program, the upshift of the mode is significantly slow and the downshift is faster, bringing a more dynamic driving style to the vehicle. Compared with the traditional manual transmission, DCT is more convenient to use and greatly improves the fuel economy of the vehicle. DCT is faster and smoother than a manual transmission, and the power output is uninterrupted. Based on the characteristics and operating modes of DCT, the DCT system can give the driver a feeling of driving a racing car. In addition, it eliminates the torque interruption of manual transmission when gears are shifted, making driving more agile and improving fuel economy.

### 3.2.3.1 System working principles
`geely_coolray_en_3a2fdaa5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

Transmission system

The transmission system includes an input shaft 1/2 assembly, an output shaft 1 assembly, an output shaft 2 assembly and a differential assembly.

Transmission system components:

1: input shaft 1/2 assembly
2: output shaft assembly
3: Reverse gear
4: 4 gear
5: 3 gear
6: gear
7: 7 gear
8: 5 gear
9: 6 gear
10: 2 gear
11: output shaft 2 assembly
12: differential assembly

![](images/a63b21e13f23d987cdf71dec2a129f9383afcba665f684e3141389fccea04769.webp)

Clutch System

The clutch system includes a wet double clutch, a clutch disengagement mechanism, and a hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator, and the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator contains a motor controller.

Clutch system components:

1. Wet dual clutch
2: Clutch disengagement mechanism
3. Hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator
4: hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator motor controller

![](images/dd8e5d082a9c2a2ede23f1af635f0ce596d5f88d37a104dd20d43a8203b22066.webp)

The transmission controller obtains the operation condition of the transmission and the complete vehicle through signals such as speed sensor and temperature sensor on the transmission, and signals such as accelerator opening and engine speed in CAN communication, and calculates the torque transmission demand of the wet dual clutch. Combined with the wet dual clutch control strategy, through CAN communication with the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator, send instructions to the motor controller (LCU) in the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator. After the motor controller (LCU) performs internal calculation according to the instructions, it drives the hydrostatic clutch to disengage the actuator motor and controls the internal actuator to adjust the oil pressure of the clutch disengagement mechanism, so as to realize the combination and disengagement of clutch 1/2 and complete the clutch control function.

### Gearshift System
`geely_coolray_en_f0e1a2f0` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

The gearshift system includes a gear shifting motor actuator, a gear shifting fork assembly, and a synchronizer assembly, and the gear shifting motor actuator includes a gear shifting motor and a gear shifting motor.

Gearshift system components:

1. Gear selector/shifter motor actuator assembly"

2: 4/R gear fork assembly
3: 1/3 gear fork assembly
4: 2/6 gear fork assembly
5: Gear selector shaft
6: 5/7 gear fork assembly
7: 2/5/6/7 shift shaft
8: 1/3/4/R shift shaft

![](images/34dffd7f4ab94cb094519fbc6538dc64999f124d3a7d47a0ecea91d5900a4819.webp)

![](images/03a51fa3c0102b413bdd9e6e8f2fe4c7572318d62dd5be25a6fc6ba581035a30.webp)

Lubrication oil circuit:

a.Transmission oil is first filtered by the suction filter and then enters the electronic oil pump.
b.Transmission oil enters the transmission oil cooler to cool down.
c. After cooling, the lubrication oil enters the oil pipe assembly.
d.Oil pipe assembly performs secondary filtration.
e.The low-temperature cleaning lubrication oil enters the wet dual clutch from the oil passage between the clutch disengagement mechanism and the input shaft.

The gearshift system judges the operation of the complete vehicle through the signals of each sensor and CAN communication. Combined with the gear shifting rule and parking rule of the control program, when gear shifting or other operations are required, the transmission control module sends instructions to realize the gear selecting and gear shifting action of the gear shifting index by driving the gear selector/shifter motor actuator, and completes the gear shift/parking function.

Lubricate the cooling system

The wet dual clutch generates heat during operation. It flows through the transmission oil in the wet dual clutch to cool the wet dual clutch. After the transmission oil is filtered and enters the electronic oil pump, then enters the transmission oil cooler, and flows through the oil cooler coolant to cool the transmission oil, so as to achieve the cooling effect of the wet dual clutch.

Cooling system components:

1: Suction filter
2. Electronic oil pump
3. Transmission oil cooler
4: Oil pipe assembly

The transmission controller adjusts the transmission oil flow rate in real time according to the current oil temperature, gear signal, gear shifting signal, etc., and the demand flow value fed back by the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator, so as to effectively improve the working conditions of all components of the transmission by controlling the speed of the electronic oil pump.

Parking system

Parking system components:

1: parking fork
2: return spring
3: locking device
4: actuating rod
5: parking signal pin
6: spring
7: parking pawl
8: parking ratchet
9: bullet head

![](images/93ca913f7e9f97720c9445fbc133b534be869f74690dded2f918edec86d883b8.webp)

Transmission automatic gear selection/parking function: By collecting the signals of each sensor and judging the operation condition of the complete vehicle through CAN communication, Combined with the gear shifting rule and parking rule of the control program, when gearshift/parking and other operations are required, the transmission controller sends an order to drive the gear selector/shifter motor actuator assembly to control the actuator to realize the gearselecting and gearshifting action, and complete the gear selection/parking function.

### Gearshift System
`geely_coolray_en_6e1508ae` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

Press down the P-gear button, and the gear selector/shifter actuator will perform the P-gear locking action. The springs on the parking actuator are compressed for energy storage, and the bullet head squeeze the pawl to stay in the ratchet. When the pawl directly rests in the ratchet slot, the wheel forces the differential and output two shafts to be directly locked by the ratchet and pawl, and realizes the parking function when the pawl stops in contact with the ratchet roof.

Press the P-gear unlocking button, and the gear selector/ shifter actuator will perform the P-gear locking release action, the actuator lever and bullet head will return to the neutral position, and the pawl will disengage from the ratchet wheel to realize the parking release function.

Electronic control system

Electronic control system components:

1: TCU: signal acquisition, information processing and control signal output.
2: Harness: connect various electronic control components to realize signal transmission.
3: Transmission oil temperature sensor: detect the transmission oil temperature.

4: Sensor module signal acquisition and control system: detect the speed of input shaft 1, input shaft 2 and output shaft 1/2.

5: Electronic oil pump: provide ubrication oil on demand.

6: Hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator: Execute and control the clutch disengagement mechanism to realize clutch disengagement and engagement action.

7: gear shifter/selector motor actuator: perform and operate gearshifting or gearselecting.

Electronic control principle

Sensor feedback signal function: DCT EVO 300 transmission is equipped with multiple sensors, including transmission oil temperature sensor, input shaft and output shaft speed sensor. The signals fed back by these sensors need to be processed before they can be recognized by the controller. Therefore, the first function of the controller is to process the feedback signal of the sensor.

Data exchange: The transmission controller realizes the communication with the data of the complete vehicle through the CAN bus, obtains the data such as engine speed, vehicle speed, throttle opening, etc., and understands the working conditions of the complete vehicle and the driver's intention, so as to realize the overall matching between the transmission and the complete vehicle.

### 3.2.7.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_91575d6c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Be familiar with system functions and operation procedures, and then start system diagnosis. This will help to confirm the correct fault diagnosis steps when a fault occurs. More importantly, it can also help to confirm whether the situation described by the customer belongs to normal operation and help to troubleshoot the faults rapidly.

When the transmission is abnormal, please go to the maintenance point designated by Geely for maintenance.

### 3.2.7.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_56b0c8f1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

Common faults of the transmission include: difficult gear shifting, gear stuck, gear collision and abnormal grinding, etc., but the fault of the clutch and drive system may also cause the above faults, so it is necessary to carefully analyze and distinguish them during the maintenance process.

Before maintenance, a general check of the transmission and clutch should be made:

Check whether the transmission and clutch pipeline seeps oil;

Check the transmission oil level, the viscosity and color of the transmission oil to see if it is dirty and whether there are metal particles, so as to initially judge whether the components in the transmission have been stuck and burned or the components have cracked;

– Check whether the transmission or parts, bolts and nuts around the transmission are obviously loose or falling of f.
Check for gear and road test to confirm the state of the vehicle when the fault occurs for further diagnosis.

Before repairing the abnormal noise of the transmission, it is necessary to separate the abnormal noise of the clutch, drive shaft, and engine, and also eliminate the abnormal noise and noise caused by external factors.

Before repairing the abnormal sound of the transmission, it is necessary to mark the following items:

Road running noise

Noise such as noise from tires, roads, wheel bearings, engines and exhaust systems may vary due to different vehicle size, type and sound insulation materials in the vehicle body.

– Drive Shaft System

As a mechanical device, the drive shaft system operates with some noise during normal operation. In order to confirm whether the noise is abnormal:

1. It is necessary to choose a good road surface to reduce noise caused by tire friction and body vibration;

2. Travel long enough to completely warm up the lubrication oil;

3. Record the vehicle speed and the gear of the transmission when the noise occurs;

4. Run the engine when the vehicle speed is zero, check if there is any abnormal noise;

5. Determine whether the vehicle makes noise when driving in the following situation:

– When accelerating slowly or suddenly;
– When driving with constant speed on a level road and with the throttle valve open;
– When sliding with the transmission in gear and the throttle closed.

Bearing noise

1. Differential gear or bearing noise

Differential side bearing noise and wheel bearing noise are easily confused. Due to the pretension of the differential side bearing, even if the wheels are off the road, as long as the differential and drive shaft are running, the noise of the differential side bearing will not be significantly reduced.

2. Wheel bearing noise

When the transmission is in neutral and the vehicle is taxiing, the wheel bearings will continue to roar or rub. Because there is no pretension force of the wheel bearing, the wheel bearing noise will be significantly reduced when the wheel is off the ground.

The inside of the bearing is worn and deformed, and the bearing retainer is compressed; small grinding particles enter the bearing and its retainer; or foreign objects enter the bearing and its retainer to lock it; the bearing and its retainer become loose due to wear; all of them will make noise or make the system unable to work.

### 3.2.7.5 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the starting switch to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

Caution

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic apparatus.

### 3.2.7.6 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 3.2.7.8 Action test table
`geely_coolray_en_7bfa88ff` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

By reading the “motion test” on the fault diagnostic apparatus, working statuses of the relay and the actuator controlled by 7DCT can be checked with no need to remove any part and component. Before diagnosing the related faults of the control system, the motion test is the prerequisite for troubleshooting, which can shorten the troubleshooting time.

### Note
`geely_coolray_en_3a2fd8db` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Data under normal condition is listed in the following table only for reference. Do not merely judge whether some part is faulty based on these reference values. Under normal conditions, a vehicle operating normally can be used to be compared with a vehicle being diagnosed in the same status to confirm whether the data of the vehicle being diagnosed is normal in current status.

a.Engine should be at normal operating temperature.
b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "OFF".
c.Connect the scan tool.
d.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

e.Select "7DCT"/"motion test".

f. Refer to the following table and conduct active test.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_7f3b08a2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Lubrication oil of different brands should not be mixed for use.

1 Lift the vehicle. Refer to Lifting and Jacking of Vehicle

2 Remove the bottom fender apron of the engine. Refer to Replacement of Engine Bottom Shield

3 Remove the oil drain bolt of the transmission and remove the oil drain bolt gasket 2.

4 Remove the transmission oil level pipe 3.

5 When the lubrication oil flows out of the transmission in a line and becomes drips, remove the drain bolt and remove the drain bolt gasket 2.

6 The lubrication oil here continuously flows out of the transmission in a line. The oil should be refilled in 15 minutes after the lubrication oil becomes drips.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_9f088eaa` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Oil cannot be reused.

Measure the quantity of discharged oil to guide the oil capacity of transmission oil when filling.

The oil will be collected and scrapped.

Refilling procedure

![](images/a00796bb3e856bba13830314ec8e27ad4b71fdfb48962307b083dcdc9191f72b.webp)

1 Insert the drain bolt washer into 2 drain bolt of the transmission, and install and tighten the drain bolt 1 of the transmission.

Torque: 40 N·m

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_371e2564` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

It cannot be reused. It is needed to replace with new parts after disassembly.

2 Mount and tighten the transmission oil level pipe.

Torque: 6N·m

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_804859b6` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

It cannot be reused. It is needed to replace with new parts after disassembly.

3 Use special tools to fill new dual clutch transmission oil.

Special tool: 4114870644

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_05a0b1a6` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

The refueling tool can still remain connected.

5 Depress the brake pedal, switch each gear for about 3 seconds, then put the gear selector lever back to the "P" gear.

Caution

The engine needs to keep running at idle speed, check the oil level and keep the transmission temperature at 35-45 °C.

6 Remove the refilling tool.

![](images/d77247361959387874b3506ce5c41aacb32d4108b080d098783a81c51ca69a27.webp)

7 Wait until no dual clutch transmission oil overflows from the oil drain bolt.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_0c4157c9` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If no transmission oil flows out, it must be refilled again.

8 Install the drain bolt.

Torque: 40 N·m

Caution

It cannot be reused. It is needed to replace with new parts after disassembly.

9 Install the engine bottom shield.
10 Lower the vehicle.

### 3.2.8.2 Hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator oil draining and filling procedure
`geely_coolray_en_287ad11f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

![](images/3bc0a6358262ac5eb4b566384e78ba4f13a041e4e50c10307f3498503cce6994.webp)

Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
2 Replacement of air filter assembly to be removed. Refer to Replacement of air filter assembly
3 Remove the air filter corrugated pipe. Refer to Replacement of air filter corrugated pipe
4 Disconnect the 2 fixing clips connecting the engine harness and the thermostat component.
5 Remove the bolts of oil filler of the two hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuators.
6 Drain the lubrication oil from the two hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuators respectively.

![](images/bf6ed141724c28fa9bf5002c65b65b4e00ad6b898b891e3f275d8f336ea820cb.webp)

1 Fill in lubrication oil through the oil fillers of the two hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuators respectively Caution

There are a total of two oil chambers marked with oil level scale lines, filling oil to the oil level lines.

The oil filling amount of Schaeffler is 115 ml ± 6 ml (each oil chamber).

The oil filling amount of Wodeer is:102 ml ± 6 ml (each oil chamber).

2 Install and tighten the bolts of the oil filler of the two hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuators.

Torque: 1.5 N m

3 Install the 2 fixing clips connecting the engine harness and the thermostat component.

4 Install air filter corrugated pipe.
5 Install the air filter assembly.
6 Connect the negative cable of battery.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_7f3b08a2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Lubrication oil of different brands should not be mixed for use.

1 Lift the vehicle. Refer to Lifting and Jacking of Vehicle

2 Remove the bottom fender apron of the engine. Refer to Replacement of Engine Bottom Shield

![](images/c6cc8b34b1058d9d01f1e506514032942f92b6a9bd0ce6fb050ed29b4c5bbcd7.webp)

3 Start the engine

4 Depress the brake pedal, switch and keep each gear for about 3 seconds, and then put the gear selector lever back to the "P" gear.
5 Remove the oil drain bolt.
6 At this time, a small amount of transmission oil should overflow from the oil drain bolt.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_c6c3f1bb` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

Oil cannot be reused.

Measure the quantity of discharged oil to guide the oil capacity of transmission oil when filling.

The oil will be collected and scrapped.

7 Use special tools to add new dual clutch transmission oil. Special tool: 4114870644

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_adc75f25` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The refueling tool can still remain connected.

9 Depress the brake pedal, switch and keep each gear for about 3 seconds, and then put the gear selector lever back to the "P" gear.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_7415c64f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

The engine needs to keep running at idle speed, and when checking the oil level, the transmission oil temperature should be within 35-45 °C.

![](images/96803d83509ffe9f75c09aa2f1322955d6f827a86d005e568e31b7142dec815f.webp)

10 Remove the refueling tool.

11 Wait until no dual clutch transmission oil overflows from the oil drain bolt.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_bed8c590` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If no transmission oil flows out, it must be refilled again.

12 Install the oil drain bolt. Torque: 40 N·m

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_9f7c00cc` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

It cannot be reused. It is needed to replace with new parts after disassembly.

13 Install the engine bottom shield.

14 Lower the vehicle.

### 3.2.8.4 Replacement of transmission control unit (TCU)
`geely_coolray_en_560b1e06` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Open the engine compartment cover.
2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
3 To lift a vehicle, please refer to Lifting and Jacking of Vehicle Remove the engine bottom shield, refer to Replacement of engine bottom shield
5 Remove the transmission control unit a. Disconnect the transmission control unit harness connector.

![](images/c21fc58b456542000cd56c1765d9a89ed7ad79b24d8093e59147d9b4287c9869.webp)

b. Remove the 4 fixing bolts connecting the transmission control module and the automatic transmission assembly. c. Take off the transmission control unit.

![](images/657aa840d781d6a84a1f8cf989ca94e278054f13e6f83d86ad652a954d13ef9c.webp)

1 Install the transmission control unit a. Install and tighten the 4 fixing bolts connecting the transmission control module and the automatic transmission assembly. Torque: 20N·m

b. Connect the transmission control unit harness connector.

2 Install the engine bottom shield.
3 Lower the vehicle
4 Connect the negative cable of battery
5 Close engine compartment cover
6 Use the diagnostic instrument for self-learning. Refer to
7DTC controller matching after replacement

### 3.2.8.5 Replacement of electric oil pump
`geely_coolray_en_560b1e06` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Open the engine compartment cover.
2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
3 To lift a vehicle, please refer to Lifting and Jacking of Vehicle Remove the engine bottom shield, refer to Replacement of engine bottom shield

![](images/992c2ede2d41500d30c9eaf6ac33f15ccf748a37a2d6c85350847790a251c419.webp)

### 5 Remove the electronic oil pump
`geely_coolray_en_be56bf5a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

a. Disconnect the electronic oil pump harness connector.

b. Remove the 2 fixing screws of the electronic oil pump, remove the two O-rings of the electronic oil pump, and remove the electronic oil pump.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_982a3d34` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Transmission oils may flow from the inlet and outlet of the housing when the electric oil pump is taken down. It is needed to collect such oils with containers prepared in advance.

Record the amount of oil spilled used to guide refueling.

Installation procedure

![](images/6001b20da9ff0d71fc43c9323e4806626f6d417e43484213a8374b9efe6f54af.webp)

1 Install the electronic oil pump a. Install and tighten the 2 fixing screws of the electronic oil pump.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_2a029ef1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The O ring and fixing screw of the electronic oil pump cannot be reused. It is needed to replace with new parts after disassembly.

b. Connect the electronic oil pump harness connector.

2 Install the engine bottom shield.
3 Lower the vehicle
4 Connect the negative cable of battery
5 Close engine compartment cover
6 Refill transmission oil. Refer to Transmission oil level
check procedure

### 3.2.8.6 Replacement of hydrostatic clutch release actuator
`geely_coolray_en_0e16b2ac` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Disconnect the negative cable of battery.
2 Remove the air filter assembly, refer to Replacement of air filter assembly
3 Remove the corrugated pipe of the air filter. Refer to Replacement of corrugated pipe of air filter
4 Remove the battery tray. Refer to Replacement of battery tray
5 Remove the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator a. Disconnect the 1 harness connector A connecting the transmission harness and the rotating speed sensor (output).
b. Disconnect the 1 harness connector B connecting the transmission harness and the rotating speed sensor. c. Disengage the 2 fixing clips C connecting the
transmission harness and the automatic transmission assembly. d. Disconnect the 1 harness connector A connecting the transmission harness and the hydrostatic clutch
disengagement actuator.
e. Disconnect the 1 harness connector B connecting the transmission harness and the hydrostatic clutch
disengagement actuator.
f. Disengage the fixing clip C connecting the
transmission harness and the automatic transmission assembly.
g. Remove the fixing bolt 1 connecting the ground wire harness and the automatic transmission assembly.

![](images/dfb8ece1423bc839688ed3c2a37ba1aa63589e2897486e2e40fe3f61caa92b3a.webp)

h. Disengage the oil return hose assembly of hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator from the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator.

![](images/02858ff29c2fa296bde2d63bbb66aa6d89bacba6e6d3e926a27efd76f9375ac8.webp)

Disengage the ventilation hose from the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator.

j. Remove the 4 fixing bolts connecting the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator and the automatic transmission assembly in the sequence shown in figure, and place the transmission harness aside. k. Remove the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_d421db3d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

When removing and installing the hydrostatic clutch release actuator, the aluminum shell should be used as the holding point during handling. It is forbidden to hold the metal tube when handling.

After the hydrostatic clutch release actuator is removed, protect the mating surfaces of the hydrostatic clutch release actuator and the housing to ensure that the surroundings are clean, so as to ensure the cleanliness of the transmission.

After the hydrostatic clutch release actuator is removed, drain the transmission oil by standing still for about 10 minutes.

Installation procedure

![](images/4982982b23edc0b72d32e71f966c6c5982dc5a094e347569f23a54a7cd252fe1.webp)

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_5ba0b964` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

The hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator C1/ C2 joint cannot be reused. It is needed to replace with new parts after disassembly.

b. Install and tighten the 4 fixing bolts connecting the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator and the automatic transmission assembly in the sequence shown in the figure.

Torque:

First time: 3N·m (pre-tensioner)

Second time: 25N·m

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_759cdcdc` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

The fixing bolts of the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator cannot be reused. It is needed to replace with new parts after disassembly.

Confirm that there is no gap on the mating surface between hydrostatic clutch release actuator and the automatic transmission housing.

Hydrostatic clutch release actuator fixing bolts need to be cross-pretightened before tightening.

Confirm that all harness brackets are installed without missing.

Check the oil level in the hydrostatic clutch release actuator and add the missing oil. Refer to Fluid Draining and Filling Procedures of Hydrostatic Clutch Release Actuator

![](images/51b04f0c0d8dfe7102800c90607f209b99a2ce801fb3cbdfe22ab140033400d4.webp)

c. Connect the ventilation hose with the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator.

d. Connect the oil return hose assembly of hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator and the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator.

e. Install and tighten the 1 fixing bolt 1 connecting the ground wire harness and the automatic transmission assembly.

Torque: 10 N m

f. Install the fixing clip C connecting the transmission harness and the automatic transmission assembly. g. Connect the 1 harness connector B connecting the transmission harness and the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_f1409a71` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.

h. Connect the 1 harness connector A connecting the transmission harness and the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_2be2ebae` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug in, second make sounds and third make confirmations”.

![](images/7743a49cdff52caea14e782ebf7d47a09d04439b7aa0da9cb923c67cf4e0f318.webp)

i. Install the 2 fixing clips C connecting the transmission harness and the automatic transmission assembly. j. Connect the harness connector B connecting the transmission harness and the rotation speed sensor(input shaft 2).

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_919835a6` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”. k. Connect the harness connector A connecting the transmission harness and the rotation speed sensor (output).

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_f1e79c4f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.

2 Install the battery tray.
3 Install air filter corrugated pipe.
4 Install the air filter assembly.
5 Connect the negative cable of battery.
6 Use the diagnostic instrument to reset the hydrostatic clutch release actuator. Refer to Replacement of transmission assembly

### 3.2.8.7 Replacement of gear selector motor actuator
`geely_coolray_en_8129756f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Open the engine compartment cover.
2 Remove the engine left shield assembly, refer to Replacement of engine side shield
3 Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable To remove the air filter assembly, please refer to Replacement of Air Filter Assembly
5 Remove the gear selector motor actuator a. Remove the transmission harness bracket fixing nut 1. b. Remove the transmission harness bracket fixing bolt 2,
and move the transmission harness and bracket aside.

![](images/d744d9b7583432328f4dc1fdc0ed75d7d190e85483579fdd7c2eac88438c20c1.webp)

c. Disconnect 2 harness connectors of the gear selector motor actuator. d. Remove the 3 fixing bolts 2 of the gear selector motor actuator, and take down the gear selector motor actuator.

Installation procedure

![](images/da7883fc0c4896ae8dfa80e50933708e65b894c6f52aa317a2a6ec7a301cc94e.webp)

1 To install the gear selector motor actuator, a. Install and tighten the 3 fixing bolts 2 of the gear selector motor actuator. Torque:25 N·m (metric) 18.4 lb-ft (imperial system) b. Connect 2 harness connectors 1 of the gear selector motor actuator harness connector 1.

c. Install and tighten the transmission harness bracket fixing bolt 2.
Torque: 20 N·m
d. Install and tighten the transmission harness bracket fixing nut 1.
Torque: 20 N·m
2 Install the air filter assembly
3 Connect the negative cable of battery
4 Install the engine left shield assembly
5 Close the engine compartment hood
6 Program the gear shifter motor control module, please refer to Replacement of gear selector/shifter motor actuator assembly

3.2.8.9 Replacement of breather hose Removal procedure

Open the engine hood

Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery

Cable

Caution

3 Lift the vehicle

### 3.2.8.10 Water inlet pipe of transmission oil cooler
`geely_coolray_en_5106c468` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

### 3.2.8.11 Replacement of transmission oil cooler
`geely_coolray_en_6820e756` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
2 Remove the air filter assembly. Refer to Replacement of Air Filter Assembly
3 Lift the vehicle. Refer to Lifting and Jacking of Vehicle
4 Remove the bottom fender apron of the engine. Refer to Replacement of Engine Bottom Shield
5 Remove the air outlet pipe of intercooler. Refer to Replacement of Air Outlet Pipe of Intercooler
6 Drain the engine coolant. Refer to Discharge and Filling of Engine Coolant
7 Disconnect the harness connector A connecting the transmission harness and the gear selector/shifter motor actuator assembly.
8 Disconnect the harness connector B connecting the transmission harness and the transmission oil temperature sensor.
9 Remove the fixing bolt 7 connecting the ground wire harness with the automatic transmission assembly.
10 Remove the 2 fixing bolts 2 connecting the transmission harness with the automatic transmission assembly, and move the transmission harness aside.
11 Loosen the 1 fixing clamp 1 connecting the transmission oil cooler water inlet hose with the transmission oil cooler, and disconnect the transmission oil cooler water inlet hose from the transmission oil cooler.
12 Loosen the 1 fixing clamp 2 connecting the water outlet hose of the radiator with the transmission oil cooler, and disconnect the water outlet hose of the radiator from the transmission oil cooler.

![](images/aa2818f186b3f40f82e5fe3bc796682f06edf32461eab8c73100bad8a2781ddc.webp)

13 Remove the 4 fixing bolts connecting the transmission oil cooler with the automatic transmission assembly in the order shown in figure, and take down the transmission oil cooler.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_f69b2ac1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The transmission oil may flow out when the oil cooler is taken down. It is needed to collect the transmission oil with containers prepared in advance.

Record the amount of oil spilled used to guide refueling.

### Installation procedure
`geely_coolray_en_740e0fc2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

![](images/3008a89c01dc2a0576aa8ec60a040819ec19416162b534383eddd8e922925a39.webp)

![](images/3d81250240cfe7b34ab9f59d4fb2963149d2b6cb3b9a8f07615f2dfe326ea86b.webp)

1 Install and tighten the transmission oil cooler, and install and tighten the 4 bolts connecting the transmission oil cooler with the automatic transmission assembly.

Torque:

First time: 3N·m (pre-tensioner)

Second: 10N·m

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_33f7019c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The O-ring of oil cooler assembly is a disposable and vulnerable part and must be replaced with a new one after removal.

The fixing bolts of oil cooler assembly are disposable and vulnerable parts and must be replaced with new fixing bolts.

Oil cooler assembly fixing bolts should be crosstightened before tightening.

2 Connect the water outlet hose of the radiator with the transmission oil cooler, and install the fixing clamp 2 connecting the water outlet hose of the radiator with the transmission oil cooler.
3 Connect the water inlet hose of transmission oil cooler with the transmission oil cooler, and install the fixing clamp 1 connecting the water inlet hose of transmission oil cooler with the transmission oil cooler.
4 Move the transmission harness to the installation position, install and tighten the 2 fixing bolts 2 connecting the transmission harness with the automatic transmission assembly. Torque: 10 N m
5 Install and tighten the fixing bolt 1 connecting the ground wire harness and the automatic transmission assembly. Torque: 10 N m
6 Connect the 1 harness connector B connecting the transmission harness with the transmission oil temperature sensor.

![](images/19593e2248350018cc9df2029110509f45a0a015f6cfe471a6798f3621fad2d4.webp)

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_46ac3849` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”. 7 Connect the 1 harness connector A connecting the transmission harness and the gear selector/shifter motor actuator assembly.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_1e8180ea` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.
8 Install the air outlet pipe of intercooler.
9 Install the engine bottom shield.

assembly.

e. Remove the clamp fixing bolt connecting the threeway catalytic converter with the turbo charger subassembly.

m. Disconnect the T harness connector A of the crankshaft position sensor. n. Remove the fixing bolt 1 connecting the crankshaft position sensor and the automatic transmission assembly. o. Take off the crankshaft position sensor.

q. Remove the 2 fixing bolts connecting the lower end of the automatic transmission assembly and the engine assembly.

r. Remove the 4 fixing bolts connecting the rear end of the automatic transmission assembly and the engine assembly.

4 Install the battery assembly.

6 Install the air filter intake pipe
Install the air filter outlet hose

![](images/022c2ff5b469d4a64f49ca84ef83f0d513d976533bc7b620f54519da82f8828c.webp)

3 Use the non-woven fabrics to clear up the foreign matters and dirt in the clutch housing, and then use a highpressure blow gun to blow out the foreign matters in the clutch housing.

`geely_coolray_en_03d46983` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

![](images/a577e0a0eaf43e695bfd8fe8272a6c9f4a797baac7febe04f165f8a11d3383bb.webp)

4 Remove the 3 fixing bolts of the clutch end cover in the order shown in the figure.

`geely_coolray_en_14776357` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

When removing the bolts, each bolt needs to be removed in two steps; first, loosen the bolts in half according to the shown sequence, and then completely remove the bolts according to the shown sequence.

5 Wrap the straight screwdriver head with the non-woven fabric and pry open the clutch end cover of the transmission (as indicated by the arrow).

Caution

Do not damage the component during operation.

6 Remove the O-ring.

![](images/beccd591917e74976d4bb732e412a81bc419e850bbbd1628412b9fa4b03882a5.webp)

Installation procedure

![](images/2f52a72fe8616a8f53cfb8c6be77ad74e9745545c2a7f981617812a6a6018e09.webp)

![](images/347df7d5847d1fa1600ffa3cbbde9a337bac70124a1ca9c05a57d032b1b46bca.webp)

1 Clean the mounting slot with the non-woven fabrics, apply transmission oil to the O-ring, and install the O-ring into the mounting slot of the clutch end cover.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_02739e1e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The O ring cannot be reused. It is needed to replace with new parts after disassembly.

After cleaning, check that the mounting slots must be free from impurities such as hairs and iron scraps.

Visually check whether the O-ring is intact, especially for the trimming and twists.

The missing of the O-ring may cause oil leakage after the installation of the wet dual clutch assembly.

2 Clean the red circle area with the non-woven fabrics.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_9551817f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The red circle area includes: O-ring installation position, oil seal installation position, and tooling surface.

The red circle area must be clean; otherwise it may cause oil leakage.

3 When installing the clutch cover, the arrow points in the direction of the hydrostatic clutch disengagement actuator.

4 Install the clutch cover plate installation auxiliary tool(for the part of the protective bush). Clutch cover installation auxiliary tool: 4114870606

![](images/52fca6c5a54b24369fcf39424add5ce9f3b778ddfebfed1e209a44056b00dbe5.webp)

![](images/4d51ccbdec694a8332905e8e4a923b380d4396d6b0d9a73a11245441f0c1d090.webp)

5 Place the clutch cover installation auxiliary tool 1 and install the clutch cover.

Clutch cover installation auxiliary tool: 4114870606

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_163c5e5f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Mount the clutch end cover and notice the clutch end cover oil seal.

Place the clutch cover installation auxiliary tool stably (for the part of pressure plate), and gently knock the part 2 area in the red circle of the clutch cover installation auxiliary tool with a rubber hammer to make it bear the force evenly.

![](images/2fb1f2d9b01233a33186cfac9dba4a23301b64d3f0d1f77f687e28afa8b24c51.webp)

![](images/311115d18794df82cdac6dfab6b0df3c629b850f9b30b18c50e42b524e178aa1.webp)

6 Install the 3 new tightening bolts on the clutch end cover respectively, tighten the bolts in the order shown in the figure, and use a torque wrench to test whether the bolts are tightened.

Torque: 10 N m

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_01ee745a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

The bolts of the clutch end cover cannot be reused. It is needed to replace with new parts after disassembly.

Bolts are tightened in three steps:

Step I: Install the new tightening bolts in turn, and manually pre-tighten each bolt by 2-3 threads.

Step II: Pre-tighten each bolt in accordance with the tightening sequence, and tighten more than half of the thread profiles.

– Use a torque wrench to recheck the torque of each bolt. The recheck sequence is:1 – 2 – 3 – 1.

After installation of the clutch end cover, use a painting pen to spot check the marks on the 3 bolts.

7 Check whether the wet dual clutch transmission assembly leaks oil.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_52117e35` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

Add the oil liquid from the transmission, use new non-woven fabrics to remove the oil stains in the housing, turn the mating surface between the automatic gearbox assembly and the engine downwards, and wait for no less than 30 minutes. Turn the automatic gearbox assembly upwards and check with new non-woven fabrics there is no leakage around the wet dual clutch assembly for a week.

8 Mount the automatic gearbox assembly.

Removal procedure

1 Adjust the transmission gear to N.

`geely_coolray_en_77ab9014` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

Removal of the clutch cannot be completed in nonneutral mode.

2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

![](images/2c9496ee6690fb91e86735df8ed858dbf75b1059156e879d37434edae93effa9.webp)

5 Manually align the inner housing of the inner clutch and the outer clutch with the pin holes of the drive disc. Use the dual clutch installation auxiliary tool to remove the wet dual clutch assembly counterclockwise.

Dual clutch installation auxiliary tools: 4114870604

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_4c1dee82` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Dual clutch installation auxiliary tool assembly standard: the clearance between the aligned rear fixture and the clutch is minimized, and the fixture mark (red line) is flat with the outer end face of the drive plate.

The removal rotation speed should not be higher than 30 rpm, and it shall be stable without vibration.

Take off the dual clutch installation auxiliary tool after 10-15 turns.

![](images/9d858d1195690f27f85a7506882f93d20e74ca1db95f10299dca7de01e9ef596.webp)

6 Take down wet dual clutch vertically and slowly.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_ababeb77` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Do not bump other parts during the lifting process.

After the wet dual clutch is lifted out of the clutch housing installation chamber, the clutch disengagement actuator gasket and disengagement bearing may adhere to the mating surface of the clutch.

3. Notes for wet dual clutch handling mode: When moving the wet dual clutch, it is forbidden to directly hold the edges on both sides of the wet dual clutch, the wet dual clutch should be supported from below.

The wet dual clutch cannot be disassembled.

7 Take off the clutch C1 disengagement bearing and clutch C2 disengagement bearing.

8 Take off the clutch release actuator adjusting gaskets C1 and C2.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_edc3569e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The one with larger diameter is C1 and the one with smaller diameter is C2. 9 Use the cover plate to block the removed part of the transmission to prevent foreign matters or water from entering the transmission.

`geely_coolray_en_644a1c21` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

![](images/469cfa70057f13c3e41b35522d7b1f1aad6b14a5d87c44eff9e9d9bfb6cc225e.webp)

![](images/32886c396a7ee77f9177cccc76eb87b163c3b8581d79de45f122b5f3c415cd6b.webp)

### 4.2.2.1 Instructions and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_f76ea5ed` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:suspension | p:1

The function of front suspension system of the vehicle is to maximize the friction between tyres and roads in order to provide good directional control ability and stability, thus ensuring the comfort level of customer. It can absorb the energy of vertical acceleration wheels to free the frame and body from interruption while the wheels bounce up and down with the road. The front suspension mainly consists of bearing unit and moving unit which can support vertical force and twisting force. Absorber can quicken the reduction of vibration; coil spring can support and transfer vertical load to diminish the shock of the road. The front suspension of this model is independent suspension with MacPherson stabilizer bar, which is composed of the following components: swing arm assembly, front strut assembly, front subframe assembly and front stabilizer bar device. The front strut assembly is the key component of the suspension system that integrates the functions of shock absorbing, damping, guiding, and locating. The lower end of the front strut spring is installed on the spring plate of the shock absorber assembly, the lower part is connected with the steering knuckle, and the upper part is connected with the vehicle body by bolt and nut fasteners. The front subframe assembly is mainly the main bearing component of the front suspension. The welding assembly of the front subframe is made of steel sheet stamping and welding, and is fixed to the vehicle body through connecting bolts. The front stabilizer bar device mainly improves the roll rigidity of the vehicle, prevents excessive lateral roll of the body when turning, and improves the driving comfort of the vehicle. The front stabilizer bar assembly is fixed on the subframe through the stabilizer bar bushing and the stabilizer bar fixing clamp; and both ends of the stabilizer bar are connected with the front strut assembly through the front stabilizer bar connecting rod assembly.

### 4.2.3.1 Suspension system terminology
`geely_coolray_en_dae0f6a5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

1. Sprung load

The sprung load refers to the weight of the vehicle supported by the spring.

– The sprung load should be greater than the non-sprung load to obtain normal handling performance.

Some examples of sprung load:

1. Body and frame
2. Load or cargo
3. Fuel tank

The sprung parts include:

1. Frame (including subframe)

2. Body (including integral body)

3. Power system (engine, transmission)

4. Steering gear

2. Non-sprung load Non-sprung load refers to vehicle weight that is not
supported by springs. Non-sprung load should be as small as possible to
ensure normal handling and drive comfort. Suspension response is good if non-sprung load is light.

Some examples of non-sprung load:

1. Wheels and tires
2. Wheel bearings and hubs
3. Axles and steering knuckles
4. Brake components (components on wheels)
3. Parts between the sprung load and the non-sprung load
Wheels/tires, ball joint, bearings, control arms, etc.
Stabilizer bars, control bars, etc.
Steering knuckles, brakes, etc.

### 4.2.3.2 Operating principle of suspension system components
`geely_coolray_en_decc78df` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

Spring:

The rigidity of spring will affect the response of the sprung mass when the vehicle is running. The vehicle with a small spring rigidity can eliminate turbulence and provide a very smooth driving feeling, but at the same time, it is prone to dive and squat during braking and accelerating, and prone to roll and tumble when turning. Vehicles with excessive spring rigidity have less stability on bumpy roads, but its body moves very little, which means they can be driven fast even when turning. Although the spring itself may look simple, by designing and implementing these devices in the automobile, and balancing the passenger’s comfort with the handling performance of the automobile, the spring alone cannot provide an extremely smooth ride. Because springs are excellent at absorbing energy but less so in terms of dissipation capacity. Therefore, the suspension system requires a kind of component called shock absorber. Without a damper structure, the spring will bounce off at an uncontrollable rate and release the jolting energy it absorbs, continuing to bounce off at its frequency until it has exhausted all the energy originally applied to it. The suspension, built on a spring, will itself allow the automobile to drive in a bouncing manner without being controlled.

Shock absorber

![](images/475bd8e23088060cfee2325dc3f8b9ed0e9ae79bd981366e224610caa8368f23.webp)

1. Piston push rod
2. Inner cylinder
3. Outer cylinder
4. Hydraulic chamber
5. Piston and valve
6. Fluid reservoir
7. Inner cylinder bottom valve

It controls the unwanted spring motion through a process called damping. Shock absorbers slow and reduce the magnitude of vibratory motion by converting the kinetic energy of suspension motion to heat energy that can be dissipated through hydraulic fluid. The upper support of the shock absorber is connected to the frame (namely sprung mass), and the lower support is connected to the shaft near the wheel (namely non-sprung mass). In double-cylinder design, one of the most common types of the shock absorber is the upper support connected to the piston rod, and the piston rod is connected to the piston, which is located in a cylinder filled with hydraulic oil. The inner cylinder is called pressure cylinder and the outer cylinder is called oil reservoir cylinder. The oil reservoir cylinder stores the excess hydraulic oil. When the wheel hits a bumpy road and causes spring compacts and stretches, the energy of spring is transferred to the shock absorber via the upper support and down to the piston via the piston rod. The piston has punched holes, through which hydraulic oil can leak out as the piston moves up and down in the pressure cylinder. Because these holes are so tiny that only very little hydraulic oil can pass through them under great pressure. This slows down the piston motion, thus slows down the spring. The operation of the shock absorber consists of two cycles the compression cycle and the extension cycle. The compression cycle refers to compress the hydraulic oil below the piston when it moves downward. Extension cycle refers to the hydraulic oil above the piston as it moves upwards to the top of the pressure tank. For a typical automobile, the resistance of the extension cycle is greater than the resistance of the compression cycle. It should also be noticed that the compression cycle controls the movement of the unsprung mass of a vehicle, while the extension cycle controls the movement of the sprung mass which is relatively heavier. All modern shock absorbers have speed-sensing feature. The faster the suspension moves, the more resistance the shock absorber provides. It allows the shock absorber to adjust to road conditions and control any undesired movement that might occur in a moving vehicle, including bouncing, rolling, braking, diving, and accelerating into a crouch.

### 4.2.3.2 Operating principle of suspension system components
`geely_coolray_en_d9c6bdf9` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

Stabilizer bar:

Used in conjunction with shock absorbers to provide additional stability to a moving automobile. The stabilizer bar is a metal rod that spans the entire vehicle shaft, which effectively connects the two sides of the suspension. As the suspension on one wheel moves up and down, the stabilizer bar will transmit the movement to the other wheels. This can make the ride smoother and reduce the inclination of the vehicle. In particular, it can offset the rollover tendency of the automobile on the suspension when turning.

### 4.2.7.1 Replacement of lower control arm assembly
`geely_coolray_en_e42b1707` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Lift the vehicle, please refer to Lifting and jacking of vehicle
2 Remove the wheels, please refer to Replacement of wheels
3 Remove the lower swing arm assembly a. Remove the nut securing the lower control arm ball joint to the steering knuckle .Use the special tool to disconnect the lower swing arm assembly. Tool: 4114720160

![](images/86c55eb5c3c0119d6c34a0e84301093368172094f5fe31cede1dee3c699640d1.webp)

b. Remove lower swing arm and front fixing bolt of front subframe

c. Remove rear fixing bolt and nut of the lower swing arm and the front subframe.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_57de592f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

While removing the rear fixing bolt and nut, use a spanner to fix nuts to prevent them from rotating.

d. Remove the lower control arm assembly from the front subframe.

Caution

Removal methods of left and right lower control arm assembly are similar.

### Installation procedure
`geely_coolray_en_065df82d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

![](images/561c1feb7f04032937414883f196d48cc085448d7846eff39e2a2032fcb93d54.webp)

1 Install lower swing arm assembly

a. Assemble the lower swing arm assembly to the front subframe, install and tighten the lower swing arm and rear fixing bolts and nuts of the front subframe.

Torque: First: 150 N·m Second: 60°

b. Install and tighten the front fixing bolts between the lower swing arm and the front subframe.

Torque: First: 150 N·m Second: 90°

c. Install and tighten the fixing nut connecting the lower swing arm ball joint and the steering knuckle.

Torque: 100N·m

Warning！

Two people are required during removal and installation, and it is necessary to keep safe and not get injured.

2 Install wheels
3 Lower the vehicle on the ground

b. Disconnect the 3 fixing sheathes connecting the left front wheel speed sensor harness and the left front shock absorber.

### 4.3.2.1 Instructions and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_b8c6516c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:suspension | p:1

Rear suspension and front suspension together provide the vehicle with excellent stability, operability and comfort. The main bearing parts and moving parts of the rear suspension can bear vertical and torsional forces, and enhance the antiroll ability of the rear suspension device and the anti-nod ability of the whole vehicle. Shock absorbers accelerate the weakening of vibration. Coil springs bear and transmit vertical loads to reduce the impact of road surface.

The rear suspension of this model adopts torsion beam type suspension, which includes: two shock absorbers, two coil springs, the rear torsion beam and two rubber bushings. The axle support assembly is connected to the underbody through a rubber bushing located on the front side of each control arm. The axle structure maintains the relationship between the wheels and the body, and balances the up and down jumps of the left and right wheels through a torsion beam to reduce the shaking of the vehicle and keep the vehicle stable.

### 4.3.4.1 Part Position
`geely_coolray_en_90998402` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

![](images/1c2090eb1f3017a64b3e698d62e083bc55822abd8deec826d7cbba3058edfeb1.webp)

1. Rear axle assembly

### 4.4.2.1 Tie structure
`geely_coolray_en_a4247d22` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

![](images/a05e7b2e6529baf352897d874a8663fdd1f7de5febdab523e97c36b19b5ab528.webp)

1. Tread

a. The part of the tyre in contact with the road allows driving, braking and other functions through friction. It should have good wear resistance, puncture resistance, impact resistance, heat dissipation and other performance.

2. Carcass

a. Ply of tyre, and main load-bearing part, it has impact resistance and should have good flexural resistance while driving.

3. Belt

a. A Steel wire ply between tread and carcass, it is intended to protect the carcass, inhibit tread deformation, maintain tread contact with the ground, and improve wear resistance and driving stability.

4. Cap ply

a. A special ply above the belt, it is intended to restrain the movement of the belt while the tyre is running, prevent the belt from detaching at high speeds and maintain stability of tyre size at high speeds.

5. Bead

a. Hanging rubber wire wrapped to a certain shape (four corners or hexagonal shape), used to attach the tyre to the rim to fix the tyre.

6. Triangle strips

a. The filling material on top of the bead in a tyre to prevent bead dispersion, slow bead impact, and protect the bead from air ingress during molding.

7. Inner liner

a. Part to maintain air tightness of tyre without tyre tube, made of special rubber and can perform the function of a tyre tube.

### 4.4.2.2 Meaning and pressure instructions of tire side identifications of tires
`geely_coolray_en_436441f4` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

Meanings of tire side identifications of tires

For example: 205/55R1691V

205― Nominal cross-section width (unit: mm)

55― Flat rate (depth-width ratio: %)

R― Radial structure (unit: in)

16― Nominal diameter of the road wheel (unit: in)

91― Load index

V― Speed rating (240km/h)

Table of Common Speed Ratings:

![](images/36d2dd6bab8b03e52eca3e99273eed233e4b675bd735a42e2e6b8f474d87d568.webp)

Pressure instructions of tires

Tire pressures have a decisive influence on wear, fault, and damage of tires, thus, the normal pressure must be maintained and the pressure must be checked regularly to drive safely.

Load capacity of tires corresponds to the inflation pressure. The reasonable pressure of the tire must be determined by the load condition of the tire. Changes in climates and seasons should not be reasons for tire pressure adjustments.

At the beginning of the use of a new tire, the overall dimension of the tire will be changed for the heating of the yield movement and the tire pressure will be reduced. It is needed to check and adjust the pressure after 24 hours of use or driving for 2,000-3,000km.

– The tire pressure should be increased by 10%-15% when driving at a high speed for a long time.

1. Harm of insufficient pressure

The insufficient pressure will lead to the aggravation of the tire side deformation and the increase of heat production, which will greatly reduce the tire life and bring the following problems and safety risks:

a.The tire shoulder position is excessively worn.
b.Increase the possibility of tire bump and bulge.
c.Delamination is caused by the decrease of adhesive force between various parts of the tire.
d.Severely insufficient pressure leads to tire side rolling damages.
e.Too large tire hops cause the abnormal worn between the bead and the road rim and damage the road rim.
f. Rolling resistance increases and fuel consumption increases.
2. Harm of the excessive pressure

The excessive pressure will reduce the tread grounding area, increase the tire rigidness, and reduce the buffering effect, and will bring the following problems and safety risks:

a.The tread center is excessively worn.
b.Increases the risk that the tire broken or even burst when impacted by the external force.
c. The reduced grounding area leads to reduced steering and controlling performance and risks of drifting and glissades will occur.
d.Riding comfort is decreased.
e.Poor riding performance and the long-term driving at the excessive pressure are prone to cause damage to the vehicle chassis
3. Uneven tire pressures at the same suspension can
cause
a.The brake force is uneven from left to right.
b.The steering is running deviation.
c.The steering and controlling performance are decreased.
d.The deviation at speed up.
e.The vehicle is running deviation when driving.
