### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_dd203f70` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When the steering wheel turns, the noise from the engine compartment may be heard, especially in the low-speed conditions, for example, starting the vehicle on the parking lot. In this case, it is not a fault, but a normal phenomenon. Steering or starting the operation at a low speed is a relatively huge load to the steering system. Therefore, a certain noise will be produced.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_582d97ce` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Power steering of the vehicle is controlled by the electric power steering control module. Before connecting or disconnecting the electric power steering control module harness connectors, the start and stop button must be placed in the OFF position and the battery grounding cable must be disconnected.

### General
`geely_coolray_en_d56a95e7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The function of the steering system is to make the vehicle control the driving direction according to the driver's intention. The electric power steering system is developed on the basis of traditional mechanical steering systems. It uses the power generated by electric motors to help the driver steer, so that the turning of the vehicle is light and flexible when driving at low speed, and the turning is stable and reliable when driving at high speed.

Main structures

Electric power steering system is mainly composed of steering-angle sensor, electric motor and electronic control unit.

Main part and component functions

Steering- angle sensor: convert the angle and speed of the driver turning the steering wheel into an electrical signal and send it to the EPS control unit.

Motor: receive the signal from the EPS control unit and generate the corresponding torque according to the signal.

EPS control unit: calculate the assistance current according to the rotation angle, vehicle speed and other relevant input signals, and output a control signal to the motor.

Instrument cluster: display warning message and warn the driver when detecting EPS system fault.

### 7.2.3.1 System working principles
`geely_coolray_en_4acc3752` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When the driver steers by operating the steering wheel, the steering wheel angle sensor detects the steering of the steering wheel and sends the voltage signal to the EPS control unit, which sends the control command to the motor according to the received voltage signal to make the motor output power assisting torque of corresponding size and direction to generate auxiliary power. When the vehicle is running in a straight line, the EPS control unit does not send instructions to the motor controller, and the motor does not work. It provides different power assisting effects of motors according to vehicle speeds, and provides greater main torque at low speed, so as to ensure that the vehicle is light and flexible during low-speed steering; it provides less power or no power assistance or even reverse damping force at high speed to ensure the stability and reliability of the vehicle during high-speed driving.

### 7.2.7.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_cec52dbe` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before diagnosing the fault of electric power steering system, refer to the description and operation and system working principle. Understand and be familiar with the working principles of electric power steering system, and then start the system diagnosis. This will help to confirm the correct fault diagnosis steps when the fault occurs. More importantly, it also helps to confirm whether the situation described by the distributor is normal to operation. Any fault diagnosis of electrically operated power assistance steering system should start with a routine inspection that guides the serviceman to take the next logical step for troubleshooting. Understanding and using the diagnosis flow chart correctly can shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of the faulty part.

### 7.2.7.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_18939c69` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1

Confirm customer’s fault before repair. Check that the tire pressure is normal and that there are no obvious signs of mechanical or electrical damage. Check whether the tightening bolts of the movable coupling head of the electric power steering column assembly shaft are loose, whether the fixing bolts on the mounting bracket of the electric power steering column assembly are loose, and confirm whether there are disassembly marks on the torque mark and nut surface.

### 7.2.7.5 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic instrument to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the start and stop button to ON status. The diagnostic instrument is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic instrument.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_6e9e0540` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic instrument is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic instrument is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a probl em in the diagnostic instrument. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic instrument.

### 7.2.7.6 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 7.3.2.1 Description and operations (Type I)
`geely_coolray_en_94838f88` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The main function of the steering wheel is to transmit the steering torque and angle input by the driver to the steering system. The steering wheel is equipped with driver airbag, horn switch and multi-function control switch.

### General
`geely_coolray_en_12cd21f7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The steering wheel heating switch of this vehicle is integrated on the display screen, and the steering wheel heating function can be enabled through the multimedia interface; the main principle is that the steering wheel is heated through the resistance wire in the steering wheel, so that the driver will not feel the cold hand even in the low temperature environment, which improves the driver's driving comfort and the safety of driving.

Main structures

The steering wheel heating system is mainly composed of front heating module, NTC thermistor, steering wheel, etc.

### 7.3.3.1 System working principles
`geely_coolray_en_0302cc08` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Working principles of steering wheel heating

The principle of the heating function of the steering wheel is to heat the steering wheel by energizing the resistance wire preembedded in the steering wheel. The steering wheel heating function can be turned on/off through the soft switch of the multimedia screen.

When the driver operates the multimedia screen steering wheel heating opening switch, the steering wheel heating opening signal is transmitted to the driving infotainment system, the driving infotainment system transmits the steering wheel heating signal to the front heating module through IFCAN communication, the front heating module turns on the steering wheel heating resistance wire circuit after receiving the signal, heats the steering wheel, and monitors the heating temperature through the negative temperature coefficient thermistor. When the heating temperature reaches 44℃, the temperature signal is transmitted to the front heating module, and the front heating module stops power supply to the heating wire and heating stops; when the heating temperature is less than 37℃, the front heating module resupplies power to keep the temperature of the steering wheel within a suitable temperature.

Opening condition:

The multimedia screen triggers the ON signal of the steering wheel heating switch;

The engine is running;

Voltage range is 9-16V

– The corresponding temperature of the thermal resistor ＜ 37℃, NTC resistance:3244 Ω (to be calibrated).

Exit condition:

The engine is not running;

Voltage range < 8.5V or > 16.5V;

Receive an OFF signal of the multimedia screen steering wheel heating switch;

– The corresponding temperature of the thermistor≥ 44℃, NTC resistance:2982 Ω (to be calibrated)；

Steering wheel heating load is short-circuited to ground;

Open or short circuit of thermistor.

### 7.3.7.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_24cfb99e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before diagnosing the TCM system faults, refer to the description and operation and system working principle. Understand and be familiar with the working principle of TCM system, and then start system diagnosis, which helps to determine the correct fault diagnosis steps when a fault occurs. More importantly, it helps to determine whether the condition described by the customer is normal. Any fault diagnosis of TCM system should start with a routine inspection that guides the serviceman to take the next logical step for troubleshooting. Understanding and using the diagnosis flow chart correctly can shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of the faulty part.

### 7.3.7.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_0c7f86c7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1

Confirm customer’s fault before repair.

Check whether the tire pressure is normal and whether there are obvious signs of mechanical or electrical damage. Check whether the tightening bolts of the movable coupling head of the mechanical steering column assembly shaft are loose, and whether the fixing bolts on the mounting bracket of the mechanical steering column assembly are loose. If so, repair or replace related parts.

### 7.3.7.3 Fault symptom table
`geely_coolray_en_0fd2891d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

### 7.3.7.5 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic instrument to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the start and stop button to ON status. The diagnostic instrument is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic instrument.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_6e9e0540` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic instrument is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic instrument is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic instrument. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic instrument.

### 7.3.7.6 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 8.2.2.1 Description and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_bc17791c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

The electronic air conditioning system is designed to provide a comfortable environment for the passenger compartment regardless of the weather conditions outside the vehicle. The system is composed of the following main components:

1. Cooling system

2. Heating system

3. Air distribution system

4. Mode/temperature control system

Compressor

A/C compressor is driven by the engine crankshaft driving the compressor clutch belt pulley through the transmission belt. When the electromagnetic clutch coil is not powered, compressor belt pulley rotates freely without driving the compressor shaft. When the clutch coil is powered, the clutch disc and the hub are pushed to the pulley, and the magnetic force integrates the clutch disc with the belt pulley to drive the compressor shaft. The compressor has a unique lubrication system. Crankshaft suction port is discharged through a rotating swash plate, which allows lubrication of the swash plate bearing. The rotation produces the effect of oil separation, with some oil being separated from the crankshaft suction port and discharged back into the crankshaft. The returned oil lubricates the mechanical components of compressor.

The compressor is turned off when:

1. Ambient temperature is too low
2. Temperature of engine coolant
3. Refrigerant pressure is too high or too low

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_e1e2998d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

Do not hit or drop the compressor or turn it upside down. If the compressor is hit or turned upside down, rotate the compressor clutch 5-6 times by hand to circulate the oil deposited in the cylinder. When oil is in the cylinder, sudden rotation can cause valve damage and adversely affect durability.

Condenser, fluid reservoir dryer

The high temperature and high pressure refrigerant vapor from the A/C compressor flows into the condenser, which is made of aluminum tube and cooling fin that can carry out rapid heat transfer. The cooling fin condenses the high temperature and high pressure refrigerant vapor into medium temperature and high pressure liquid through heat dissipation.

Fluid reservoir dryer is located on the left side of the condenser and welded into one with the condenser. The internal structure of the fluid reservoir dryer is designed to ensure that the medium temperature and high pressure gas-liquid mixing refrigerant enters and the medium temperature and high pressure liquid refrigerant comes out of the fluid reservoir dryer. There is desiccant that absorbs the moisture of the cooling system inside the fluid reservoir dryer， and the desiccant cannot be reused. When leakage occurs due to the following reasons, the fluid reservoir dryer core cannot be maintained and can only be replaced.

1. Piercing
2. Containment damage
3. The outside air has been in the system for a long time

### Inside temperature sensor and outside temperature sensor
`geely_coolray_en_52c2bf3f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Outside and inside temperature sensors affect the automatic control of the inside air temperature: these sensors are all temperature sensitive thermistors, and the resistance of the sensors is inversely proportional to the temperature. A/C control module sets internal and external circulation motor, cooling and heating temperature wind direction motor, and blower speed control module to control A/C temperature according to resistance value information.

Inside temperature sensor housing is connected to the aspirator through a hose pipe. The air flow out of the main air-conditioning assembly forms a small vacuum at the end of the aspirator hose. The vacuum makes the air flow through the inside temperature sensor, which improves the accuracy of the temperature detected by the sensor.

The outside temperature sensor is located in the front grille area under the front bumper of the vehicle. A/C control module uses this sensor to acquire the surrounding air temperature information. The A/C control module will display the external temperature on the instrument when the information is used.

### Inside A/C master device
`geely_coolray_en_d6e53d3d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:1

The inside air-conditioning assembly is in the instrument panel, which is composed of blower motor, blower speed control module, air conditioning filter, heater core, evaporator, expansion valve, temperature and wind direction control motor, air deflectors and ventilation ducts.

1. Blower motor

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_cf1be15c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When the blower motor is placed, the fan of the blower motor should not be used as the supporting surface. It is forbidden to touch the fan to prevent damaging the fan blade.

Blower is composed of permanent magnet motor and mouse-cage fan. The change of the speed of the blower depends on the speed control module of the blower. If the user chooses the maximum air conditioning mode, most of the air entering the blower comes from the passenger compartment (internal circulation).

### 2. Heater core
`geely_coolray_en_9df2c14a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Heater core is the main component of heater system. The heater core is located in the air-conditioning assembly. The engine coolant is pumped from the engine into the heater core during engine operation. The heater core transfers heat from the engine coolant to the air flowing through the heater core. The heater core has special inlet and outlet warm air pipes. When removal, the warm air pipes of heater core must be completely discharged. When maintenance, the heater core that is equipped with independent warm air pipes must already be installed.

### 3. Evaporator and expansion valve
`geely_coolray_en_39df5e65` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

The evaporator is located to the left of the air-conditioning assembly. When the air-conditioning assembly is installed on the vehicle, it needs to be removed to remove and install the evaporator and expansion valve. When removal, the refrigerant pipeline of the evaporator must be completely discharged. When maintenance, the evaporator equipped with separate refrigerant lines must already be installed. The expansion valve is connected with the evaporator and installed at one end of the evaporator and located at the evaporator inlet. One side of the expansion valve is connected with the air inlet and outlet pipes of the A/C compressor, and the other side is connected with the air inlet and outlet pipes of the evaporator, which restricts the highpressure liquid refrigerant in the liquid pipeline and makes the refrigerant flow to the evaporator as low-pressure liquid.

The expansion valve changes its position from large to small according to the lower and upper limit of air conditioning pressure. The evaporator cools and dehumidifies the air before it enters the passenger compartment. The refrigerant evaporates in the evaporator, absorbing heat from the air flow through the evaporator. When the heat from the air is transferred to the evaporator core, the moisture in the air condenses on the outer surface of the evaporator core to form water and flow out.

The evaporator is equipped with a temperature sensor to prevent it from freezing. The sensor measures the surface temperature of the heat sink on the evaporator. If the temperature is lower than about 0℃ (32℉), the compressor will not continue to work. If this temperature increases to 3° C (37.4℉), the compressor starts working again.

Refrigerant R-134a and lubricating oil

Refrigerant has the function of absorbing heat, carrying heat and releasing heat in A/C system. The R-134a refrigerant is used on the vehicle, which is non-toxic, flame retardant, transparent, colorless liquefied gas.

Depending on the various compressors configured by vehicle models, the lubrication oil of the specified grade should be used:

The following matters should be noticed：

The lubricating oil must be brand new, and no waste lubrication oil containing moisture/dust/metal scraps shall be used;

Excessive lubrication oil is not allowed to be added to the system, otherwise it will affect the cooling capacity of the cooling system;

When the system is replaced, the refrigerant should be discharged slowly so that the lubrication oil does not spurt out with the refrigerant.

Before filling, check the quality of the lubricating oil in the pipeline. If serious blackening or carbon particle precipitation is found, the entire air conditioning system should be thoroughly cleaned and blown, fluid reservoir dryer should be replaced, and all lubrication oil should be replaced; it is forbidden to use water, corrosive solvent or flammable and explosive solvent to clean the air conditioning system. Heptane and other cleaners are recommended to thoroughly clean and dry the air conditioning system;

### A/C high pressure pipe, A/C low pressure pipe, A/C pressure sensor and three-way pressure switch
`geely_coolray_en_b80355cd` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:1

The A/C cooling system is connected as a closed system with A/C high and low pressure pipe (A/C hard pipe and/or hose), in which refrigerant and lubrication oil flow to complete the working cycle process of refrigerant. The A/C hard pipe is composed of aluminum pipe and corresponding joints, and A/ C hose is composed of rubber hose and corresponding joints.

The pressure sensor detects the pressure value of the air conditioning system, and the vehicle controller realizes the functions of pressure protection for the air conditioning system according to the pressure signal.

Three-way pressure switch: output medium-pressure signal according to the pressure of the air conditioning system, and turn on the high-speed fan; Low-pressure and high-pressure signals realize pressure protection for the air conditioning system.

### 3. Heating system working principles
`geely_coolray_en_28aa6286` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:1

![](images/3eb9279cc2faad0c246d19f374fcbd4bd8cf49cae3eb483f63d45cd50c091bbf.webp)
Superheated steam-saturated steam-condensation-saturated liquid-supercooled liquid

The compressor can be driven by the engine through the drive belt. The gaseous refrigerant is extracted from the evaporator and compressed. The temperature of refrigerant rises and the pressure rises.

The high-pressure overheated refrigerant is transferred to the condenser. At this time, the heat in the refrigerant is carried away by the air transferred to the heat sink of the condenser. Because of the loss of heat, the refrigerant is cooled and the temperature drops

The refrigerant is sent to the fluid reservoir dryer under high pressure, which serves as a storage intermediary to filter all water entrapped in the refrigerant.

The dried refrigerant from the condenser is sent to the inlet of the expansion valve. The expansion valve controls the flow of the refrigerant entering the evaporator by throttling and decompression. The pressure of the mist refrigerant coming out of the expansion valve drops. The temperature drops.

The fog refrigerant is heated to evaporate in the evaporator. At last, the blower blows the air through the surface of the evaporator box towards each air outlet. Because of the

When the automatic A/C system is in heating mode, turning the temperature control device to the heating air position, the air entering the heater core will produce the following effects:

Part or all of the airflow is bypassed to the heater core

-Heat transfer

Any unheated air will be mixed with the heated air before entering the passenger compartment to obtain the corresponding mixed air of the right temperature. The engine coolant status is the key factor for the normal operation of the heating system.

### 4. Working principles of the ventilation control system
`geely_coolray_en_4059eec2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

![](images/8dd7b96a827b67a6372436b24b7dddf669eab4ea3a60d94690e8321876a2a6d4.webp)

Various positions on the ventilation control system allow the mode valve to mix or introduce cold, hot, and outside air through the A/C system, and the air flow is transmitted to the passenger compartment by the air duct system and the air outlet.

In the "AUTO" mode, the corresponding mode state will be automatically selected, and the "MODE" button can be used to change the air supply mode of the vehicle. If an air supply mode is currently displayed, press the "MODE" button to select the next air supply mode.

The air flow direction is changed according to the following modes:

Face blowing - air supply through the air outlets of the instrument panel

Face blowing /Feet blowing air supply through the air outlets of the instrument panel and floor

Feet blowing air supply through the air outlets of the floor

Feet blowing /Defrosting air supply through the air outlets of the floor and front windshield

Defrosting air supply through the air outlets of the front windshield

### 8.2.6.5 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic instrument to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the start and stop button to ON status. The diagnostic instrument is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic instrument.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_6e9e0540` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic instrument is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic instrument is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic instrument. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic instrument.

### 8.2.6.6 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 8.2.6.25 Recovery and Filling of A/C Refrigerant
`geely_coolray_en_6637635e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:1

The operation efficiency and service life of air conditioning (A/C) system depend on the chemical stability of the cooling system. When the refrigeration system is contaminated by foreign matter (such as dust, air or moisture), the contamination will change the stability o f refrigerant and compressor oil. It also affects the relationship between pressure and temperature, reduces work efficiency, and can lead to internal corrosion and abnormal worn of components. please operate as follows to ensure the chemical stability of the system:

Before opening the connector, wipe off the oil stain at and around the connector to reduce the possibility of oil stain entering the system.

After the joint is disconnected, the two sides of joints are sealed by cap, plug or tape to prevent oil, foreign matter and moisture from entering.

Keep all tools clean and dry, including manifold pressure gauge components and all replacements.

Use clean, dry conveying devices and containers to add refrigerant oil, as far as possible to ensure that the refrigerant oil is not affected by moisture.

Minimize exposure time of A/C system interior to air during operation.

A/C system interior must be emptied and refilled after exposed to the air. All repair parts are dried and sealed before delivery. These sealed parts should only be opened when the installation is about to begin. Before unpacking, all parts should be kept at room temperature to prevent moisture in the air from condensing on the parts and entering the system, and resealed as soon as possible.

Draining, lubricating oil filling, emptying and filling procedures of air conditioning system

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_a1cf1f29` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:1

Refer to “Warning of inhaling R-134a” in the “Warnings and Notice”. Other health and safety information is available from refrigerant and lubrication oil manufacturers.

Warning！

Refer to “Warning regarding goggles and gloves” in the “Warnings and Notice”

The discharge, adding of lubrication oil, emptying and filling of A/C system can be completed by one connection of filling machine. The refrigerant is filtered during both recovery and empting to ensure that the refrigerant pumped into the A/C system is clean and dry.

1. R-12 filling machine is prohibited to fill R-134a system. The refrigerants and refrigerant oils of the two systems are not compatible and must not be mixed, even in small amounts, mixing in residual refrigerant will damage the equipment.

2. Reducing joints are prohibited to ensure internal sealing of the system.

Installation and maintenance of the filling machine

There are many types of filling machine. All filling machines perform various tasks such as air conditioning system discharge, refrigerant recovery, system evacuation, quantitative addition of refrigerant oil and quantitative refilling of refrigerant. Refer to the operation manual of the filling machine to understand the initial installation procedure and maintenance procedure.

Functions of the control panel

The operator can control and monitor the operation process with the control button and indicator light on the filling machine. For details, please refer to the operation instrument of filling machine. Operation instrument should include:

1. Main power supply switch: The main power switch supplies power to the control panel.

2. Display screen: The display shows the programmed vacuuming time and the weight of the refilled refrigerant. Refer to the operation instrument of manufacturer and know the detailed program information.

3. Low pressure side manifold pressure gauge: this gauge shows the pressure of system low pressure side.

4. High pressure side manifold pressure gauge: this gauge shows the pressure of system high pressure side.

5. Control panel: It includes control buttons to control various operation functions.

6. Low pressure side valve: this valve is used to connect the low pressure side of A/C system and filling machine.

7. Humidity indicator light: This indicator light indicates whether the refrigerant is moist or not.

8. High pressure side valve: this valve is used to connect the high pressure side of A/C system and filling machine.

Recovery of refrigerant

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_1ba11358` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Use only refrigerant tanks specially designed for filling machine. The anti- overcharge mechanism of filling machine is specifically calibrated for the use of this refrigerant tank. The tank valve of the refrigerant tank is also specially manufactured for the device.

Check the high pressure side and low pressure side gauges on the control panel of the filling machine to ensure that there is pressure in the A/C system. If there is no pressure, there is no recyclable refrigerant in the system.

Open high pressure side and low pressure side valves.

Open the gas and liquid valves on the refrigerant tank.

Drain the refrigerant oil from the oil-liquid separator.

Close the drain valve.

Connect the filling machine to an appropriate power outlet.

Switch on the main power supply switch.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a550606e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:1

It is forbidden to mix used refrigerant oil with new refrigerant oil. Aluminum or other foreign matter may be deposited in the used oil. Always use new refrigerant oil when refilling the air conditioning system. Properly discard used refrigerant oil.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_5aef855c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Some of the lubrication oil in the A/C system may be recycled along with the refrigerant. The amount of recovered lubrication oil is variable. The filling machine can separate the lubrication oil from the refrigerant so that the amount of lubrication oil recovered can be determined. Add equal amount of lubrication oil when the system is refilled. Refer to the operation instrument of manufacturer and know the detailed method of filling machine.

1. Start the recovery process. Refer to the operation instrument of manufacturer and know the detailed method of filling machine.

2. Wait for 5 minutes, and then check the low pressure side pressure gauge on the control panel. If the A/C system maintains vacuum, the recovery is completed.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_4bd3b62f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If the control panel indicator light indicates that the refrigerant tank is full during the recovery period. After the filling machine is closed, install an empty tank to store the refrigerant required for the subsequent steps. Do not use other types of refrigerant tanks.

1. If the number starts from zero on the low pressure side pressure gauge, there are still refrigerants in the system. Recycle the remaining refrigerant. Repeat this step until the system can maintain vacuum for 2 minutes.

Emptying

The refrigerant tank of filling machine must be filled with adequate R-134a refrigerant for filling. Check the amount of refrigerant in the tank. If the refrigerant is less than 6kg (8lb), add a new refrigerant to the refrigerant tank. For details, please refer to the operation instrument of filling machine and know the method of adding refrigerant.

1. Check whether the high pressure side and low pressure side hoses are connected to the A/C system and open the high pressure side and low pressure side valves on the control panel of the filling machine.

2. Open the gas and liquid valves on the refrigerant tank.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_728c8b12` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:1

Refer to the operation instrument of manufacturer and know the detailed method of filling machine. The system must be emptied before new refrigerants or recycled refrigerants can be refilled

Start the vacuum pump and begin the emptying procedure. During the recovery process, non-condensable gases (mostly air) are discharged automatically from the tank. You will hear the sound of pressure relief.

Caution

Replace vacuum pump oil frequently. Refer to the operation instrument of manufacturer and know the detailed method of filling machine.

4. Check the system for leakage. Refer to the operation instrument of manufacturer and know the detailed method of filling machine.

Filling and replenishment of lubricating oil in air conditioning system

Lubrication oil discharged from the A/C system during recovery must be replenished.

1. Use graduated bottles specially designed for R-134A systems.

2. Refer to the manufacturer's operating instructions for details on the use of the filling machine, and add appropriate lubricating oil to the system

3. When the required amount of oil is filled, switch off the valve.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_87c48903` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Keep the cap on the lubrication oil bottle tightly to prevent moisture or contaminants from entering the lubrication oil. This operation requires a certain degree of vacuum in the A/C system. Do not open the lubrication oil filling valve when there is positive pressure in the A/C system, otherwise it will cause the lubrication oil to flow back through the vent of the oil bottle. When filling or replenishing lubrication oil, the oil level should not be lower than the fluid pipe, otherwise air will enter the A/C system.

Filling

### Empty the A/C system before filling.
`geely_coolray_en_ca6608f9` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Close the low pressure side valve on the control panel.

2. Close the high pressure side valve on the control panel.

3. Refer to the operation instrument of manufacturer and know the detailed method of filling machine.

4. Fill the necessary refrigerant into the A/C system to ensure that the unit of measurement is correct (i.e., kilogram, kilogram or pound).

5. Start filling.

Successfu completion of regrigerant filling

1. Close the high and low pressure side valves on the control panel of the filling machine. Both valves should be closed.

2. Start the vehicle and A/C system.

3. Keep the drive motor running until the readings on the high pressure side and low pressure side gauge are stable.

4. Compare readings with system specifications.

5. Check the evaporator outlet temperature to ensure that the operation of A/C system is in accordance with system specifications.

6. Keep A/C running.

7. Close the high pressure side quick joint valve.

8. Disconnect the high pressure side hose on the vehicle.

9. Open the high pressure side and low pressure side valves on the control panel. The system will quickly inhale the refrigerant in the two hoses through the low pressure side hoses.

10. Close the low pressure side quick joint valve. Disconnect the low pressure side hose on the vehicle.

Refrigerant filling failed

Sometimes the refrigerant entering the A/C system does not reach the total filling volume. There are two reasons:

The pressure of the refrigerant tank of the filling machine is similar to that of the A/C system, which will cause the filling process to be too slow. Refer to the operation instrument of manufacturer and know the detailed method of filling machine.

There is not enough refrigerant in the refrigerant tank to refill. it is necessary to recover some of filled refrigerant from the vehicle. empty the A/C system, add refrigerant to the refrigerant tank and refill it. Refer to the operation instrument of manufacture rand know the use of filling machine

### 8.2.7.1 Replacement of automatic A/C controller
`geely_coolray_en_0ed9615b` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

2 Remove the right lower fender apron assembly of the dashboard. Refer to Replacement of Right Lower Fender Apron Assembly of Dashboard

![](images/da56e82f57504f563fe394ce68bb0569f7f4379ccda778fa3db3c23416462b96.webp)

3 Remove the automatic A/C controller. a. Disconnect the automatic A/C controller harness connector.

b. Remove the fixing screw connecting the upper of the automatic A/C controller and the A/C master unit.

![](images/10d618041f4c0ef1cd089d7041870fe29d38cc46e849fa51b019aa6f907993b5.webp)

c. Remove the 1 fixing screws connecting the lower of the automatic A/C controller and the A/C master unit. d. Take off the automatic A/C controller.

Installation procedure

![](images/31b794c12f69161a6e565ca6a56a934f73697a0ce5f433fc4af430b3a4d7bf43.webp)

Install the automatic A/C controller.

a. Install and tighten the fixing screws connecting the lower of the automatic A/C controller and the A/C master unit.

Torque: 1.7N·m (metric system) 2.3lb-ft (British system)

![](images/df4a00e51b11428c2fa83a83e5678a732ff25e8312db3c08f945482becde4fea.webp)

b. Install and tighten the fixing screws connecting the upper of the automatic A/C controller and the A/C master unit.

Torque: 1.7N·m (metric system) 2.3lb-ft (British system)

c. Connect the harness connector of the automatic A/C controller.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_9877330b` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.

2 Install the right lower fender apron assembly of the dashboard. 3 Connect the negative cable of battery.

![](images/a4cbe90857aa1dacddfda3925331dccbd0068db20d363f3efa23d5b7f4840f4b.webp)

a. Install the A/C panel switch into the right trim strip of the dashboard.

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.

d. Turn off the A/C pressure switch dust cover.

2 Refill air conditioner refrigerant.
3 Connect the negative cable of battery.

### 8.2.7.5 Replacement of air-conditioning compressor
`geely_coolray_en_4ce98063` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
2 Recycle air conditioner refrigerant. Refer to Recovery and Filling of A/C Refrigerant
3 Remove engine trim cover. Refer to Replacement of engine trim cover
4 Lift the vehicle. Refer to Lifting and Jacking of Vehicle
5 Remove the right front wheel. Refer to Wheel Replacement
6 Remove the left front wheel arch splash guard. Refer to Replacement of Left Front Wheel Arch
7 Remove the bottom fender apron of the engine. Refer to Replacement of Engine Bottom Shield
8 Remove the air intake pipe of intercooler. Refer to Replacement of Air Intake Pipe of Intercool er
9 Remove the A/C compressor a. Use a wrench to turn the tensioning mechanism components clockwise. b. Remove the drive belt.

![](images/24eee0d3df4c7f27dc259586096289309323ac5152341a05a8c6a5d67f6a28d0.webp)

a. Disconnect the harness connector of A/C compressor.

![](images/6f95c8d9cbb9a772641d7622a5dd8608043b715e03263203a53e93618e2fdf3e.webp)![](images/3fc2ff3b64c9379ca314aeb9bd7e4a90d1fec2f2a6b8c5cd9dfecde8d972a831.webp)

d. Remove the 1 fixing nut connecting the compressor exhaust pipe assembly and the A/C compressor, and disconnect the pipeline.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_8e627078` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

After the pipeline is disconnected, the pipeline should be wrapped in time to prevent foreign objects from entering the pipeline.

e. Remove the fixing bolt connecting the A/C highpressure pipe and the A/C compressor, and disconnect the pipeline.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_b792292c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

After the pipeline is disconnected, the pipeline should be wrapped in time to prevent foreign objects from entering the pipeline.

f. Remove the fixing bolt connecting the upper end of the A/C compressor with the crankcase.

![](images/f44c5bc6e35a8f5f2a3853b0e2d066a41b6dd0b7a38ab082f89b79ea08e9e4bc.webp)

g. Remove the 2 fixing bolts connecting the lower end of the A/C compressor with the crankcase. h. Remove the A/C compressor.

![](images/489d8a72493c015eab2c7e8dcd2c30900c12ba878d185bb2db93b1501782f8e3.webp)

Installation procedure Install the A/C compressor a. Move the A/C compressor to the installation position. b. Install and tighten the 2 fixing bolts connecting the lower end of the A/C compressor with the crankcase. Torque: 24N·m

![](images/85f41fb9f923e166707ec533bf76a7ccba4a39a7855cabf38a07b4c6daa36849.webp)![](images/1316ac880c5224c21a2b6781151e7952ddba7779b9e19bfb454e38a820dbacb0.webp)

c. Install and tighten the fixing bolt connecting the upper end of the A/C compressor with the crankcase. Torque: 24N·m

d. Connect the pipeline, and install and tighten the fixing bolt connecting the A/C high-pressure pipe and the A/C compressor.

Torque: 24N·m

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_21870b54` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Replace the sealing ring with a new one and apply some lubricating oil.

e. Connect the pipeline, and install and tighten the 1 fixing bolt connecting the compressor exhaust pipe assembly with the A/C compressor.

Torque: 24N·m

Caution

Replace the sealing ring with a new one and apply some lubricating oil.

![](images/96933d7674ef7dae806cac0fb68e7489a9c68f6b3fb4bf25e9560a6421918f92.webp)

f. Connect the harness connector of the A/C compressor.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_04202ad6` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.

g. Move the drive belt to the installation position. h. Use a wrench to pull the tensioning mechanism components clockwise.

2 Install intake pipe of intercooler.
3 Install the engine bottom shield
4 Install the right front wheel.
5 Lower the vehicle.
6 Install the engine trim cover
7 Connect the negative cable of battery.
8 Refill air conditioner refrigerant.

### 8.2.7.6 Replacement of A/C Master Device Assembly
`geely_coolray_en_4849823a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

![](images/22d72ec3f8406569afe66994cbf0c763a6e664e13d066aeaa5a59c4ef3f0015f.webp)

1 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
2 Recycle air conditioner refrigerant. Refer to Recovery and Filling of A/C Refrigerant
3 Drain the engine coolant. Refer to Discharge and Filling of Engine Coolant
4 Remove the instrument panel cross member. Refer to Replacement of Dashboard Cross Member
5 Remove the A/C master device assembly. a. Remove the fixing clamp A of the A/C warm air water outlet pipe. b. Disconnect the A/C warm air water outlet pipe. c. Remove the fixing clamp B of the A/C warm air water inlet pipe. d. Disconnect the A/C warm air water inlet pipe.

e. Remove the fixing bolt connecting the A/C low/high pressure pipe assembly and the A/C master unit.

f. Disconnect the A/C high/low pressure pipe assembly.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_6494d06e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:hvac | p:1

After the pipeline is disconnected, the pipeline should be wrapped in time to prevent foreign objects from entering the pipeline.

![](images/ad177ba8a99408e9e67e697915bf6a1e78e385489a36e577cbfd2ce13a810e1d.webp)

g. Disconnect the A/C drain pipe from the vehicle body floor.

h. Remove the 2 fixing bolts connecting the A/C master device assembly and the vehicle body. i. Take off the A/C master unit assembly.

Installation procedure

![](images/d73bd11f90ff7ddc6c5a9da7ac64c5148b40bd14a573877a2d4ddf5c842beeeb.webp)

1 Install air-conditioning assembly. a. Install and tighten the 2 fixing bolts connecting the A/C master unit assembly with the vehicle body. Torque: 6N·m

b. Connect the A/C drain pipe from the vehicle body floor.

c. Connect the A/C high/low pressure pipe assembly. d. Install and tighten the 1 fixing bolt connecting the A/C low/high pressure pipe assembly with the A/C master unit.

Torque: 10N·m

Caution

Replace the sealing ring with a new one and apply some lubricating oil.

![](images/7082d1e9ba26eb4a6bf85ebaade99e68d3a847b21e7f1f3bef5a1e644564da7a.webp)

e. Connect the air conditioning heater outlet pipe.
f. Install the fixing clamp A of the A/C warm air water outlet pipe.
g. Install the T fixing clamp B of the A/C warm air water inlet pipe.
h. Connect the air conditioning heater inlet pipe.

2 Refill air conditioner refrigerant.
3 Fill engine coolant.
4 Connect the negative cable of battery.

### 8.2.7.8 Replacement of H expansion valve
`geely_coolray_en_1220bfa0` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

![](images/f7863b857c6ba1304e2e91c276b1fde5f103a4a874bc4eba150066032ec52c90.webp)

1 Recycle air conditioner refrigerant. Refer to Discharge and Filling of Refrigerant.
2 Remove H-type expansion valve a. Remove the 1 fixing bolt connecting the A/C low/high pressure pipe assembly with the H-type expansion valve. b. Disconnect the pipeline connecting the A/C low/high pressure pipe assembly with the H-type expansion valve, and set the A/C low/high pressure pipe assembly aside.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a9687303` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

After the pipeline is disconnected, the pipeline should be wrapped in time to prevent foreign objects from entering the pipeline.

![](images/30ac9efc79c1687959eed96af14f09cdcbf1a6af2726f0e4e2a646c4bffcf87f.webp)

c. Remove the 2 fixing bolts of the H-type expansion valve. d. Take off the H-type expansion valve.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_d17c8979` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

After the pipeline is disconnected, the pipeline should be wrapped in time to prevent foreign objects from entering the pipeline.

Installation procedure

![](images/2d146f6b1a9a330d31cb23c188bcf6965a20830f7a4ead27d74d61e0a01101f1.webp)

Install the H-type expansion valve.
a. Move the H-type expansion valve to the installation position.

### 9.1.1.1 Warnings and Precautions
`geely_coolray_en_594248c7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Warning regarding airbag system

Warning！

This vehicle is equipped with airbag system. The following conditions will happen if the correct operation procedure is not followed.

The airbag system is accidentally opened.

The system does not work when the airbag is needed for protection.

Warning！

### Following criteria should be strictly followed to avoid the occurrence of above conditions
`geely_coolray_en_b2117e22` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The airbag system component view should be referred to in order to ensure whether you are maintaining or operating on airbag system components, surrounding, or its circuit. If you are performing maintenance operations on airbag system components and its surroundings or its lines, disengage the airbag system.

Warning regarding extremely high temperature of deployed airbag electronic control unit (ACU)

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_a0a464a0` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

After deployment, the metal surfaces of airbag system components may be very hot. To avoid fire and personal injury:

There should be sufficient cooling time before touching any metal surface of the airbag system components.

Do not place inflatable airbag system components next to any combustible material.

Warning regarding clock spring of airbag system

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_78ebad9a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The clock spring assembly is integrated with the dashboard switch block, and improper installation of the dashboard switch block will damage the spiral coil inside the clock spring, which may cause coil failure and make the airbag module unable to work normally, thus leading to personal injury.

Warning regarding scrap of airbag

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_dbab7fca` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

To prevent accidental deployment of airbags and personal injury, non-deployed airbag should not be disposed of as conventional workshop wastes. If the sealed container damages in the process of scrap, some of the substances contained in the non-deployed modules may cause serious illness or personal injury. Safely scrap non-deployed airbag with deployment procedures.

Warnings regarding taking and storage of the airbag system inflated modules

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_edb474a6` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When transporting non-deployed airbag:

Do not lift the wires or connectors on the airbag for handling.

Make sure the airbag opening does not face yourself or someone else.

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_cb797d86` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When storing undeployed airbags, ensure the airbag openings are not toward the surface where the airbag is placed. The airbag openness should not be downward. It is prohibited to place any object on the airbag. There should be enough space around the airbag for accident deployment; otherwise, it will hurt people. It is prohibited to immerse the non-deployed airbag in water or contact with other liquids. The undeployed airbag should be prohibited from fire sources or high temperatures to avoid accident deployment of the airbag that may hurt people.

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_7aeb330c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Do not impact or shake the airbag system collision sensor. Before charging the collision sensor, make sure that the collision sensor is firmly fixed. Failure to follow the correct installation procedure may cause accidental detonation of the airbag system or no effect at the time of detonation, causing personal injury.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_0c294d8e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

Airbag system is not intended to overlap the function of seatbelt. If the seat belt is not fastened, serious personal injury may result when the air bag is detonated. When driving or riding a vehicle, you need to fasten the seat belt. Only when you fasten the seat belt can the airbag system better provide auxiliary protection in case of a collision.

Description of airbag system

The airbag system consists of the following components:

– Airbag warning lamp on the instrument cluster Airbag electronic control unit (ACU)
Driver’s frontal impact sensor
Passenger’s frontal impact sensor
– Left side impact sensor
– Right side impact sensor
Passenger identification sensor in the front row
– Driver’s airbag
– Front passenger airbag
Driver seat belt pretensioner
Front passenger seat belt pretensioner
Driver seat side airbag
– Front passenger seat side airbag
– Left curtain airbag
Right curtain airbag Clock spring Airbag system harness

Airbag system is a passive safety system, which provides the passengers in the vehicle with auxiliary protection in addition to seat belt. The airbag system has multiple airbags distributed in different positions in the vehicle, including the steering wheel, instrument panel, front seat backrest, and roof rails. Besides airbags, seat belt pretensioner may also be equipped. When a collision occurs, it will tighten the seat belt to increase the distance between the personnel in the vehicle and the airbags when the airbags deploy. Each airbag has an ignition circuit which is controlled by the airbag control module. When the airbag electronic control unit detects the impact force of the collision is huge enough, it will control the airbag to deploy. The airbag control module continuously diagnoses and monitors the electrical components of the airbag system. When a circuit fault is detected, the airbag control module will set a DTC and turn on the airbag warning lamp to inform the driver. The steering column is of energy absorption type. When front side collision happens, it can be shrunk to reduce the driver injury odds.

The airbag electronic control unit will receive the sensor signals to judge the degree of severity of the collision. When the signal value is bigger than the setting value in the memorizer, the airbag electronic control unit will send out an ignition commands to deploy the corresponding inflatable module of the airbag system. In case of a frontal collision with sufficient impact, the front airbags will deploy and the seat belt pretensioner will be tensioned; in case of a side collision with sufficient impact, the side airbags of front row, curtain airbags and front airbags on the corresponding side will deploy, and the seat belt pretensioner will be tensioned.

After the airbag electronic control module(ACU) confirms the collision signal, it will send the "collision unlocking and power off" signal to the bus within 20ms. The signal will be sent with 20ms as a cycle, and 3s in total. If BCM and EMS receive more than 3 consecutive signals, they will respectively perform unlocking and power off functions.

### 9.2.5.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_f899efd6` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Refer to description and operation. Familiarize yourself with system functions and operation procedures before starting system diagnosis. This helps to determine the correct troubleshooting steps when a trouble occurs. More importantly, it also helps to determine whether the situation described by the customer is normal.

### 9.2.5.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_0ca8b7d8` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Confirm faults symptoms.

The most difficult situation during troubleshooting is that no symptoms appear. Under the circumstances, the fault described by the user must be thoroughly analyzed. Then it is needed to simulate the same or similar conditions and environments when the customer’s vehicle fault occurs. No matter how experienced and skilled the maintenance personnel is, if the fault symptoms are not confirmed before troubleshooting, something important during repair will be missed and some wrong guess will be made, which will result in troubleshooting unable to proceed.

• Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage or there is a situation that may cause a malfunction.

• Pivot for connector joint and vibration should be the main part subject to a thorough examination. If the fault is caused by vibration, the vibration method is recommended.

Gently vibrate the possible fault part with fingers, and check whether the fault occurs.
– Gently shake the connector in both vertical and horizontal directions.
Gently shake the harness in both vertical and horizontal directions.

### 9.2.5.4 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic instrument to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the start and stop button to ON status. The diagnostic instrument is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic instrument.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_6e9e0540` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic instrument is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic instrument is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic instrument. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the dia gnostic instrument.

### 9.2.5.5 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_00de352a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC
a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.
b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".
c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen. 2. Clear DTC
a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.
b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".
c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 9.2.6.2 Replacement of driver front airbag

Removal procedure

Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery

Cable

Caution

Disconnect the negative battery terminal for more than 90s and wait for the airbag capacitor to be fully discharged before disassembly. Insufficient discharge may cause an accidental detonation of airbag during disassembly and injuring the operators.

2 Remove the driver’s airbag a. Turn the steering wheel to the left and use a small screwdriver to pry off the fixing circlip at the lower and right sides of the airbag.

![](images/c89eb39992bc3fc0e85788b109807d39ed86d7b8fe602d828f117ba930261f11.webp)

b. Turn the steering wheel to the right and use a small screwdriver to pry off the fixing circlip 2 at the left of the airbag.

c. Disconnect the 2 harness connectors of the driver's airbag.
d. Take off the driver's airbag.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_9d25b940` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When storing, the surface of the airbag should be put upward, otherwise, accidental deployment may occur and cause serious accidents. To prevent damage to airbags, keep away from engine oil, grease, detergent, water and other materials. Do not place any object on the airbag. Do not use detection lamps, voltmeters, ohmmeter and other tools to measure the circuit of the airbag system; otherwise, it may be detonated unexpectedly. The airbag system can only work once, and the airbags detonated in case of accident must be replaced.

Installation procedure

![](images/62b8cc06c350c2c9edd412ed1efe4757a9a86266697d5ea075e752830ca08d26.webp)

a. Move the driver airbag to the installation position. b. Connect the 2 harness connectors of the driver's airbag.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_ac5fa717` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.

c. Install the driver's airbag on the steering wheel and confirm the circlip is installed in place.

2 Connect the negative cable of battery.

### 9.3.2.1 Instructions and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_479b048e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

Seat belt

The front and rear seats of the vehicle are equipped with seat belts, which are the main way to protect the people in the vehicle. Seat belts can keep people in the vehicle in the following situations, gradually reducing the collision force:

– Front collision Rear collision Side collision Overturn caused collision

The seat belt has an automatic locking function. When the seat belt is quickly pulled out of the retractor, the seat belt is automatically locked. When the seat belt is completely rolled back into the retractor, the seat belt is unlocked to cancel the automatic locking function. At this time, the seat belt can be pulled out of the retractor. The vehicle is also equipped with an airbag system, please refer to Description and Operations in the "Airbag System"

Seatbelt Warning Lamp

The seatbelt warning lamp is locateed in the instrument cluster.

Child seat protection system

Warning！

Because of the warning labels on the sunshade of front passengers, do not place backward child seat on the seat protected by airbags. It will cause great risk to child sitting backward if airbags are deployed.

Please install the child seat on the rear seat, which is equipped with ISOFIX interface. Install and fix the child safety seat according to the instructions of the child safety seat manufacturer.

### 9.3.3.1 System working principles
`geely_coolray_en_fdeffbbb` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1

Front seat belt system

Front seat safety belt system includes the driver and passenger seat belt pretensioner and retractor, passenger identification sensor and two front seat belt switches. Passenger identification sensor is applied to check whether passengers are in the seats. If no passenger is detected, turn off the passenger seatbelt warning lamp. Two front seat belt switches are located in the seat buckles, and they are used to control the seat belt alarming indicator and the buzzer.

### Seatbelt Warning Lamp
`geely_coolray_en_b16214d9` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:interior | p:1

After the power mode of the start-and-stop switch is ON, the airbag electronic control unit (ACU) will signal the seat belt state through the CAN bus to the instrument cluster. If the front seat belt is not fastened, the instrument cluster seat belt warning lamp is on to remind the driver to fasten seat belts.

Rear seat belt system

Rear seat belt system includes the following components:

The rear seatbelt retractor is located in the central fender apron of the C-pillar and the rear seat backrest.

– The lower part of the rear seat belt is fixed on the floor.
– Rear seat belt buckles are fixed on the floor.

### 9.3.6.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_f7930f86` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Confirm trouble symptom

The most difficult situation during troubleshooting is that no symptoms appear. Under such a condition, the fault described by distributors must be completely analyzed. Then simulate the same or similar condition and circumstance when the distributor’s vehicle has faults. No matter how experienced and skillful maintenance personnel are, if eliminating faults without confirming fault symptoms, something important will be ignored in the maintenance, and wrong conjectures will be made in some places. It will make trouble shooting to fail.

Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage or there is a situation that may cause a malfunction.Connector joints and fulcrums of vibration should be the main parts to be checked, and if the fault may be caused by vibration, the vibration method is recommended:

Gently vibrate the possible fault part with fingers, and check whether the fault occurs.
Gently shake the connector in both vertical and horizontal directions.
Gently shake the harness in both vertical and horizontal directions.

Vehicle inspection

Check the seat belt warning lamp:

Operate the start and stop button to switch the power supply mode to “ON” status.
Check whether the seat belt warning lamp on the instrument cluster turns on when the front seat belt is not fastened.
– Check whether the seat belt warning lamp off the instrument cluster turns on when the front seat belt is fastened.

### 9.3.6.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_0ca8b7d8` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Confirm faults symptoms.

The most difficult situation during troubleshooting is that no symptoms appear. Under the circumstances, the fault described by the user must be thoroughly analyzed. Then it is needed to simulate the same or similar conditions and environments when the customer’s vehicle fault occurs. No matter how experienced and skilled the maintenance personnel is, if the fault symptoms are not confirmed before troubleshooting, something important during repair will be missed and some wrong guess will be made, which will result in troubleshooting unable to proceed.

Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage or there is a situation that may cause a malfunction. • Pivot for connector joint and vibration should be the main part subject to a thorough examination. If the fault is caused by vibration, the vibration method is recommended. Gently vibrate the possible fault part with fingers, and check whether the fault occurs. – Gently shake the connector in both vertical and horizontal directions. Gently shake the harness both vertical and horizontal directions.

### 9.3.6.5 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic instrument to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the start and stop button to ON status. The diagnostic instrument is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic instrument.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_6e9e0540` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic instrument is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic instrument is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic instrument. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic instrument.

### 9.3.6.6 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 9.3.7.1 Replacement of front passenger seat belt buckle
`geely_coolray_en_b019c4e3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Open the engine compartment cover.
2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

![](images/8b8eff96e8885174c4d654c199007dee0c54aa495eb99d30f25044949a57d6ee.webp)

3 Remove the front passenger belt buckle a. Disconnect the front passenger belt buckle harness connector. b. Remove the 3 fixing clips of the seat belt buckle harness.

c. Remove the 1 fixing bolt of the front passenger belt buckle and take off the front passenger belt buckle.

Installation procedure

![](images/9189fc92ed8441b9acefe604b26175110f9c3c514cc9c4220c42e824fd9a9d66.webp)

![](images/330809cb86119a3a5eaff1b4eda0a99515474f23ccc4f39517ebe64a764b34eb.webp)

1 Install the front passenger belt buckle a. Install and tighten the fixing bolt of the front passenger belt buckle. Torque: 45 N·m

b. Install the 3 fixing clips of the front passenger belt buckle harness.
c. Connect the front passenger belt buckle harness connector.

2 Connect the negative cable of battery.
3 Close the engine compartment cover.

c. Install and tighten the 1 fixing bolt connecting the driver seat belt pretensioner and the left front seat belt lower fixing plate.
Torque: 45 N·m
