### 10.1.1.1 Warnings and Precautions
`geely_coolray_en_d618b91f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Warnings regarding battery disconnection

Warning！

Before servicing any electrical component, the start and stop button power supply mode shall be in the OFF status and all electrical loads must be “OFF (switch-off)” unless otherwise stated in the operating procedure. If tools or equipment are easily accessible to exposed live electrical terminals, disconnect the negative battery cable. Violation of these safety instructions may result in personal injury and/or damage to the vehicle or vehicle components.

### Warning regarding road test
`geely_coolray_en_ed54719a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Warning！

Road test should be conducted under the premise of ensuring safety and observing all traffic regulations. Do not try any operation that may endanger the control of the vehicle. Violating the above safety instructions can cause serious personal injury and damage the vehicle.

Warning regarding window fast down function

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_dfd90300` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

When the driver door operates the electric window switch, the fast up/down function makes the window move extremely fast without stopping, which may result in personal injury.

### Notice of electro-static discharge
`geely_coolray_en_6ba27ab3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Caution

Do not touch the connector pins or welding components on the circuit board to prevent electrostatic discharge from damaging the electronic control module on the vehicle.

### 1. Early warning
`geely_coolray_en_d16ca9ea` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Enter the warning status first by anti-theft relief status (3s) At this time, the anti-theft indicator flashes rapidly, with a cycle of 160 ms on and 160 ms off. During this period, if a door/rear compartment door/engine bay lid is opened, the warning status will always remain. Otherwise, the system will automatically turn into the anti-theft alert status after three seconds.

### 2. Alarm issuing
`geely_coolray_en_4e30c837` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

In the anti-theft alarm issuing state, the anti-theft indicator flashes slowly, with a cycle of 100ms on, and 3100ms off. When the vehicle is in an alert status, once there is external illegal action, the body anti-theft alarm system will enter the alarm status.

Under the alert status, the conditions for triggering the alarm are as follows:

• Open the FL door Open the FR door Open the RL door Open the RR door Open the rear compartment Open the engine body lid Illegal switch ignition

3. Alarm status

When the anti-theft system is in alarm mode, the alarm circulation is: the turn signal lamp flashes, then the anti-theft alarm horn beeps interactively, with the flashing cycle of the turn signal of "500ms on, 500ms off". The horn will sound for 500ms and then stop for 500ms. After 30s the horn stops and the turn signal flashes for 5min. When the alarm time exceeds five minutes, the external anti-theft alarm system will return to the anti-theft alert status. When the anti-theft lifting signal is received after the alarm is issued, the alarm cycle will end.

### 4. Reminding state
`geely_coolray_en_06de1ea4` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

When using the remote control locking button to lock the door, if any door/trunk door/motor compartment cover is not closed, the turn signal flashes 3 times, the system will enter the reminder state, the anti-theft horn will sound twice, and after 10s, the anti-theft alarm state is activated. If all doors are closed within the reminder period (10s), the reminder state will be suspended, and the anti-theft alarm system will turn to the alarm issuing state or the alarm release state according to the situation. If the locking button is pressed again within 10s and remains in the reminder state, the alarm cycle will begin after 10s. If the remote unlock button is pressed within 10 s, the system will enter the alarm relief state from the reminding state.

### 5. Anti-theft release status
`geely_coolray_en_1a658049` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When the vehicle is in the non-anti-theft lifting status, the external anti-theft alarm system will enter the anti-theft lifting state after performing unlocking operation when receiving the remote key or TBOX or keyless entry system unlocking request.

### 6. Remote key learning:
`geely_coolray_en_6175df20` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Learning by diagnostic apparatus, bus diagnostic tool and matching tool for production line. 3 keys can be learned in sequence. The remote control learning mode will exit the remote key learning state 10s after learning at least one key.

### 2. Door lock control function
`geely_coolray_en_c96c52e7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

The vehicle body control module(BCM) controls the opening and closing of door lock motors and provides the following central door lock functions:

### 1. Remote key locking/unlocking
`geely_coolray_en_af8949d2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Start the switch power supply mode OFF state. After receiving the remote control unlocking order sent by the remote key, the vehicle body control module unlocks the four-door lock motor and gives feedback of the unlocking position signal.

Start the switch power supply mode OFF state. The four doors are closed. After receiving the remote control locking order sent by the remote key, the vehicle body control module locks the four-door lock motor and gives feedback of the locking position signal to lock the four doors. The turn signal lamp flashes three times, the horn beeps twice, the internal lamp gradually goes out and the position lamp goes out.

The power mode of the start-and-stop switch is in the OFF state. Press the remote locking button for more than 2s, the power windows are automatically closed, and the signal is transmitted through LIN.

### 2. Inside central switch unlocking/locking
`geely_coolray_en_ad3ecd5e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Press down the central door control switch unlocking key, then the BCM will drive four doors to perform unlocking. When the vehicle speed is greater than 15km/h, the central control unlocking command is prohibited. The inside central control

unlocking can be performed only in the anti-theft relief status.
If it is in other anti-theft status, it will not respond.

3. Unlock the door at driver’s side individually

Turn the mechanical key to the UNLOCK position to unlock the door at driver's side individually.

4. Automatic re-locking

30S after unlocking by remote control, none of the four doors, trunk door and engine compartment cover is opened, and then the doors are locked again automatically. Inside lamp switch off, and the system enter the alert status

5. Automatic locking during running

When the power supply mode is in ON position and the vehicle speed is greater than 20km/h for more than 3s, the fourdoor lock will be closed automatically.

6. Automatic unlocking in case of collision

When the collision signal is received from the CAN bus, the BCM will trigger the central control unlocking twice within 3s, and the left and right turn signals will continue to flash, and the central control locking will become invalid. Unless a door is opened while the power mode is OFF and the collision signal has expired (4s).

### 7. Automatic unlocking after flameout
`geely_coolray_en_9ce7d368` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

When the door lock is in lock status and the power supply mode is in OFF status, the four-door will unlock automatically.

8. Tailgate unlocking

When the start and stop button is in OFF position, press down the remote control unlock button of backdoor for more than 1s to unlock the backdoor.

### 9. Backdoor automatic locking
`geely_coolray_en_e937ba70` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

The backdoor will automatically be locked after 1.5 seconds of closing. During the automatic re-locking process, the backdoor will also be locked.

10. Disable backdoor unlocking:

When the power supply mode is in ON status and the vehicle speed is faster than 5km/h, the unlocking of the back door will not be performed.

### 11. Prohibit remote control command
`geely_coolray_en_07cac45a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

When the power supply is in ON status, any remote commands other than the unalarm operation and the unlocking of the backdoor will not be executed.

12. Door lock motor protection against overheat

After five consecutive locking or unlocking actions with an interval of no more than 1000ms are performed, the overheat protection function of the door lock will be activated. At this point, only the collision automatic unlocking, the other unlocking requests can only be executed once, and no other locking/ unlocking requests will be executed for 20s.

### 3. Driver alarm information
`geely_coolray_en_a5f65f61` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

When the driver has some abnormal operation, the body control module will send CAN message to the instrument, and the instrument will produce buzzer warning to remind the driver. It has the following functions: issue a warning when the light is not turned off: when the power mode is OFF, the dashboard switch block will light up the headlight or position lamp. If the door at the driver's side is open, the body control module will generate an alarm signal to the instrument, and the instrument will issue an audible warning.

### 4. Automatic control of external lights
`geely_coolray_en_0dd41f27` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Follow me home function: The user sets the follow me home function and the opening time in the infotainment system. Then the infotainment system sends the setting signal to the vehicle body module. When the vehicle anti-theft system is in the relief state, within 10min of the power supply mode from ON/ACC state to OFF state, the high beam lamp flashes once to activate the follow me home function. When the follow me home function is turned on, the overtaking lamp can be operated to turn off the follow me home function, then the function cannot be activated again within 10min when the ignition state turns to be OFF. To activate the follow me home function, before the output exceeds 10min, any door (including the trunk door) is opened, and the follow me home function re-times.

### 5. Remote unlock search lamp function
`geely_coolray_en_d705afc6` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When the power supply mode is in OFF state, shortly press the remote control key-vehicle locating button twice to trigger the vehicle locating function. The horn will beep three times and the turn signal flashes three times.

### 6. Automatic lamplight
`geely_coolray_en_8666176f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When the power supply mode is in ON status and the dashboard switch block is in AUTO position, if the environment light sensor is required to light up, the position lamp relay and the headlamp relay will automatically pull in at the request of the sunlight sensor.

### 7. Turn signals
`geely_coolray_en_21024762` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Turn signal lamp system will use turn light lamp flash signals to react to various body control request. The requests coming from turn signal lamp system are mainly: left turn signal on and off, right turn signal on and off and warning lamp on and off Other requests coming from external module are mainly:

central door control, diagnosis operation, anti-theft alarm system, emergency brake and collision flash. Collision flash has the highest priority, and alarm lamp has the second highest priority.

### 1. Flashing due to collision
`geely_coolray_en_f1b4f019` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When the power mode is in the ON state, if the BCM receives a collision signal from the hardware, the front, rear, left and right turn signals will flash at the same time at a frequency of 75 times/min. Press the warning switch button once again to cancel the warning flashing function.

### 2. Warning lamp
`geely_coolray_en_eae93582` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

No matter what condition the power mode is in, press the warning switch button and the left and right turn signals will flash at the same time at a frequency of 75 times/min. Press the warning switch button once again and to cancel the warning flash function.

### 3. Steering prompt
`geely_coolray_en_5a66f220` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When the power mode is ON, turn on the left turn signal switch and the left turn signal blinks at a frequency of about 75 times/ min. When the power mode is ON, turn on the right turn signal switch and the right turn signal blinks at a frequency of about 75 times/min.

### 4. Self-diagnosis of turn signals
`geely_coolray_en_15acd870` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

In the steering state, the front and rear turn signals are LEDs. When the output current of the turn signal is less than 110 mA, it is regarded as a fault (when the LED turn signal fails, the output waveform of the fault feedback line at the turn signal terminal is opposite to the output waveform of the BCM switch); other turn signals on the same side flash about twice as often as in normal mode. When the alarm is activated, if one of the turn signals is damaged, the turn signals on both sides will flash at a frequency of about 150 times/min.

5. Lane changing lamp function:

When the turn signal lamp switch is turned on and off between 100ms and 700ms, the corresponding turn signal lamp will flash three times as a lane change signal.

6. Emergency brake alarm lamp:

If the vehicle speed (BCM obtains the speed and brake signal through CAN bus) decreases rapidly due to emergency braking, all turn signal lamps will be activated to flash. If the vehicle speed decreases quickly, the hazard warning flashing function will be canceled. (Deceleration greater than 0.55 g is regarded as an emergency brake, and the deceleration threshold can be configured in the EEPROM).

### 8. Interior lamp and power saving function
`geely_coolray_en_e6881986` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

The interior lamp system is mainly divided into two parts: one is the interior lamp control, the other is the power saving control. The interior lamp control is mainly to activate and disenable the interior lamps. The power saving control is mainly to open or disenable the power saving control relay.

1. Interior lamp:

When one of the following situations occurs, the interior dome lamp will fade in and light up after about 0.7s:

Any one of the doors opens.
Switch power supply mode from other gear to OFF state. When the power mode is in the OFF state, give an unlocking request (including the unlocking by remote control, keyless unlocking sensor of door handle, and central door locking switch).

When one of the following situations occurs, the indoor ceiling light will fade out and go out after about 1.7s:

• The power is in ON status and all doors are closed. When the power is in OFF status and all doors are closed,
send out unlocking request (including locking by remote
control, by locking switch of door handle and by central lock
door locking switch.)
The central control is in unlocking state and the power
supply mode is OFF. After the last door is closed, it is
delayed for 15s. The interior lamp is lighted up for 15s, and there is no
condition to activate it. Disenable all the doors and lock central control.

The conditions when interior dome lamp goes out immediately:

Due to door opening, the interior lamp will be turned on. After 20 minutes, the lamp will go out immediately instead of gradually.

Power saving function: When any of the following actions occur, the power saving function will be retimed:

Alteration of the status of power supply mode.
Change of the status of any door.
Issue unlock command (including the unlocking of remote control, keyless unlock sensor for door handle, and central locking switch).
When the power-saving protection starts after 20 minutes of delay, the power-saving protection relay will cut off the power supply output of the body control module.

2. Front foot lamps:

Any door is opened, the front foot lamp is turned on, and the door is closed 3 minutes after closing the door. Power supply mode is in ON status, and the foot lamp is turned off.

Lock command, and the foot lamp goes out.

If any door is opened and the foot lamp is turned on, if the door is not closed within 10 minutes, the foot lamp is turned off. Within 10 minutes, any door is opened and the timer is reset.

When the power mode is OFF, and all doors are closed, the foot lamp goes out.

### 9. Heating function
`geely_coolray_en_15290e9c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

1. Rear defroster heating function:

The voltage signal is obtained from the CAN bus. When the battery voltage is greater than 10.7V and the power supply mode is in ON status, rear defroster heating is allowed. When the detected battery voltage is less than 10.3V, rear defroster heating is not allowed to operate.

There is any body control module of CAN signal transmission on the CAN bus.

2. Sleep conditions of CAN network:

The power mode is OFF.
Start and stop button status change.
Turn signal lamp is not activated.
Smart key command is not received.
Light on alarm function is not activated.
• No change o any door status.
• No signal transmission on the CAN bus.

The rear defroster heating switch is the inching button switch. Press down the rear deforester heating switch, and rear defroster heater will heat for 12 minutes; if the switch is pressed again during the rear deforester heating, the rear defrosting process will stop. Press down the rear defroster heating switch again, and the rear defroster heater will stop heating until 12min after pressing down the rear defroster heating switch for the first time (accumulatively run for 12min). The heating time before 36min is not accumulated in the next operation.

### 10. Window control
`geely_coolray_en_74853b11` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

When the power mode is ON, the windows can be operated. When the power mode is ON, the window control is disabled when any of the following conditions is met:

1min after the power mode is OFF.
Any of the front doors is opened.

### 11. CAN network management
`geely_coolray_en_0b3aa0cc` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

1. In this model, the wake-up conditions of body control module CAN network are as follows:

Wake-up conditions of local network:

The power mode is ON.
Hazard warning switch is in ON gear.
Start and stop button status change.
Activation of light on alarm.
Receive smart key command.
Change of the status of any doors.

### 10.2.4.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_4b771e54` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before diagnosing the fault of the vehicle control system. Refer to Description and operation. Understand and familiarize yourself with the working principle of the vehicle control system, and then start system diagnosis. This will help to confirm the correct fault diagnosis steps when the fault occurs. More importantly, it can also help to confirm whether the situation described by the distributor is normal operation. Any fault diagnosis of vehicle control system should start with a routine inspection that guides the serviceman to take the next logical step for troubleshooting. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 10.2.4.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_85997a94` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Check the after-sales installations which may affect BCM and ensure that these installations cannot affect the BCM.

Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.

### 10.2.4.4 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic instrument to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the start and stop button to ON status. The diagnostic instrument is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic instrument.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_6e9e0540` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic instrument is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic instrument is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic instrument. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic instrument.

### 10.2.4.5 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 10.2.4.7 Action test table
`geely_coolray_en_dcdb36fd` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

By reading the “action test” on the fault diagnostic apparatus, working statuses of the relay and the actuator controlled by BCM can be checked with no need to remove any part and component. Before diagnosing the related faults of the control system, the motion test is the prerequisite for troubleshooting, which can shorten the troubleshooting time.

### Note
`geely_coolray_en_3a2fd8db` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Data under normal condition is listed in the following table only for reference. Do not merely judge whether some part is faulty based on these reference values. Under normal conditions, a vehicle operating normally can be used to be compared with a vehicle being diagnosed in the same status to confirm whether the data of the vehicle being diagnosed is normal in current status.

a.Engine should be at normal operating temperature.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "OFF".

c.Connect the scan tool.

d.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

### 10.2.5.1 Replacement of Body Control Module (BCM)
`geely_coolray_en_10f1a85f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Opening the engine hood

2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

3 Remove the lower left shield of instrument panel, refer to Replacement of Lower Left Shield of Instrument Desk

![](images/bb9b14d1b037ee8b667cdc88c925d5f6aafcc39db49b4cf26bcb45172f5a8b03.webp)

4 Remove the body control module a. Adjust the driver's seat backwards and adjust the steering column upward for the best operating space. b. Remove and move away 2 bolts of instrument distribution box.

![](images/6948acd58ba6e7e3ae843ee0df6ebdf67e80f0d2f2afec7b05a29822a587eb52.webp)

c. Disconnect the 5 harness connectors of the BCM.

d. Remove the 2 fixing bolts on the upper part of the BCM bracket, and take out the BCM assembly.

Installation procedure

![](images/a1bb3a79eb93e718283882e2feee9608da4d122a0f0a0aec08a8c0df2e10b2b4.webp)

1 Install the BCM

d. Place the CCU assembly, and tighten the 2 fixing bolts above the BCM bracket.
Torque: 6 N·m

b. Connect the harness connector of the BCM.

c. Install and tighten the 2 bolts of the instrument
distribution box.
Torque: 6 N·m
d. Restore the driver's seat to a suitable position and the steering column to a suitable position.
2 Install the lower left fender apron of instrument desk
3 Connect the negative cable of battery
4 Close engine compartment cover
5 For BCM control module programming, refer to Programming and Settings of Each Module of the Complete Vehicle

### 10.2.5.2 Replacement of gateway
`geely_coolray_en_d0542ec5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

2 Remove the automatic A/C controller. Refer to Replacement of Automatic A/C Controller

3 Remove the gateway

![](images/59109730866b88f67d82ce43c76c5230c7f5ba2a824f9ee93a7d8d9890e9cce5.webp)

a. Disconnect the 1 harness connector A of the gateway. b. Remove the 2 fixing screws connecting the gateway and the A/C blower housing.
c. Take off the gateway.

Installation procedure

![](images/ab4103aee5c0853792f89ba19f01f1e6fad4b51150888396c55f905577157778.webp)

1 Install the gateway. a. Move the gateway to the installation position. b. Install and tighten the 2 fixing screws connecting the gateway and the A/C blower housing.

Torque: 1.5N·m

c. Connect the harness connector A of the gateway.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_521ac5e2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.

2 Install the automatic A/C controller. 3 Connect the negative cable of battery. 4 Perform the gateway programming operation. Refer to Programming of Gateway

### 10.3.1.1 Programming precautions
`geely_coolray_en_eaf9a84f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before programming the control module, ensure that the following conditions are met:

1. The charging system shall have no fault. Before programming the control module, the fault of the charging system must be eliminated first.
2. Battery voltage should be higher than 12V but lower than 16V. If the battery voltage is too low, should be charged before programming the control module.
3. The battery charger shall not be connected to the vehicle battery. Incorrect system voltage or voltage fluctuation caused by a battery charger can lead to programming failures or damage to the control module.
4. Switch off or disable all electrical loads on a vehicle battery, such as interior lamps, daytime running lights, warm air, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems, cooling
fans, radios, etc.
5. The start and stop button should be placed in the correct position. Do not change the position of the start and stop button during programming unless indicated by the diagnostic scanner.
6. Ensure that all tools are securely connected, including the following components and circuits: Control module serial data link tester. • Connection at the diagnostic interface (DLC). • Power supply circuit
7. Do not disturb tool harness when programming. Unexpected programming interruptions can lead to
programming failures or damage to the control module.

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_7ecc94e1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

To avoid vehicle damage, serious personal injury and even death, when the main components are removed from the vehicle, and the lifter is used for support, the jack should be used to support the vehicle part corresponding to the components to be removed.

Warnings regarding battery disconnection

### Warning regarding halogen bulb
`geely_coolray_en_616ec8a7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before servicing any electrical component, the starting switch power supply mode shall be in the OFF status and all electrical loads must be “OFF (switch-off)” unless otherwise stated in the operating procedure. If tools or equipment are easily accessible to exposed live electrical terminals, disconnect the negative battery cable. Violating these safety instructions may result in personal injury and/or damage to the vehicle or vehicle components.

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_1d517af5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If a window glass is cracked but remains intact, the protective tape should be cross-pasted to the window glass to prevent further damage to the window glass and personal injury.

Warning about the express window down function

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_0e6c0e5e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

When operating the electric window switch of the driver’s door, the windows without anti-pinch control moves fast and cannot be stopped, which may lead to personal injury.

Halogen bulb contains high pressure gas. Improper handling can cause the bulb to explode into glass shards. To avoid personal injury, Before replacing the bulb, it is needed to turn off the light switch and make the bulb to cool down. Keep the light off until the bulb is replaced. Wear goggles when replacing the halogen bulb. When holding the bulb, it is important to hold the lamp base only. Avoid contact with glass. The bulb should avoid dust and moisture. Scrap the old bulbs correctly. Keep halogen bulbs away from children.

### Vehicle-mounted multimedia information entertainment system
`geely_coolray_en_dbc49d5c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

The vehicle-mounted multimedia infotainment system is mainly composed of vehicle-mounted basic terminal assembly, front central control display screen assembly, radio antenna, GPS antenna(integrated antenna for East Europe model), Bluetooth antenna, speakers (woofer, mid-frequency, tweeter, full frequency etc.), external amplifier, microphone, switch buttons related to the system on the steering wheel, and various interfaces.

It is mainly used for radio, USB audio and video playback, clock display, Bluetooth phone, GPS navigation, information display, entire vehicle settings, voice control function needs, A/C information display and settings, etc.

Emergency call system

The emergency call system is mainly composed of E-CALL switch, E-CALL external loudspeaker, GPS antenna (integrated antenna for East Europe model), collision sensor and E-CALL electronic unit.

The emergency call system is used to automatically (when a vehicle accident occurs) or manually call the emergency service operator, transmit the minimum data set containing vehicle status, position coordinates and vehicle travel time and direction, and establish the hands-free communication function between vehicle users and national operators.

When a vehicle collision occurs, the collision sensor transmits the collision signal to the E-CALL electronic unit through the CAN bus, and supplies power to the E-CALL external speaker, the system working indicator on the E-CALL switch and the microphone to establish communication with emergency call service personnel

When the emergency call button is manually turned on, the ECALL electronic unit supplies power to the E-CALL external speakers and the system working indicator lamp and microphone on the E-CALL switch to create communication with the emergency call service personnel.

GPS antenna and other control modules of the vehicle collect vehicle position and status, and transmit them to the E-CALL electronic unit through CAN bus. The E-CALL electronic unit sends vehicle information to emergency call service personnel through internal antenna.

Emergency call system switch: switch to manually enable the emergency call mode, and activate the communication function with emergency service operator when the emergency call is enabled.

External speaker of emergency call system: When receiving the signal of emergency call activation, you can clearly hear the instructions from the emergency service operator.

– E-CALL control unit: according to the collision signal of the collision sensor and the emergency call signal manually activated, the vehicle information is transmitted to the emergency service operator through the internal antenna.

GPS antenna (if equipped): obtain vehicle position information.

Indicator lamp: monitor the working status of the E-CALL system.

### 11.2.5.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_c32c0cb7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before diagnosing the audio entertainment system faults, refer to the description and operation and system working principle. Understand and be familiar with the working principle of audio entertainment system, and then start system diagnosis, which helps to determine the correct fault diagnosis steps when a fault occurs. More importantly, it helps to determine whether the condition described by the customer is normal. Any fault diagnosis of audio entertainment system should start with a routine inspection that guides the serviceman to take the next logical step for troubleshooting. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.2.5.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_77ee1125` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Check after-sale installations that may affect the operation of the audio system to ensure that they do not affect the operation of the audio system.

Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.

• For faults where all of the speakers are inoperative, focus on areas of the speaker circuit that are prone to short to GND, to facilitate quick removing the fault.

• For the fault of a single speaker inoperative, the distributor may inadvertently use the sound channel shielding function of the host/intelligent vehicle host to make a single sound channel inoperative in the process of use, which is not a fault of the sound system. You can consult the handbook for instructions of sound system.

### 11.2.5.4 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the starting switch to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a2f6e3c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic apparatus.

### 11.2.5.5 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 11.3.2.1 General
`geely_coolray_en_90e621cb` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The vehicle-mounted navigation system works relying on the audio system, the vehicle-mounted GPS and the electronic map. It can conveniently and accurately tell the driver the shortest or quickest path to the destination. It is a good helper of the driver.

GPS is the abbreviation of “Global Positioning System”, which is developed for military purpose by the United States. Its meaning is to utilize navigational satellites to measure time and distance, and thus form a global navigation system.

### 11.3.2.2 GPS system introduction
`geely_coolray_en_48b0400d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Vehicle-mounted navigation mainly has the following functions:

Retrieval of the beat route to the destination;
Instantaneous re-retrieval;
Rich menu and record function for easy retrieval;
Real-time voice prompt during appropriate time;
Extended functions.

GPS is mainly composed of three parts: space, ground control and user equipment.

### Space:
`geely_coolray_en_0be957ad` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

In the sky of 20000 km. It is evenly distributed in 6 orbital planes with an orbit angle of 55° and the distance between each orbital plane is 60°. 4 satellites are distributed in each orbit. This kind of distribution structure can ensure that more than 4 satellites can be seen at any place in the world.

When a device is connected to the audio control unit through USB, the audio control unit will automatically switch to the USB play mode.

Ground control:

For navigation and orientation, it is needed to figure out the position of the satellite first. The position of the satellite is calculated based on the movement of the satellite and its orbital parameters. The ground monitoring station observes each satellite for many years continuously. On the basis of the observed satellite status parameters, it is needed to is adjust the satellite to the predetermined orbit promptly and correct the satellite’s posture. When one of the satellites is faulty, backup satellite can also be used to cover the position.

User receiving system:

The user receiving system includes hardware such as power supply, antenna, receiver, microprocessor, control display equipment as well as internal software and data processing software package.

### 11.3.2.3 Brief introduction to extended function
`geely_coolray_en_1a5eaf0c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Radio function

Just like ordinary radios, this system has a radio function, and the storage list can store the radio station. After disconnecting the battery negative cable, the whole radio station information in the storage list will reset.

### 11.3.3.1 Positioning principle of the GPS system
`geely_coolray_en_fc62cd6a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The GPS system is used to determine user’s exact position on earth. Because each satellite orbits the earth twice a day, any region on the earth will simultaneously receive signals from more than four satellites. The computer can calculate the user’s current position in the earth coordinate system according to these signals (longitude and latitude). The three dimension positions, three dimension orientations and velocity of movement and time, and other information are calculated after the receiver received these signals. Generally, the GPS receiver will be subject to pseudo-range measuring, carrier phase measuring, satellite radio interference measuring, Doppler measuring and other measuring methods.

### 11.3.3.2 Self-discipline navigation
`geely_coolray_en_bd17d3d6` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When the driver drives the vehicle into underground tunnels, high-level buildings, highways and other hidden objects and cannot receive the signal from GPS satellites, the system can automatically enter self-discipline navigation. At this time, the vehicle speed sensor can detect vehicle speed from vehicle forward speed, and calculate vehicle forward distance from vehicle microprocessor. Gyro sensor can directly detect the change of forward direction and driving status. For instance, at the time of driving the vehicle on trench mountain pass, circular disc bridge or slip in situ sections on ski track, the error between all these curve distances and latitude and longitude coordinates of satellite navigation occurs. Only through gyro sensor detection and microprocessor calculation, can we get the correct vehicle position. But its position accuracy is much lower than GPS positioning accuracy.

### 11.3.3.3 Map matching technique
`geely_coolray_en_873c8baf` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The electronic maps recognized by the microprocessor are the data that are subject to node orientation. Because there are some errors between the position coordinates and the direction of the vehicle measured by GPS satellite navigation and self-regulating navigation devices and the actual track of the vehicle. To correct the errors between them and unify them with the route on the map, map matching technique is needed to be adopted. At this time, the microprocessor performs real-time relevant matching and automatic correction for the road error between the route of the vehicle and that of the electronic map. There are vehicle traffic trunk line, highway map and city traffic map stored in the map database. Before driving, the driver should tell the processor the city, street and place name to go through the input interface. The processor will use the signal of the satellite system and determine the orientation of the place to go according to the measured data such as speed sensor and gyroscope sensor, and indicate the best route to the place to go according to the route planning process. In the process of driving, the driver can use the display screen in the car to observe the map of the area where the vehicle is and the vehicle’s position on the map at any time on the screen. The remaining distance to the destination can be shown on the display screen. At the same time, the relevant information is also prompted to the driver through audio output and voice.

### 11.3.5.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_159b9747` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before diagnosis of faults navigation, refer to the Description and Operation and System Working Principle. Understand and be familiar with the working principle of navigation, and then start the system diagnosis. This will help to confirm the correct fault diagnosis steps when a fault occurs. More importantly, it can also help to confirm whether the situation described by the customer belongs to normal operation. Any fault diagnosis of the navigation should start with a routine inspection that guides the serviceman to take the next logical step for troubleshooting. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.3.5.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_482d582c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Check the after-sales installations that may affect operations of navigation to ensure that they cannot affect operations of navigation.

• Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.

Check the harness and harness connector to ensure that there is no sign of loosening, damage, poor contact, aging, etc.

### 11.3.5.3 System diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_92d4a8e7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

1. When the vehicle is running, the driver is requested not to watch the video, and it is strictly prohibited to operate the navigation system to avoid affecting the driving safety due to inattention.

2. At the time of running on rough roads, severe turbulence may lead to sound jumping.

3. The GPS positioning of the car entertainment navigation system will be affected by the weather and the place of use (high-rise buildings/tunnels/underpasses/woods). Most GPS cannot be positioned indoors and basements, and GPS signals cannot penetrate high-rise buildings and metal-containing car heat insulation films or similar products.

4. The GPS positioning results of the car entertainment navigation system are only for the driver’s reference. Please drive according to the actual road conditions if there is any abnormal situation.

5. The navigation electronic map data provided by the car entertainment navigation system only provides general reference and cannot provide high-precision positioning and path planning. Voice prompt and intersection information are the suggested results calculated by the best path according to the electronic map database, and the results are only for the reference of drivers, who must abide by the local traffic rules.

6. Keep the volume indicated by the voice at an appropriate level so as to be able to be aware of the conditions of the road and vehicles and ensure driving safety when driving.

7. Avoid excessive moisture and dust. Do not let the navigation control unit get wet, which will cause electric shock, fire or other damage.

8. Extremely high or extremely low temperatures can interfere with normal functions. If the vehicle motor is turned off and parked in direct sunlight or cold places for too long, the vehicle may become particularly hot or cold, and the entertainment navigation system may work abnormally in this environment. Once the temperature in the car returns to the normal range, the normal function can be restored. If it cannot be recovered, please contact an authorized after-sales service center for maintenance.

9. Please do not open the casing, disassemble the body or lubricate the rotating parts without permission, if the car entertainment navigation system fails (power failure, no image, no sound) or is in an abnormal state (foreign matter, water inflow, smoke, or peculiar smell inside). Immediately cut off the power supply and contact an authorized after-sales service center for overhaul.

### 11.3.5.4 Cautions for navigation use
`geely_coolray_en_9f251a68` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Because there are differences between vehicles, during the 1st use of the navigation system, a period of adaptive calibration is required, which can make the positioning of vehicles more accurate. During driving, the system will automatically and dynamically conduct the calibration.

2. It takes a longer time for the navigation system to receive the GPS signal and reposition the vehicle when it is started long after it was stalled. Usually, the positioning will be successful within 3 min in places with good signals.

3. In places with a masking effect on the GPS signal reception, such as a road with tall buildings on both sides, roadside with trees, under a flyover, an underground parking, and a tunnel, GPS signal cannot be received and the positioning may suffer deviation.
4. Sometimes, whether the vehicle is on an elevated road or the ground cannot be identified. The vehicle will be correctly repositioned after the roads diverge.
5. To avoid excessive invalid voices, there is no voice prompt in some turn roads: If there is no fork junction or roads at the fork are of significantly different levels.
6. While turning, if there is a parallel road (leading to the same direction) next to the target road, the voice will prompt “Turn to Y at the Xth junction” to help the driver select the correct turning road. Side road are frequently seen. The prompt will regard a side road intersection as an intersection, too.
7. While they vehicle is counting the roads, inputting the address, switching among languages, switching between the day and night modes, searching point of interest, or performing multimedia search operation, lots of system resources and a certain period of waiting are required. It is suggested not to ignite, switch among interfaces, plug/unplug the SD card or perform other operations during this period, otherwise, the system stability will be affected and the system will be reactivated in severe cases.

### 1. FM radio function
`geely_coolray_en_ffe578e5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

With FM radio function, users can select their own favorite channels. Users can save their favorite frequency rate to preset channels, totally 6 preset channels are provided. When users introduce frequency rate by other means, in case the current FM or AM frequency rate is the same as the preset channel frequency rate, the corresponding preset channel number will be displayed. After the battery negative cable is disconnected, all radio information in the storage list is cleared.

### 2. Bluetooth telephone
`geely_coolray_en_4f5c15c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The system is equipped with bluetooth chip, which supports wireless bluetooth technology. It can connect the surrounding bluetooth devices wirelessly and realize the telephone handsfree function.

### 11.4.2.1 Instructions and operation of exterior lighting system
`geely_coolray_en_e0943163` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

Headlamp

The headlamp is controlled by the multi-functional control lever on the left of steering column. When the headlamp switch is turned to the first position, the position lamp, license plate lamp and fascia lamp will be illuminated. When the headlamp switch is turned to the second position, all lamps mentioned above will be lightened. The headlamp will be lightened, too. When the switch turns to OFF position, all lamps are switched off.

The high beam and low beam of the headlamp are also controlled by this control lever. When the headlamp is switched on, push the control lever forward away from the driver until a sound of click is heard. Then the low beam is switched to high beam. When the headlamp high beam is switched on, the indicator lamp on the instrument pack assembly is illuminated. Pull back the control lever toward the driver. Then the high beam is switched to low beam. If continue to pull the control lever toward the driver, the low beam can still become the high beam. But when your hand is released, the control lever will return to low beam position automatically.

The headlamp must undergo beam calibration to achieve proper road lighting. When new headlamp assembly is being installed or the headlamp assembly or its mounting seat is influenced by the maintenance of front area possibly, the beam of headlamp should be checked and calibrated.

### Headlamp on reminding buzzer
`geely_coolray_en_e927cbfc` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

When the headlamp switch is in the headlamp ON position or position lamp ON position and the starting switch is in the OFF position at the same time, the body control module monitors the status of the driver door. If the left front door is opened, the body control module will make the buzzer sound. At the same time, the instrument will display icon and text to prompt the driver that the lamp is not turned off. If the headlamp is turned off, the BCM will not detect that the headlamp switch is on and the buzzer will not sound.

Position lamp and turn signal lamp

Turn the lighting switch to the first position, the position lamp will be illuminated. Operate the starting switch to turn the power mode to OFF. The position lamp will be switched off. When turn signal lamp is enabled, the front/rear turn signal lamps and side turn signal lamp flash to give a turning signal. Turn signal lamp only works when the power is under ON status. Turn signal lamp is controlled by the lamp switch on the left of steering column. Pull up or pull down the control lever (beyond the stop point). The front/rear turn signal lamps and side turn signal lamp will be illuminated. After turning is completed, the control lever returns to horizontal position. The turn signal lamp will stop flashing.

During lane changes or a small turning, the turn signal may not be canceled due to small rotating angle of steering wheel. Therefore, only turn signal control lever to a stop point and remain in the position. When the control lever is released and returns to horizontal position, the turn signal will be cancelled.

When remote anti-theft system is working, BCM can control the turn signal indicator lamp to flash to indicate the working status of the remote anti-theft system.

Rear fog lamp

The rear fog lamp switch is located on the multi-function lever on the left side of the steering column. On the premise that the low beam lamp are turned on, press the rear fog lamp switch to turn on the rear fog lamps, and then press the rear fog lamp switch again to turn off the rear fog lamps. The rear fog lamp is mainly turned on in rain, fog, and snow weather, with poor line of view, and the control signal of the rear fog lamp is sent by BCM.

### Rear combination lamp
`geely_coolray_en_c0a6865f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The rear combination lamp on the tail gate side adopt a through-type tailgate lamp. The rear position lamps are turned on when the position lamps are switched on. The reverse lamp will turn on when the shift lever is in Reverse gear. The reverse lamp is turned on and off by a command from the BCM.

Central high-mounted brake lamp

Central high-mounted brake lamp is located in the middle of rear spoiler. It will be illuminated when the brake pedal is applied.

License plate lamp

License plate lamp will be illuminated when the headlamp or the position lamp is illuminated. The license plate lamp is mounted above the license plate.

### 11.4.2.2 Instructions and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_7adece7d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

Internal courtesy lamp

The courtesy lamp and switch are on the front reading lamp. Press the courtesy switch, you can switch the interior courtesy lamp to the door-control state, the courtesy switch will send the signal to the BCM, and the BCM will turn on the reading lamp after receiving the signal.

Light: When the four doors are closed, the interior courtesy lamp will gradually turn on after stalling. When the four doors are closed, after receiving the unlocking command, the interior courtesy lamp will turn on gradually. When any door is opened, the interior courtesy lamp will turn on gradually.

Turn off: When the four doors are closed, the interior courtesy lamp goes out gradually after starting. When the four doors are closed, when the locking command is received, the interior courtesy lamp goes out gradually.

Reading lamp

Front and rear reading lamps are on the headlining, and interior lamp switches are on the front and rear reading lamps. Press the interior lamp switch to turn on or off the corresponding interior lamp.

Trunk lamp

The trunk lamp is located on the trim panel of the left side of rear compartment. Open the tail gate, and the trunk lamp will automatically turn on, and it will automatically turn off when the tail gate is closed.

Ambient lamp

Ambient lamps are located on the four doors and the right trim panel of instrument panel to create a night indoor atmosphere and assist interior lighting. The brightness of ambient lamp can be controlled through the backlight adjustment knob on the left switch of the instrument panel.

Glove box lamp

The glove box lamp will automatically go on when the glove box is opened and will automatically go out when the glove box is closed.

Foot lights

The foot lamp is located on the lower shield of the instrument panel above the feet of the driver and front passengers. The starting switch is in the OFF gear. If any door is opened, the foot lamp will light up for several minutes.

### 11.4.2.3 Comfortable Lighting Control Function
`geely_coolray_en_6c04cba8` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Follow me home function

Within 10 minutes after the starting switch is adjusted from ON/ACC to OFF, the high beam lamp flashes once, that is, the Follow Me Home function is activated, and the low beam lamp is lit. With the Follow Me Home function activated, toggle the overtaking lamp switch again to turn off the Follow Me Home function. When the Follow Me Home function is activated, the timer is 30s (the time can be set to 30s, 60s, 90s on the multimedia display). The Follow Me Home function is automatically turned off after the timing is over. If you turn the overtaking lamp switch again, the Follow Me Home function can be reactivated.

Automatic lamplight

When the ignition switch is set to the ON position, the intelligent headlamp system can automatically switch between position lamps and low beam lamps on and off according to ambient lamp. The ambient lamp sensor converts the ambient lamp intensity into an electrical signal and sends it to the BCM. When the ambient lamp intensity meets the light opening conditions, the BCM sends a control command to automatically turn on the position lamps and low beam lamp. When the ambient lamp becomes strong and the light switchoff conditions are met, the BCM sends out a control command to automatically turn off the position lamps and low beam lamp.

Bulb inspection function

Under turning status, if one of directional indicators is damaged, other directional indicators of the same side flash at a double-frequency in normal mode.

Fade-in lightening function

External condition of BCM controlling interior lamp is that the interior lamp switch is shifted to “DOOR” mode.

If one of following conditions is met, interior dome lamp will fade-in lighten within about 0.7s：

– Any one of doors is open Operate the starting switch to place the power to OFF status Operate the starting switch to place the power to OFF status, release unlock request (including remote control and internal)

Fade-in shut off function

External condition of BCM controlling interior lamp is that the interior lamp switch is shifted to “DOOR” mode.

When one of the following situations occurs, the interior dome lamp will fade-out shut off after about 1.7s.

Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON", and close all doors.

When operating the starting switch to set the power mode to OFF and all doors are closed, issue an locking request (including remote and internal requests)

The central control door is unlocked, and the starting switch is operated to make the power mode OFF. After the last door is closed, it is delayed for 15 seconds

The interior lamp is lit for 15 seconds within 15 seconds after the last door is closed, and there is no condition to activate it again

– All doors are closed and the central control is locked Intelligent High Beam Control System (IHBC)

IHBC system can automatically toggle between high and low beam at night. Based on the light source information detected by the camera above the front windshield, the system automatically toggles between high beam and low beam according to the light of vehicles in the same or opposite direction, as well as the ambient lamp. Under normal circumstances, this function automatically toggles the high beam to low beam when the headlamps of the oncoming vehicle, the taillights of the forward preceding vehicle or other light sources are detected to avoid the glare of high beam to surrounding traffic participants. After the vehicles meet, overtake or there is no ambient light source around, the low beam is automatically toggled to high beam.

### 11.4.2.3 Comfortable Lighting Control Function
`geely_coolray_en_e8cf0ad2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

After IHBC system is activated, if all the following conditions are met, the IHBC system will recommend to turn on the high beam:

Vehicle speed ≥ 40 km/h

– Relevant traffic participants or other light sources are not detected.

If any of the following conditions are met, the active high beam control system will recommend to turn on the low beam:

Vehicle speed ≤ 25 km/h Relevant traffic participants or other light sources are detected.

### 11.4.3.1 System working principles
`geely_coolray_en_d42c1e39` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Working principles of the headlamp

When the lamp combination switch is at “headlamp”, the working voltage is driven by the lamp combination switch harness connector output to pull in the headlamp relay to light the headlamp. The power supply voltage of the headlamp is transmitted to the optical axis adjustment switch of the headlamp and the optical axis adjustment motor of the right and left headlamps. At this time, toggle the adjustment switch up and down to adjust the signal voltage of the motor to realize the height adjustment function of the headlamp.

### Too frequent toggling of the key may cause damage or no operation to the motor.
`geely_coolray_en_4dbf5758` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

In case BCM (body control module) detects the voltage of the lamp combination switch harness connector, it indicates that the switch is at “AUTO” (automatic lamp). At this time, BCM detects signals from the ambient light sensor. If the ambient lighting is not strong, BCM will drive the headlamp relay to pull in through harness connector output voltage and automatically light up the headlamp. In case the ambient lighting is intensified, BCM will cut off the voltage output of the harness connector to realize the automatic switch-off of the headlamp. In case the lamp combination switch is switched into the high beam position, it will control the grounding to drive the high beam lamp relay to pull in and light up the high beam lamp through the harness connector 1, meanwhile the supply voltage of the high beam lamp is transmitted to the instrument to lighten up the high beam indicator in the instrument.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_88f1f9d2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The working voltage of the high beam lamp relay comes from the headlamp power supply circuit.

Working principles of the position lamp

When the lamp combination switch is at “position lamp”, the switch signal drives the position lamp relay to pull in through the harness connector terminal output working voltage to light up all position lamps, instrument backlight lamp, and left and right license lamp.

### Working principles of the daytime running lamp
`geely_coolray_en_0a8ec3c7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

BCM harness connector terminal output control signal to light up the daytime running lamp. At the same time, the signal is sent to the instrument to light up the daytime running lamp indicator.

### Working principles of the rear fog lamp
`geely_coolray_en_df78d7a1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When the current low beam or high beam is turned on, the switch controls the position lamp relay to work and delivers the driving power to the rear fog lamp relay. When the rear fog lamp switch is closed, the switch provides the voltage output from the position lamp relay to drive the rear fog lamp relay to close and light the rear fog lamp. At the same time, this voltage is transmitted to the rear fog lamp indicator lamp after the instrument is turned on.

Working principles of the turn signal lamp

A multi-functional control lever controls the grounding circuit of the lamp combination switch harness connector terminal and the grounding signal is sent to BCM. BCM lights up the left and right turn signal lamps through harness connector output voltage.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_73f6f4aa` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:electrical | p:1

When the hazard warning lamp button is pressed down, BCM outputs the voltage to these two circuits and lights up all turn signal lamps.

Working principles of the brake lamp

The brake lamp is controlled by the brake lamp switch placed on the brake pedal. When the brake pedal is depressed, the working voltage is directly applied to the brake lamp through the switch.

Working principles of the reverse lamp

Electron gear shifting harness connector output working voltage drives the reverse lamp relay to pull in and lights up the reverse lamp. The reverse gear information of the instrument is received and displayed through the CAN network.

Working principles of the interior door lamp

When the front row reading lamp switch is at DOOR, the power supply of the front row reading lamp comes from the BCM harness connector. When the door is open, the grounding circuit of the courtesy switch is connected to light up the front row reading lamp.

The power supply of the courtesy lamp comes from the fuse. When the door is open, the grounding circuit of the courtesy switch is connected to light up the courtesy lamp.

The power supply of the luggage compartment lamp comes from the fuse. When the luggage compartment door is open, the grounding circuit of the courtesy switch is connected to light up the luggage compartment lamp.

### 11.4.6.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_41ad32a7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Refer to the Description and Operation and System Working Principle before diagnosing the fault of the lighting system. Understand and familiarize yourself with the operating principle of the lighting system before starting a system diagnosis, which will help to determine the correct fault diagnostic procedures when a fault occurs. More importantly, it will help to determine whether the situation described by the customer is subject to normal operation. Any fault diagnosis of lighting system should start with a routine inspection that guides the serviceman to take the next logical step for troubleshooting. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.4.6.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_039ab74d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Check after-sale installations that may affect the operation of the lighting system to ensure that they do not affect the operation of the lighting system.
Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.
• If only one bulb is inoperative, check and repair the power supply or poor contact or open circuit fault at the grounding circuit before replacing the bulb.

### 11.4.6.5 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the starting switch to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a2f6e3c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic apparatus.

### 11.4.6.6 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 11.4.6.26 Light adjustment of front combination lamp
`geely_coolray_en_219bc75e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:fuel_ev | p:1

Equipment and site preparation Tools: Phillips screwdriver or hexagon wrench. Tape measure or laser rangefinder (electronic ruler). Site: The dark environment site shall be level and flat, the size shall allow the vehicle to enter, and the distance between the reference center of the headlamp and the screen should be at least 10m.

Test screen: thick white paper or white wall (for easy observation of the light shape, the width of the test screen should be ≥2m wider than the vehicle).

Vehicle preparation

• The tires shall be inflated according to the full load pressure specified in the technical conditions of the complete vehicle.

2. Vehicle is refilled with fuel, engine coolant, washer fluid and lubrication oil, and provided with all accessories and tools for the test vehicle (spare tyre, tools, etc.). Refilling means that the fuel tank is filled with no less than 90 percent of its volume.

• A 75Kg load is placed on the driver's seat to simulate the driver's sitting state.

• Prior to measurement, the vehicle shall be in a state of natural stillness. The vehicle shall travel backward at least one wheel circumference distance, and then travel forward the same distance.

Make sure the exterior covers of the headlamps are clean.

Start the vehicle.

Low beam measurement

1. Park the vehicle as shown in the figure, and the distance L between the reference center of the headlamp and the screen is 10m.

![](images/6d1d3351fee7edcb81eae20818841cd94dac8636b6a5281a3c425c65ef71eebc.webp)

2. To turn on the headlamps, first turn the ESC switch to 3rd gear, and then turn it to 0th gear to adjust the light.

3. Draw Line O, Line A, Line A1, Line A2, Line B, Line B1 and Line B2 on the screen.

![](images/0db5aeda9059913bdb1d460a78410522b92340af7881fcca02fe6994f2930be3.webp)

– Line O: Draw a vertical line in the center of the test screen aligned with the center of the vehicle.

– Line A: Draw a line to the left of Line O, parallel to Line O, with a distance of 727.5 mm from Line O (solid red line).

– Line A1: Draw a line to the left of Line A, parallel to Line A, with a distance of 60mm from Line A (dashed red line).

– Line A2: Draw a line to the right of Line A, parallel to Line A, with a distance of 60mm from Line A (dashed red line).

– Line B: Draw a line to the right of Line O, parallel to Line O, with a distance of 727.5 mm from Line O (solid red line).

– Line B1: Draw a line to the left of Line B, parallel to Line B, with a distance of 60mm from Line B (dashed red line).

– Line B2: Draw a line to the right of Line B, parallel to Line B, with a distance of 60mm from Line B (dashed red line).

4. Draw Line h1 and Line h2 on the screen.

Line h1: Draw a horizontal line parallel to the ground at a distance of 744mm from the ground. Line h2: Draw a horizontal line parallel to the ground at a distance of 704mm from the ground.

5. Complete all lines to form the green box shown in the figure.

![](images/3f090415770f0a2b4f4b50475885be21279e52ca00613cd468f9d4f707ed709d.webp)

### 11.4.6.26 Light adjustment of front combination lamp
`geely_coolray_en_4e63b465` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Low beam adjustment

1. Low beam adjustment a.Turn on the low beam lamp.

b.Left beam: insert a Phillips screwdriver or hexagon wrench into the beam leveling port of the low beam. Rotate the low beam adjustment handle 1 to adjust the low beam vertically (up and down); rotate the low beam adjustment handle 2 to adjust the low horizontally (left and right), as shown in the figure below:

### Note
`geely_coolray_en_150eea42` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Adjust the lights on the right with the same method as that on the left.

Caution

In order to observe the effect of light adjustment, the light on one side may be adjusted while the light on the other side is shielded.

![](images/23c823475c9cdc5aedcc80bb52f310f099a5f3b2b0b6bfaffa3c86fd90bc23c5.webp)

1. Adjustment of low beam at vertical (up and down) direction

2. Adjustment of low beam at horizontal (left and right) direction

c. It is required that the turning point of the low beam cut-off line is located within the frame, and the light adjustment is completed, as shown in the figure below:

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_6b988ba1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

After commissioning, the light height on left and right sides should be consistent.

![](images/2701cb51bc4d24b885b4d56da544c97c243d5a2f1d2ed5330a5946f59fe46564.webp)

![](images/f1f5e2147d3115b6cfbb2570e19f2166ffe44a47334463e4c4e38cd9827bb60a.webp)

2. To turn on the headlights, first turn the ESC switch to 3rd gear, and then turn it to 0th gear to adjust the light.

3. Turn on the high beam switch.

4. Draw Line O, Line A, Line A1, Line A2, Line B, Line B1 and Line B2 on the screen.

![](images/bc429c2342be7ce4d3fabf5c62d3f1ca1313beeb526be6e64c00fb3c85f27ef4.webp)

Line O: Draw a vertical line in the center of the test screen aligned with the center of the vehicle.

– Line A: Draw a line to the left of Line O, parallel to Line O, with a distance of 589.5 mm from Line O (solid red line).

– Line A1: Draw a line to the left of Line A, parallel to Line A, with a distance of 60mm from Line A (dashed red line).

– Line A2: Draw a line to the right of Line A, parallel to Line A, with a distance of 60mm from Line A (dashed red line).

– Line B: Draw a line to the right of Line O, parallel to Line O, with a distance of 589.5 mm from Line O (solid red line).

– Line B1: Draw a line to the left of Line B, parallel to Line B, with a distance of 60mm from Line B (dashed red line).

– Line B2: Draw a line to the right of Line B, parallel to Line B, with a distance of 60mm from Line B (dashed red line).

5. Draw Line h1 and Line h2 on the screen.

– Line h1: Draw a horizontal line parallel to the ground at a distance of 776mm from the ground. – Line h2: Draw a horizontal line parallel to the ground at a distance of 745mm from the ground.

6. Complete all lines to form the green box shown in the figure.

![](images/c50b4b36988b2c720dd2875efd3c2b274a2d9a5a93ec29d00d0649cd374b0aaa.webp)

### 11.4.7.1 Replacement of Switch Block on the Instrument Panel
`geely_coolray_en_f3ca1780` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to

Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery

Cable

Caution

Disconnect the negative battery terminal for more than 90s and wait for the airbag capacitor to be fully discharged before disassembly. Insufficient discharge may cause an accidental detonation of airbag during disassembly and injuring the operators.

2 Remove the steering wheel assembly. Refer to Replacement of steering wheel assembly

3 Remove the lower cowl of the steering column. Refer to Replacement of the lower cowl of the steering column

4 Remove the switch block of instrument panel

![](images/61ea408c13ae37d1b275169b22ed19c7cf867dcdb1386d870a6ba498b5aeec1b.webp)

a. Disconnect the 2 harness connectors A of the switch block on the instrument panel.
b. Remove the 1 fixing bolt 1 on the clamp of the
instrument panel switch block.
c. Take off the switch block of instrument panel.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_9e734079` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

After removing the switch block of instrument panel, it is strictly forbidden to turn the coil cable at will.

![](images/5e0e622b361b2fcfbcc5eb9a6758dd45c22522cae3683da7e9b43c95e51779e2.webp)

Install the switch block of instrument panel

a. Move the switch block of instrument panel to the
installation position.
b. Install and tighten the fixing bolt on the clamp of the switch block of instrument panel.
Torque:6N·m
c. Connect the 2 harness connectors A of the switch block on the instrument panel.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_65bf5cb3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.

2 Install the lower cowl of the steering column.
3 Install the steering wheel assembly.
4 Connect the negative cable of battery.
