### 11.5.2.1 Instructions and operations
`geely_coolray_en_d338b96d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Instruction and operation of door glass regulator

The door glass lift has the following four kinds of operating methods: manual up, manual down, auto up, and auto down. Without anti-pinch function, the lifter has the following three operation modes: manual up, automatic down and manual down.

Manual up

Slightly pull the manual-up gear of the door glass regulator switch and hold it, letting the corresponding motor of the door glass lift operate to make window glasses move upwards; release the switch to let window glasses stop moving.

– Manual down

Slightly press the manual-down gear of the door glass regulator switch and hold it, letting the corresponding motor of the door glass lift operate to make vehicle window glasses move downwards; release the switch to let window glasses stop moving.

The window lifting function is disabled when any of the following conditions is met:

1. 45s after the start-and-stop switch is turned off..

2. Any front door is opened.

– Auto up

Fully pull up the front left door window lifter switch (pull and hold for more than 500 ms), and the front left window will automatically rise to the highest position, or rise until the switch is pressed down or pulled up again, the operations of the remaining windows are the same.

– Auto down

Fully press down the front left door window lifter switch (press and hold for more than 500 ms), the front left window will automatically drop to the bottom, or drop until the switch is pressed or pulled up again, and the operations of the remaining windows are the same.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_0e075833` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

During automatic rise or drop of the window, if the glass regulator switch is pulled up or pressed down for more than 500ms, the window will be in the manual raising or lowering mode; if the UP or DOWN button of the FL window regulator switch is pressed for no more than 500ms, the window will stop running.

– Anti-pinch function (if equipped)

When the driver operates the glass lift switch, and the motor exceeds the blocking current(12V) during operation, the motor will move in the opposite direction after stopping for 100ms.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_6658ad67` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

1. If some vehicle window has not been initialized or lost its initialization, it has no auto-up function. At this time, the anti-pinch function loses efficacy.
2. The anti-pinch function only can be used in the auto-up mode of a vehicle window. Comfort switch-off function (if equipped)

Comfort switch-off automatically closes vehicle windows through LIN communication. Once receiving a comfort switch-off command, all vehicle windows will move upwards in turns until they arrive at the travel destination (Vehicle window full switch-off position). Starting order and delay requirement will be achieved by software. During the comfort switch-off period, signals from the vehicle window switch will be neglected and the anti-pinch function will stay at activation status.

Motor protection switch-off (if equipped with anti-pinch function)

If the continuous operating time of a motor exceeds 20s, the control module is switched off and loses initialization.

– Adaptive learning (if equipped with anti-pinch function)

When a window suffers from any of the following situations, self-learning of the anti-pinch power window is required:

The automatic gear of the window switch fails or works
abnormally;
• The anti-pinch function does not work properly; Close windows with the smart key, and the windows will
open automatically after they are fully closed;
The smart key cannot open/close windows; Replace glass lifter, window rubber strips, etc., but do not
replace the factory anti-pinch module.

The self-learning steps are as follows:

Pull up the window switch to fully close the window. After releasing the window switch, pull up the window switch again and hold it for more than 2 seconds.
After pressing down on the window switch to fully open the window, pull up the window switch to completely close the window.
After opening the window, perform an automatic window closing operation.

If the window automatically closes to the fully closed position, self-learning is completed, and the window has automatic closing and anti-pinch functions; otherwise, repeat the above steps.

Software thermal protection (if equipped with anti-pinch function)

The control module provides protection through a thermal protection algorithm to prevent lifting motor from overheating. When thermal protection procedures are triggered in the antipinch period, the system will complete reverse operating actions of the vehicle window but will neglect any upwards new vehicle window command until the motor is completely cooled.

Description and operation of exterior rearview mirror

The exterior rearview mirrors are electronically controlled by a switch on the driver's door. The left and right selector switches select the rearview mirror to be operated, and the direction button switch is used to adjust the position of the rearview mirror glass.

There is also a heating element in the mirrored glass of the exterior rearview mirrors. The exterior mirror heating elements will also work when the rear windshield defrosting switch is pressed.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_adefb841` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Front windshield glass heating

The heating function of the front windshield glass is that the system controls the front windshield heating components to realize the windshield heating in cold environment, so as to prevent the mist and icing, and ensure safe travelling.

The front windshield heating system consists of the heating resistance wire, heating drive module, and heating control soft switch(integrated on the multimedia screen).

### 11.5.3.1 Power supply management
`geely_coolray_en_13eefefc` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The left front door glass lifter and the left rear door glass lifter share one power supply (30 A).

The right front door glass lifter and the right rear door glass lifter share one power supply (30 A).

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_ad9dd0e1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The four window lifter switches are under small current control high current, and have an overload current protection function: the four window lift motors all have a continuous output 8s protection function.

### 11.5.3.2 Front windshield heating function principle
`geely_coolray_en_bfebc514` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The principle of heating the front windshield is to heat the glass by energizing the resistance wire embedded in the glass. The front windshield heating can be turned on/off through the soft switch of the multimedia screen. When the driver operates the multimedia screen front windshield heating on switch, the front windshield heating on signal is transmitted to the driver infotainment host, which transmits the front windshield heating signal to the front heating module through CAN communication. The front heating module receives the signal and connects the front windshield heating resistance wire circuit to heat the front windshield. The maximum heating time for a single activation is 20 minutes

Function opening conditions:

The front windshield heating output terminal is high; Voltage range 9\~16V; The heating time of the front nozzle does not exceed 20min Engine start

Function closing conditions:

Receive the multimedia screen front windshield heating switch off signal;

– The front windshield heating output terminal is not high; – The voltage is less than 8.5V or greater than 16.5V; The maximum activation time of a single time exceeds 20min; The engine does not start.

### 11.5.7.5 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the starting switch to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a2f6e3c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic apparatus.

### 11.5.7.6 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 11.5.7.7 Initialization of glass lifter
`geely_coolray_en_945dc976` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

To initialize the system, the glass must be lifted fully to the top and the switch must remain in the up status until the control module stops the glass lifter motor (with the window at the top of the block for 1s). Each time the system loses initialization, the above operation must be repeated to restore the anti-clamp function.

After initialization, all the specified system functions must be operational.

During initialization, the voltage on the control module must not drop below 9V.
• When the power supply voltage on the control module drops momentarily but is still greater than 6V, the initialized state remains effective.
Every time the window is in auto up mode until it stops automatically (at full top position), the system will get the latest full top position value and overwrite the previous value to calculate the full top position.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_197a4677` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. The original value is overwritten only if the new value is within the calibrated value range; otherwise, the new value will be ignored by the control module.
2. Auto up, anti-clamp, and comfort switch off functions are not provided if the initialization procedure has not been executed or is lost. Manual up, down and auto down functions are still available.

Initialization will be lost when the following situations occur (if anti-clamp function is equipped)

The power supply is cut off.
When the lifter moves, the power supply voltage drops below 6V.
The control module detected an illogical Hall sensor signal.

### 11.5.7.8 Driver side glass lifter does not work
`geely_coolray_en_0cad6768` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:electrical | p:1

4. Diagnosis steps

Step 1 Use diagnostic apparatus to read the trouble code.

A. Connect the diagnostic apparatus to the DLC.
B. Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON". Read the trouble code of the control system again to confirm whether the system has output a DTC.

No

Refer to Intermittent Fault Detection

![](images/495417bd713da57e2b3096023672aa3c2beee763c54021fab542862ebd563d3b.webp)

A. Check the driver side glass lifter motor, driver side door glass lifter switch and BCM harness connectors for damage, poor contact, aging, loosening and other signs.
B. Check components for obvious scratches or damage.

Yes

Yes

### 11.5.8.8 Replacement of second row door window lifter assembly
`geely_coolray_en_1641f215` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Open the engine hood
2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
3 Open doors Remove the internal trim panel of the rear door, refer to Replacement of the internal trim panel of the rear door

![](images/de0acc26bbd50766eef6b15948b3041a81f91ef4ad20b24ffae2c4626984cdd1.webp)

5 Disconnect the rear glass regulator assembly a. Uncover the door waterproof membrane. b. Remove the 2 bolts connecting the rear door glass and the rear door glass lifter.

c. Disconnect the rear door glass lifter motor harness connector. d. Remove the 3 nuts of the rear door glass lifter motor and the 4 nuts of the rear door glass lifting run channel, take off the rear door glass lifter assembly, and sink the rear door glass to the bottom of the door sheet metal.

Installation procedure

![](images/3aa8b37a192278f3d38ddd07dbe1a683e51c1b01c05683e976db76690e288366.webp)

1 Install the rear glass regulator assembly a. Install the rear door glass lifter assembly, install and tighten the 3 nuts of the rear door glass lifter motor and the 4 nuts of the rear door glass lifting run channel. Torque: 9 N m b. Connect the rear door glass lifter motor harness connector.

c. Install the 2 bolts connecting the rear door glass and the rear door glass lifter. d. Paste door waterproof membrane.

2 Install the rear door interior trim panel.
3 Close doors
4 Connect the negative cable of battery
5 Close engine compartment cover

11.5.8.9 Replacement of rear door window Removal procedure

1 Open the engine hood
2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
3 Open doors
4 Remove the rear door glass lifter, refer to Replacement of the rear door glass lifter

### 11.6.2.1 Instructions and operations
`geely_coolray_en_35ccdf39` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The wiper/washer system consists of the following parts:

– Body control module (BCM)
Wiper/washer switch
Front washer fuse
– Washer fluid reservoir
– Front wiper motor and connecting rod
– Washer fluid pump
– Front wiper arm
– Washer nozzle
– Rear wiper motor assembly
– Rear wiper arm assembly

The wiper/washer can realize four control modes: high speed, low speed, clearance and inching. The wiper switch is set on the control lever on the right side of the steering column.

Front wiper/washer system

The front wiper system consists of wiper/washer switch, wiper motor, connecting rod, wiper arm and wiper blades. In the front wiper circuit, there is an automatic-stop device which consists of a worm gear and a cam disc, so as to keep the circuit intact for a short time after the wiper/washer switch is turned off, and do not disconnect the circuit until the wiper arm is fully returned to the initial position. The wiper system is driven by permanent magnetic motor. The wiper motor is installed on the front wall, connected with the front wiper linkage directly. The wiper switch is an integral part of the wiper/washer system.

### Rear wiper/washer system
`geely_coolray_en_34cad564` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

The rear wiper system consists of wiper/washer switch, wiper motor, wiper arm and wiper blades. The rear wiper motor is of high current type, the BCM will be turned off immediately, and the rear wiper will return under the self-return mechanism. There is an automatic return unit in the rear wiper circuit, which is composed of a worm gear and a cam disc. Its purpose is to still maintain the circuit completeness temporarily after the wiper/washer switch is turned off, and break the circuit until the wiper arm completely returns to the initial position. The wiper motor is installed in the rear door panel and is directly connected with the rear wiper connecting rod. The wiper switch is an integral part of the wiper/washer system.

Windshield washer system

The windshield washer system is composed of glass washing fluid, fluid reservoir, washer fluid pump, hose, nozzle and wiper/washer switch. The washer fluid reservoir of windshield is installed under the front right headlamp assembly, at front of front right wing liner. Washer fluid pump is fixed on the washer fluid reservoir. The washer fluid pump sends the washer fluid to front and rear nozzles through hose. Washer switch is also a component of wiper/washer switch.

Washer nozzle heating

The heating function of the washer nozzle is that the system controls the washer nozzle heating components to realize the washer nozzle heating in cold environment, so as to prevent the icing of the washer nozzle.

The washer nozzle heating system consists of the heating resistance wire, heating drive module, and heating control soft switch etc. (integrated on the multimedia screen).

### Front wiper
`geely_coolray_en_60c8aed3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The front wiper switch provides signal to BCM and BCM receives the grounding signal to drive the rotation of front wiper motor. When the wiper switch is in a low gear, the current flows from the low speed brush of the motor into the armature coil, generating a large counter electromotive force, and resulting in the motor rotating at a low speed. When the wiper switch is in a high gear, the current flows from the high speed brush of the motor into the armature coil, generating a small counter electromotive force, and resulting in the motor rotating at a high speed. When the wiper washer switch is turned on, the wiper spray pump is in working status, and after the washer switch is operated continuously, the wiper motor starts to rotate in a low gear. When the wiper switch is turned off, the wiper motor will not stop immediately and continue to rotate for a while under the inertia of the armature. Meanwhile, the armature generates counter electromotive force, which will generate electric brake on the wiper motor and the motor will stop at the fixed position immediately. The working principle of rear wiper is similar to that of front wiper.

### Washer nozzle heating
`geely_coolray_en_b786bf93` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The heating principle of the washer nozzle is to heat the washer nozzle by energizing the resistance wire pre-embedded in the wiper nozzle, as the energization will produce heat. The washer nozzle heating function can be turned on/off through the soft switch of the multimedia screen. When the driver operates the washer nozzle heating start switch on the multimedia screen, the washer nozzle heating start signal is transmitted to the driving infotainment system. Then, the driving infotainment system transmits the heating signal to the front heating module through CAN communication. The front heating module turns on the washer nozzle heating resistance wire circuit after receiving the signal, and heats the washer nozzle. The single activated heating lasts for 200s to the maximum.

Function activation condition:

The output end of the washer nozzle heating is at the high level;

– Voltage range is within 10.7-16V;
– The front nozzle heating time is not more than 200s.

Function deactivation condition:

– Receive an OFF signal of the multimedia screen steering wheel heating switch;

– The output end of the washer nozzle heating is not at the high level;

– Voltage is lower than 10.3V or higher than 16.5V;
– The single maximum activation time exceeds 200s;
– Washer nozzle is in short circuit.

### 11.6.7.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_45b04cb4` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before diagnosis of wipers/cleaning system, refer to description and operation and system working principle. Understand and familiarize yourself with working principle of wiper/ cleaning system before starting system diagnosis. This helps to determine the DTC steps when a fault occurs. More importantly, it also helps to determine whether the situation described by the distributor is normal. Any fault diagnosis of wiper/washing system should start with a routine inspection that guides the serviceman to take the next logical step for troubleshooting. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.6.7.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_8b2410eb` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

• Check after-sales installations that may affect the operation of front windshield wiper/washer system to ensure that these installations do not affect the operation of front windshield wiper/washer system.

. Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.

Check and confirm that the washer liquid level of washer fluid tank is normal.

### 11.6.7.5 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the starting switch to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a2f6e3c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic apparatus.

### 11.6.7.6 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:electrical | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 11.6.8.1 Replacement of front wiper blade
`geely_coolray_en_f82e2660` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

![](images/3fc86fc77fe8315cacd66754c9dcd1d172030cbfe1ec9bcda3ef087043962fb0.webp)

Remove the front wiper blade
a. Within 30 seconds after the starting switch is shifted from ON to OFF before removal, pull the front wiper switch downward to the inching brush position to execute the front wiper maintenance mode.
b. Press and hold the fixing clip and slide the front wiper blade downward along the front wiper arm.
c. Take off the front wiper blade.

Installation procedure

![](images/e30f6dec639d83cf39a16257c09d241992fd1ac547cd04fd6385bc877c07d88d.webp)

1 Install the front wiper blade. a. Slide the front wiper blade into the front wiper arm until the fixing clip is engaged.

### 11.6.8.2 Replacement of front wiper arm
`geely_coolray_en_776bfc73` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

![](images/93dc7f2288e1e8b50d5e4c16dc04c23384ff55394de1355179dca4aefaaf2f96.webp)

1 Remove front wiper blade, refer to replacement of front wiper blade
2 Remove the front wiper arm a. Stop the front wiper arm at the initial position before removal. b. Remove the nut cap of front wiper arm. c. Remove the fixing nut of the front wiper arm.
d. Take off the front wiper arm.

![](images/7224698e2e8400332a17351dd73bf7273d5ecd45c73f097887ff4c090be8695e.webp)

Installation procedure

![](images/4719ee57bb6184cd14af0f4c23703f3f1f405835672cdce9c465c731ff1c61ed.webp)

1 Install the front wiper arm a. Install and tighten the fixing nut of the front wiper arm. Torque: 25 N·m

b. Install the nut cap of front wiper arm.

### 11.6.8.6 Replacement of rear wiper nozzle Re moval procedure
`geely_coolray_en_22bc522b` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

![](images/643a10cd5bbe4255120be047eb0783613f099dc719ee42ed902628969d5e09d6.webp)

1 Open the engine hood
2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer t Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
3 Remove spoiler assembly, refer to replacement of spoiler assembly

### 11.7.2.2 Mileage display mode switching
`geely_coolray_en_8e68e501` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

The vehicle signal can be collected by the instrument through two ways including hardwire and CAN. Display the required information to the driver in the forms of TFT LCD graphic and LED light.

The instrument pack has two display modes according to the vehicle configuration. Type mainly displays the following contents: vehicle status, this mileage, subtotal mileage, tire status, clock display, outdoor temperature display, vehicle notifications information, driving mode, gear display, instrument pack menu display (vehicle settings, navigation, personalized settings, etc.), open door reminder, seat belt reminder, current function information display and some warning lamp icons, etc. Type 2 mainly displays the following contents: clock display, outdoor temperature, tire pressure monitoring (including four-wheel position, tire temperature, tire pressure), door opening information (four doors and two lids), gear information, fuel consumption information (instantaneous fuel consumption or average fuel consumption), total mileage, remaining maintenance mileage, subtotal mileage, cruise speed, endurance mileage, overspeed alarm, etc.

The buzzer is internally installed in the instrument. When any fault occurs, the buzzer will make the corresponding alarm sound.

Type I

This mileage

After the starting switch is set from the ON position to the OFF position and lasts for 4 hours, the mileage is automatically reset, and the vehicle driving data information is recorded again, including mileage, time consumption, average fuel consumption and average speed.

The driving data in this mileage are as follows:

Trip1
888.8 88:88
8.8L/100km 888km/h 8.8x1000r/min

1. Mileage: The display range of this data is 0.0 9999.9 km.

2. Time consumption: The maximum travel time displayed by this data is 999: 59 h.

3. Average fuel consumption: This value is displayed in L/100 km by default. After the value is reset, if the vehicle runs within 300 meters, the average fuel consumption will be displayed as–.- (unit).

4. Average speed: After the engine is started, the average speed starts to be calculated. When the vehicle is stalled, the calculation is suspended. Display the average speed after driving 300 meters. The unit can be switched between km/h and Mph through the menu.

Subtotal mileage

The subtotal mileage shows the data and information of multiple trips of the vehicle since the last reset. Include mileage, time consumption, average fuel consumption and average speed.

The driving data in subtotal mileage are as follows:

Trip2 2
888.8 88:88h
8.8L/100km 888km/h 8.8x1000r/min

1. Mileage: This display is updated every 0.1 km or 0.1 mile (based on the unit setting). The display range is 0.0 \~ 9999.9 km. When the maximum value is reached, the mileage display is recalculated from 0.0.

2. Time Consumption: When it is detected that the engine is running, the driving time starts to accumulate. When the engine is stopped or stalled, the calculation is suspended. After the engine is started, time is accumulated on the original basis. The data is updated every 60 seconds.

### 11.7.3.1 System working principles
`geely_coolray_en_b63b2d7a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:fuel_ev | p:1

Wake and sleep

1. After stalling, if the sleep conditions are met (stalling and CAN network sleep conditions are met at the same time), the instrument will enter the power-saving sleep mode, and all instrument functions and CAN bus communication will stop running.
2. The sleep and wake-up of instrument pack should meet the requirements of vehicle network management.
3. When the ignition switch is off and the door is opened, the door alarm should be displayed for a maximum of 30 s. After 30 s, no other door opening alarm will be triggered, and the screen will be turned off.

Button description

The key signal is a CAN signal. The instrument obtains the key signal through the CAN signal.

A. Instrument buttons are integrated on the multifunctional steering wheel buttons of the vehicle. TRIP button is on the top of the lamplight instrument panel. B. TRIP key time definition: press and hold ≥ 2 s, press 0.2 s < t < 2 s, and only when the ignition switch is in ON position, the adjustment button can be used.

Tachometer

The tachometer indicates the engine speed per minute in 1000 r/min. The indication range of the tachometer is 0 r/min\~ 8000 r/min. The 6250 r/min\~ 8000 r/min is the red zone of the tachometer.

Fuel gauge

The fuel gauge input signal comes from the resistance signal of the fuel sensor. When the fuel in the fuel tank is lower than the alarm point, the low fuel alarm lamp will be on. The fuel gauge shows the amount of fuel in the fuel tank. When the vehicle runs on curve road or mountain road, it will show a little more or less fuel than the actual fuel level. Only when the engine is shut down on flat ground can the fuel gauge show the actual fuel level.

### Speedometer
`geely_coolray_en_33f0839d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The display range of the digital speedometer is 0-240 km/h, the minimum scale value is 1 km/h, and the corresponding value of the vehicle speed is displayed on the LCD screen.

Total mileage

It can display the total mileage of the vehicle that has been traveled. The display range is 6 digits, the maximum is 999999 km, and the accuracy is km.

Subtotal mileage

The subtotal mileage display can be reset to zero by long pressing the TRIP button. The instrument pack has the function of automatically memorizing the subtotal mileage. When the start-and-stop switch is at the OFF position, the subtotal mileage will not be automatically reset, but after the battery is disconnected, the subtotal mileage will be reset automatically. The subtotal mileage display is updated every 0.1km. The display range is 0.0 - 9999.9 km. When the maximum value is reached, the sub-mileage display is recalculated from 0.0.

Instantaneous fuel consumption

When the vehicle is running, the instantaneous fuel consumption is updated at a frequency of once per second, which is displayed in L/100 km. When the engine is running and the vehicle is stationary, the instantaneous fuel consumption is displayed as–.- L/100 km. Select on the instrument pack in turn: the main menu of the instrument pack → Vehicle Settings → Unit Settings. The fuel consumption unit can be adjusted to L/ 100 km, km/L, mpg (US) or mpg (UK) in this interface. This interface helps you adjust your driving habits to achieve your desired fuel consumption value.

### Endurance mileage
`geely_coolray_en_cc5eb3c3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:fuel_ev | p:1

Endurance mileage is used to display the miles that you can travel with the current fuel in tank. The system calculates the endurance mileage per second, and the interface is updated every 10 seconds. The value of endurance mileage is calculated in a rolling manner based on the fuel consumption per minute. Due to different road conditions and driving conditions, the displayed endurance mileage will be different from the actual driving distance. This value is for reference only. After each refueling, the last endurance mileage will be reset. When the fuel sensor is faulty, the interface displays— km; Based on driving habits, the endurance mileage is displayed 0 km at least. The endurance mileage cannot be reset manually.

Average fuel consumption

The average fuel consumption is in L/100 km by default, displaying the average fuel consumption after the memory was last cleared. This interface is updated every 10 seconds. If the driver wants to measure the average fuel consumption in a certain driving cycle, he can reset the average fuel consumption by pressing and holding the TRIP button or the confirm button on the steering wheel (activate the reuse function of the steering wheel) before measuring the fuel consumption. After clearing the records, the fuel consumption information will be displayed again after driving about 300 meters. After each ignition, the average fuel consumption shows the value at the last exit.

Driving time

The maximum travel time displayed by this data is 999: 59 h. When it detects that the engine is running, the driving time starts to accumulate. When the engine is stopped or stalled, the calculation is suspended.

Average vehicle speed

After the engine is started, the average vehicle speed is calculated. When the vehicle is stalled, the calculation is suspended. Display the average speed after driving 300 meters. The unit can be switched between km/h and Mph through the menu

Tire pressure state

The pressure of tires can be displayed in real time on the instrument pack display via settings. Select on the instrument pack in turn: the main menu of the instrument pack → Vehicle Settings → Unit Settings, and the pressure unit can be adjusted to psi, kPa or bar in this interface.

The display of tire temperature is accurate to 1℃, and the display of tire pressure is accurate to 1 kPa.

1. Alarm of tire leakage and low sensor power:

When the tire leakage and sensor low power alarm are activated, the tire and the value in the corresponding position start flashing, with an audible alarm and a text prompt.

2. Low tire pressure alarm:

When the low tire pressure alarm is activated, the tire and the value in the corresponding position become flashing, with an audible alarm, and a text prompt interface will pop up. After the tire is inflated to the standard pressure value in the cold state, the low tire pressure alarm is released.

3. System fault alarm:

– Sensor fault alarm: When TPMS detects the existence of a system fault alarm of a tire (sensor failed), the instrument pack will give a light alarm, and the warning lamp will be on (always on until the alarm is removed). At the same time, the speaker will sound 3 times, and the alarm interface will pop up, displaying the alarm tire position.

### Endurance mileage
`geely_coolray_en_af3d520b` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

– TPMS host information loss: After TPMS host information is lost, the instrument pack did not receive the information sent by TPMS for more than 3 seconds, and the instrument pack judged that the TPMS host information was lost.

4. Low battery alarm:

When TPMS detects that there is an alarm of insufficient electricity in the tire pressure sensor, the instrument pack lamp gives a light alarm. At this time, the warning lamp is on (always on until the alarm is removed). At the same time, the speaker sounds 3 times, and the alarm interface pops up, displaying the alarm tire position (the corresponding tire flashes).

### 5. Multi-signal alarm:
`geely_coolray_en_b2032514` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

When the TPMS detects that there is an alarm from multiple tires, the instrument pack will give an audible alarm according to the sequence of alarm time. At this time, the warning lamp is on (always on until the alarm is removed), and the speaker will sound (if a new alarm occurs, the alarm times of the speaker need to be recalculated. For example, when the left front tire first shows a low pressure, the speaker will sound if the right front tire also shows high temperature, no matter whether the speaker ends the alarm at a low pressure, the speaker will start the alarm again). The alarm interface will pop up in turn, and the alarm interface will indicate the alarm tire position (the corresponding tire flashes).

6. High temperature alarm:

When TPMS detects the high temperature alarm of a tire, the instrument pack gives a sound and light alarm. The warning lamp is on (always on until the alarm is removed), the speaker sounds 3 times, and the alarm interface pops up, displaying the alarm tire position (the corresponding tire flashes).

7. Winter mode display:

When the vehicle is in cold winter, the vehicle owner should replace the anti-slip tire, if no tire pressure sensor is installed on the anti-slip tire, the TPMS system will prompt the sensor of failure alarm. At this time, the failure alarm will be turned off through diagnosis, and there will be no tire pressure alarm system function after it is turned off.

Gear display

It displays the current gear of the vehicle, there are four gears: R, N, D and P, and the default gear is P. When the gear is introduced, an animation of gear introduction will appear. After the introduction is completed, only the current gear will be displayed, and other gears will not be displayed. When the introduction of gear appears a wrong gear other than any of the four gears of R, N, D and P, the instrument will display the previous gear and prompt by flashing gear.

### 11.7.6.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_3deb4784` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before fault diagnosis of instrument pack/driver information system, refer to description and operation and system working principle. Understand and familiarize yourself with operating principles of instrument pack/driver information system before starting system diagnosis. This helps to determine the correct fault diagnosis steps when a fault occurs. More importantly, it also helps to determine whether the situation described by the distributor is normal. Any fault diagnosis of instrument pack/driver information system should start with a routine inspection that guides the serviceman to take the next logical step for troubleshooting. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.7.6.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_323b6e68` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Check after-sales installations that may affect the operation of the instrument system to ensure that these devices cannot affect the operation of the instrument system.

• Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.

Check and make sure the sensors of various instrument display information are normal.

### 11.7.6.5 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the starting switch to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a2f6e3c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic apparatus.

### 11.7.6.6 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

B. Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".
C. Clear the trouble code.
D. Start the engine and run at idle speed for at least 5min.
E. Road test for at least 10min.
F. Read the trouble code of the control system again to confirm the system has no trouble code output.

No

Diagnose according to the output trouble code.

Yes

### 11.8.2.1 Instructions and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_8a87fb4d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

System composition Sunroof control module Sunroof switch Sunroof motor with pressure sensor and limit sensor Sunroof Sunroof Sunshade

Opening/closing sunroof

1. Press the sunroof glass switch backward, the sunroof glass will automatically run to fully open; press and hold the sunroof glass switch backward, the sunroof glass will slide to open, and will stop sliding when you release the switch.

2. Press the sunroof glass switch forward, the sunroof glass will automatically run to fully closed; press and hold the sunroof glass switch forward, the sunroof glass will slide to close, and will stop sliding when you release the switch.

3. When the vehicle is equipped with a rainfall sensor, in the "comfort settings" of multimedia, turn on the "Automatically Close Window When Raining". After the owner locks the vehicle and leaves the vehicle, if it rains, the sunroof and power windows will automatically close.

Tilt opening/closing

Press the sunroof glass switch upward, and the sunroof glass will automatically run until it is fully tilted; press and hold the sunroof glass switch upward, and the sunroof glass will be tilted. Release it, and the sunroof glass will stop lifting.

Opening/closing sunshade of sunroof

Type 1: The sunvisor can be opened with the sunroof glass, but it needs to be manually pulled back and closed when it is closed.

Type 2: Press the sunroof sunshade switch backward, the sunroof sunshade will automatically run to fully open; press and hold the sunroof sunshade switch backward, the sunroof sunshade will slide to open, and will stop sliding when you release the switch.

Press the sunroof sunshade switch forward, the sunroof sunshade will automatically run to fully closed; press and hold the sunroof sunshade switch forward, the sunroof sunshade will slide to close, and will stop sliding when you release the switch.

If the sunroof glass is not completely closed, the linkage function will be triggered, and the sunshade sliding to close will stop at the linkage position of the trailing glass; the sunshade can be completely closed only after the sunroof glass runs to the completely closed position; during the automatic opening or closing process (by pressing) of the sunshade, push the sunroof sunshade switch backward/forward again, and the sunroof sunshade will stop sliding.

Thermal protection function

If the sunroof motor goes into thermal protection status after continuous operation, then the sunroof will not operate by pressing any button. After stopping operation to allow it to cool down, the sunroof motor can resume operation.

Anti-pinch function

When the sunroof or sunshade is closing, the sunroof or sunshade will return to the initial status when meeting barriers. If the anti-pinch function of the sunroof or sunshade cannot work normally after several consecutive anti-pinch, the sunroof or sunshade needs self-learning.

Self-learning of sunroof anti-pinch

1. Run the sunroof and sunshade to the fully closed position, and then operate the sunroof closing button and hold. After 6 seconds, the sunroof and sunshade shake.

### 11.8.2.1 Instructions and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_5048520d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

2. Release the sunroof closing button.

3. Operate and hold the sunroof closing button again within 6 seconds. After 4 seconds, the sunroof and sunroof sunshade will automatically open and then close.

4. Release the sunroof OFF button and the self-learning is over.

### 11.8.3.1 System working principles
`geely_coolray_en_f9b5b371` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The basic structure of power sunroof mainly consists of sliding mechanism, driving mechanism, control system and switch. The operation principles of each part are as follows:

1. Sliding mechanism

The sliding mechanism of power sunroof is mainly composed of a guide block, a guide pin, a linkage, a bracket, a front and rear rests.

2. Driving mechanism

The driving mechanism of power sunroof is mainly composed of a motor, a transmission mechanism, and sliding screws.

Motor: provides power to the opening and closing of the sunroof through the transmission. The motor can rotate in both directions, that is, the direction of current changes the direction of motor rotation to realize the opening and closing of sunroof.

Drive gear: the drive gear is mainly composed of worm gear, idler gear (active idler gear, transitional idler gear) and drive gear. The gear transmission mechanism receives electric power, changes the rotation direction, reduces the speed and increases the torque, and then transmits the power to the sliding screw to open and close the sunroof; at the same time, it transmits the power to the cam to open and close the start of the cam jack limit position. The active intermediate gear and the worm gear are fixed on the same shaft and rotate synchronously with the worm gear; the intermediate gear and the drive gear are fixed on the same output shaft, and are driven by the active intermediate gear to make the drive gear drive the glass to open and close.

### 11.8.7.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_6e371ff0` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before diagnosing the sunroof fault, refer to the Description and operation and the System working principle. Understand and familiarize yourself with the working principle of the sunroof, and then start system diagnosis. This will help to confirm the correct fault diagnosis steps when the fault occurs. More importantly, it can also help to confirm whether the situation described by the distributor is normal operation. Any fault diagnosis of sunroof should start with routine inspection. The routine inspection will guide maintenance personnel to take the next logical step for fault diagnosis. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.8.7.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_1ff5eb4b` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Check after-sales installations that may affect the operation of sunroof system to ensure that these installations cannot affect the operation of sunroof system.

Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.

Check and ensure that the sunroof is initialized properly.

### 11.8.8.1 Replacement of sunroof glass (openable panoramic sunroof)
`geely_coolray_en_c9250a91` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

![](images/74db147496c19087a4922d12541d88c2824df5e71815589891141bd2b36206ca.webp)

1 Take off the sunroof sealing strip.

![](images/8e955c3c008460540605048d7fcf156b2622da56e848fbdb53a7d6e751d7fd91.webp)

2 Remove the sunroof front glass assembly

a. Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON", and flip the sunroof front glass slightly.
b. Remove the 4 fixing bolts on the left and right sides of the sunroof front glass assembly.
c. Move the sunroof front glass assembly upward and remove it.

![](images/bd37a614075429883a515aa50bb1a90148f135abeb5c3ee0981faeac2d33791b.webp)

3 Remove the sunroof rear glass assembly a. Remove the 2 fixing bolts on the left and right sides of the sunroof rear glass assembly. b. Move the sunroof rear glass assembly upward and remove it.

Installation procedure

![](images/52fe1810a87b496d23dc4e0d503c12f37084ffc4dfc7dec962205ed4acfb27a7.webp)

![](images/7503800d41fcf8bbbf36f65ed5a171f9b39b800da89a27c8f3236aeff0a59035.webp)

![](images/18af99fee77087c48b4f9cde6e0a6eef769c5f014fcf8bfeb13363af8c65c5cb.webp)

1 Install the sunroof rear glass assembly a. Move the sunroof rear glass assembly to the installation position. b. Install and tighten the 2 fixing bolts on the left and right sides of the sunroof rear glass assembly. Torque: 8 N·m

2 Install the sunroof front glass assembly

a. Move the sunroof front glass assembly to the
installation position.
b. Install and pre-tighten the 4 fixing bolts on the left and right sides of the sunroof front glass assembly without tightening them.
c. Adjust the sunroof front glass so that it is parallel with the roof and the clearances between its four edges and the frame are consistent. Tighten the 4 fixing bolts on the left and right sides of the sunroof front glass assembly. Torque: 8 N·m

3 Install the sunroof sealing strip

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_6301b985` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

After installation, it is required to perform a rain test to check for water seepage to confirm whether the installation is correct.

Remove the sunroof motor
a. Disconnect the sunroof motor harness connector 1. b. Remove the 3 fixing screws 2 of the sunroof motor and take off the sunroof motor.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_c9af1597` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Installation procedure

![](images/b089a526fe1e3c968fd26bdf3f301b6e3214836052c41c807162ad13afb4a210.webp)

Install the sunroof motor
a. Install and tighten the 3 fixing screws 2 of the sunroof motor.

Torque: 4 N·m b. Connect the sunroof motor harness connector 1.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_433b0af7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Avoid the misplacement of gears and racks of sunroof motor.

2 Install the front reading lamp (sunroof switch)
3 Connect the negative cable of battery
4 Close engine compartment cove

`geely_coolray_en_e738e91f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Open the engine hood

3 Remove the sunroof glass, please refer to Replacement of Sunroof Glass

7 Remove the sunroof frame a. Disconnect the harness connector connecting the sunroof harness and the roof harness. b. Disconnect the sunroof front water drain pipe assembly with the sunroof assembly 2.

c. Disconnect the sunroof rear water drain pipe assembly from the sunroof assembly.

d. Remove the 4 fixing bolts at the front of the sunroof frame.

![](images/8c0f558682d30d2eb0fb89ef4d576aeb8809b289450fe71b993ed2ca75461e4b.webp)

e. Remove the 4 fixing bolts on each side of the middle of thr sunroof frame.

9 Remove the sunroof harness. a. Disconnect the fixing clip of the sunroof harness on the sunroof frame, and separate the sunroof harness from the sunroof frame.

![](images/18ceddcdff4f36b1c4109da8a4946c3398e246f8d6b1e015875405dfab28a38d.webp)

1 Install the sunroof harness. a. Install the fixing clips of the sunroof harness on the sunroof frame.

2 Install the sunroof sunshade
3 Install the sunroof frame a. Install the sunroof frame c/w sunshade assembly. b. Install and tighten the 4 fixing bolts at the rear of the sunroof frame. Torque: 9 N·m c. Install and tighten the 4 fixing bolts on each side of the middle of the sunroof frame.
Torque: 9 N·m d. Install and tighten the 4 fixing bolts at the front of the sunroof frame.
Torque: 9 N·m

![](images/37c85f04878fb4659565990e4794894d59cd62ebd75e896ea11e7489d246094d.webp)

![](images/bb0260c7dad69ef8491e75c5d12e9f609cd21ccfebe8051e5a85595abd792abd.webp)

e. Connect the sunroof rear water drain pipe assembly with the sunroof assembly.

f. Connect the sunroof front water drain pipe assembly with the sunroof assembly 2. g. Connect the harness connector 1 connecting the sunroof harness and the roof harness.

4 Install the sunshade motor
5 Install the sunroof motor
6 Install the roof interior trim panel.
7 Install the sunroof glass
8 Connect the negative cable of battery
9 Close engine compartment cover

### 11.9.2.1 Instructions and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_e3ada2f2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

One solenoid valve in each door lock assembly is used in the electric door lock. The door lock can only be operated by the FL door glass lifter switch or the lock cylinder switch on the driver side door (smart key operation). All doors should be locked or unlocked when the driver side door is locked or unlocked with the smart key or the FL door lock cylinder (the driver’s lock cylinder can only unlock the driver’s door)

1. Key unlocking/locking

Insert the mechanical key into the driver door lock. Turn clockwise to unlock the door; turn counterclockwise to lock the door.
Press the unlock button on the key to unlock the complete vehicle, and the turn signal flashes 3 times for confirmation. Press the locking button on the key to lock the vehicle, and the turn signal lights up for 1.75 s.
In-vehicle unlocking/locking switch (Driver side door panel): unlocking action, four door locks are unlocked; double locks on the remote control key are locked four door locks are locked.
Boot can be opened by the remote control or the switch. When the vehicle speed is above 5km/h. Boot/tail gate opening function is disabled.

### 2. Automatic locking
`geely_coolray_en_b90ef266` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

When you unlock the vehicle after the vehicle is successfully locked by operating the key or door handle, and if any of the engine trim cover, four doors, and tail gate is not opened within 30 seconds, the doors will be automatically locked. The interior backlight goes out and the system enters a defense state. The vehicle is fitted with automatic locking function in travel. When the start switch is at the ON position, the four doors will be locked automatically after the speed is higher than 20km/h and lasts for 3s.

### 3. Automatic unlocking
`geely_coolray_en_b5d12c5e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

When the door lock is in lock status and the power supply mode is in OFF position, the four-door will unlock automatically. In any state of power mode, press the tail gate remote control unlocking button for more than 2.0s to unlock the tail gate.

### 4. Central door lock control function
`geely_coolray_en_5f5d1701` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

When the power supply of the starting switch is in the OFF status, press the unlocking button on the remote controller once to unlock the four doors, then the turn signal flashes three times for confirmation, and the interior lamp fades on, and the position lamp lights up. When the power supply of the starting switch is in the OFF state, press the locking button on the remote controller once to lock the four doors of the vehicle, the turn signal flashes for 1 second for confirmation, the inner lamps fades off, and the position lamp goes out.

Press the interior locking button to lock the four doors. When the power mode is not ON or it is ON and the vehicle speed is less than 15km/h, if the central door control switch is pressed to the unlocking position, the BCM drives the four doors to unlock. When the vehicle speed is greater than 15km/h, the central control unlocking command is prohibited. When the power supply is in ON status, any remote commands other than the unalarm operation and the unlocking of the tail gate will not be executed.

5. Priority levels of central control door lock Priority level: When several signals are valid at the same time: collision unlocking > front door key switch signal > remote control signal > central control door lock > automatic unlocking and automatic locking function When one of the above signals is valid and the corresponding action is being performed. If another signal occurs at this time, it will be ignored. But when a collision unlocking signal occurs, the BCM immediately executes the collision unlocking action.

### 11.9.3.1 System working principles
`geely_coolray_en_2784c87c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

1. Door lock

Door lock is mainly composed of motor, status switch, shell, pull rod, etc.

• There is one motor and two status switches in the door lock. The working voltage of the motor is 9-16V. One status switch is used for feedback on whether the door is open or not. The other status switch is used to provide feedback on whether the door lock is in the locked or unlocked status.

The central control switch is integrated in the glass lifter switch of the driver side door. When the driver operates the central control switch, the control signal is transmitted to the BCM by the driver door glass lifter switch. BCM controls the door lock motor to perform corresponding actions according to the received signals.

### 2. Locking operation
`geely_coolray_en_0232643f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

When BCM receives the input signal of locking central control switch, it outputs power from the lock output terminal of BCM and controls the door lock motor of doors to perform locking operation.

### 3. Unlocking operation
`geely_coolray_en_558a6489` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

When BCM receives the input signal of unlocking central control switch, it outputs power from the unlock output terminal of BCM and controls the door lock motor of doors to perform unlocking operation. The tail gate can be opened separately by operating the tail gate switch and controlling by the BCM signal.

### 4. Tail gate
`geely_coolray_en_140993b8` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The tail gate can be opened by operating the tail gate release switch. When the driver operates the tail gate release switch, the tail gate release signal is transmitted by the tail gate release switch to BCM. After BCM receives this signal, it controls the tail gate lock motor to perform an opening action.

### 11.9.6.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_439d835b` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Refer to the description and operation of the system before diagnosing the fault of the central locking. Understand and familiarize yourself with the working principle of the central locking and the start the system diagnosis, which helps to determine the correct fault diagnosis steps in case of failure, and more importantly, helps to determine whether the condition described by the distributor is normal operation Any fault diagnosis of central control door lock should start with a routine inspection that guides the serviceman to take the next logical step for troubleshooting. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.9.6.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_86c6078d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Check after-sales installations that may affect the operation of central locking system and ensure that these installations do not affect the operation of central locking system.
Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.
• If all the door lock operations fail, check and repair any poor contact or open circuit of the power supply or grounding circuit before replacing the bulb.

### 11.9.6.4 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the starting switch to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a2f6e3c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic apparatus.

### 11.9.6.5 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_00de352a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC
a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.
b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".
c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 11.9.7.1 Replacement of front left door lock body assembly
`geely_coolray_en_2176ec49` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Open the engine hood
2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
3 Remove the door waterproof membrane and refer to Replacement of front door glass
T Remove the left front door lock body assembly a. Remove the 3 countersunk head screws of the left front door lock body assembly. b. Disconnect the left front door exterior release rod.
C. Disconnect the front left door lock cylinder tie bar. d. Take out the left front door lock body assembly.
e. Disconnect the left front door interior release cable.
f. Disconnect the left front door lock body assembly harness connector.
g. Take off the left front door lock body assembly.

### 11.10.2.1 Instructions and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_cf10a59d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Remote anti-theft system is an auxiliary vehicle alarm system that is triggered in the occasion of a forced invasion. The system is used together with central locking system. Radio frequency interference or battery exhaustion can fail the system.

The remote anti-theft system composes of the following main components:

Body control module (BCM)
Electrical steering column lock (ESPL)
Smart key
Keyless entry + keyless locking sensor
Vehicle key search antenna
Starting switch

When the button on transmitter is pressed down, the transmitter sends a signal to BCM. BCM then performs the corresponding function. The driver executes the door (front door or tail gate) opening action within 1.5 m of keyless entry+keyless locking sensor (left front and right front door handles). BCM detects the validity of smart key and executes corresponding functions.

The remote anti-theft system is designed to give an alarm when someone forcibly opens the door. Under the alarm system, the anti-theft horn will sound intermittently and all the turn signals will flash simultaneously. After 30s, the horn stops working, and only the left and right flashes flash for 5 minutes. When all doors are closed, the alarm will continue to sound for 30s. 30s later, the horn and headlights stop alarming, the door is locked, and the system returns to the enabled state. The remote control anti-theft system will not affect the start-up or normal operation of the vehicle.

### 1. Remote door locking
`geely_coolray_en_4e48e8f4` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

• When the power supply system is in the OFF status, press the unlocking button on the remote controller twice within 500ms to unlock the complete vehicle, then the turn signal lamp flashes three times for confirmation, and the interior lamp fades on, with the position lamp on.

When the power supply is in the OFF state, press the unlock button on the remote controller once to lock the vehicle, the turn signal lights up for 1.75 second, the interior lamp gradually goes out, and the position lamp goes out.

2. Enter anti-theft state

When the power supply is in the OFF state, close the door, use the remote control lock button to lock the door (press the locking button once), and the turn signal will flash once. Enter the anti-theft state after 3s.

When automatic locking, the system will automatically enter the anti-theft state.

When using the remote control locking button to lock the door, if the door is not closed properly, the turn signal flashes 3 times, the anti-theft horn beeps 2 times. After 10s, it will enter the anti-theft alarm state (alarm cycle: the left and right turn signals flash at the same frequency as the anti-theft alarm horn sounds. After 30s, the horn will stop working, and only the left and right turn signals flash for 5 min). If the locking key is pressed after 10s and the anti-theft alarm state is not entered, the anti-theft alarm is still issued (but at this time, if there are no other external conditions to trigger, the horn will not sound and the turn signals will not flash). In the alarm state, if the unlocking button on the remote control is pressed again, the alarm cycle will be stopped and the antitheft alarm will be released. If the locking key is pressed again, the original state will be restored. As shown in the figure below:

![](images/dfd6a42446960bed81f8e15dce1288c1657b5be18bd7a86b020c002b920058ff.webp)

### 3. Smart key learning
`geely_coolray_en_1b954b04` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Smart key learning function: learning by diagnostic apparatus, bus diagnostic tool and matching tool for production line. 3 keys can be learned in sequence. The smart key learning mode will exit 10s after learning 3 keys or at least one key, or make the starting switch power mode ON.

### 4. Passive entry passive start
`geely_coolray_en_62f5d6c7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

The passive entry and passive start feature allows the driver to enter the vehicle by pulling the door handle and start the vehicle using the push-button start button. When the driver pulls the door handle, the BCM detects the validity of the surrounding remote controls, and the smart key sends a signal in response to the vehicle, and causes BCM to unlock all doors. When the driver presses the starting switch, the validity of the smart key around the BCM will send a signal in response to the vehicle to unlock the steering column electronic lock (ESPL). At this time, the BCM will pass the information authentication with the power system. If all the information is valid, the BCM will control the starter relay to start the vehicle.

### 1. Trunk contact switch
`geely_coolray_en_e491d834` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The trunk is equipped with a contact switch. If the boot lid is closed, the switch will be disconnected; if the trunk is opened, this switch will be connected and send the grounding signal to BCM. Afterward, according to this signal and with the help of the CAN bus, the BCM will send the message of lightening the warning lamp to indicate that the trunk (tail gate) is opened to the instrument.

### 2. Door contact switch
`geely_coolray_en_d22a8bf0` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

All door lock body assembly is equipped with a contact switch. If the doors are closed, the switches will be disconnected; if one of the doors is opened, the contact switch inside the door will be connected and send the grounding signal to BCM. Afterward, according to this signal and with the help of the CAN bus, the BCM will send the message of “door is opened” to the instrument.

### 3. Anti-theft indicator lamp
`geely_coolray_en_0ecf3e9d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The anti-theft indicator is a light-emitting diode, and the power comes from the circuit system. When the system enters the anti-theft state, the BCM provides a grounding circuit to control its flashing.

### 11.10.6.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_defbfcec` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before diagnosing the fault of the remote anti-theft system Refer to the Description and Operations and System Working Principle. Understand and be familiar with the working principle of the remote anti-theft system, and then start system diagnosis. This will help to confirm the correct fault diagnosis steps when a fault occurs. More importantly, it can also help to confirm whether the situation described by the customer belongs to normal operation. Any fault diagnosis of remote anti-theft system should start with a routine inspection that guides the serviceman to take the next logical step for troubleshooting. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.10.6.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_97d3d317` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

• Check after-sales installations that may affect the operation of remote anti-theft system to ensure that they cannot affect the operation of remote anti-theft system.
• Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.

• If a remote control fails, make sure the built-in battery of the remote control is charged before checking for system failure.

### 11.10.6.4 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the starting switch to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a2f6e3c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic apparatus.

### 11.10.6.5 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 11.11.2.1 Instructions and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_3727988a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The driver power seat system includes the following components:

1. Power seat adjustment switch

2. Power seat heater

3. Seat forward/backward adjustment motor

4. Seat height adjustment motor

5. Seat backrest adjustment motor

6. Left front seat module

### 11.11.3.1 System working principles
`geely_coolray_en_d04e310a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Power seat adjuster switch

The seat adjuster switch provides the power supply and grounding circuit for the selected seat motor, which drives the motor to adjust.

### Electric motor
`geely_coolray_en_4ba3f844` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

All seat motors work independently. Each motor includes an electronic circuit breaker (PTC). The circuit breaker is disconnected when the circuit is overloaded and will only reset after the circuit voltage is cut off. There are three seat motors. They are back and forth adjusting motor, height adjusting motor and backrest adjusting motor. Back and forth adjusting motor enables the entire seat move forward and backward. The height adjusting motor enables the entire seat move up or down. Backrest adjusting motor enables backrests tilt forward or backward.

Horizontal adjustment

When the seat adjustment switch is operated to move the entire seat forward, the positive voltage of the battery is applied to the motor through the switch contacts and forward control circuit of the back and forth adjustment motor. The motor is grounded through backward switch contact of the back and forth adjustment motor and backward control circuit of the back and forth adjustment motor. The motor runs to drive the entire seat forward until the switch is released. The operation process of moving the whole seat backward is similar to that of moving the whole seat forward, except that the positive voltage of battery and grounding are applied to the motor through opposite circuits, thus enabling the motor to run in the opposite direction.

Height adjustment

When the seat switch is operated to move the entire seat upward, the positive voltage of battery is applied to the height adjusting motor through the upward switch contact of height adjusting motor and the upward control circuit of height adjusting motor. The motor is grounded through the downward switch contact and the downward control circuit of height adjusting motor. The height adjusting motor drives the entire seat to move upward until the switch is released. The operation process of moving the whole seat downward is similar to that of moving the whole seat upward, except that the positive voltage of battery and grounding are applied to the motor through opposite circuits, thus enabling the motor to run in the opposite direction.

### Backrest adjustment
`geely_coolray_en_39809f1d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When the backrest adjusting switch is operated to enable the backrest tilt forward, the positive voltage of battery is applied to the motor through the switch contacts and the forward control circuit of backrest adjusting motor. The motor is grounded through the backward switch contact and the backward control circuit of backrest adjusting motor. The motor runs to move the backrest forward until the switch is released. The operation process of moving the backrest backward is similar to that of moving the backrest forward, except that the positive voltage of battery and grounding are applied to the motor through opposite circuits, thus enabling the motor to run in the opposite direction.

### Seat heating
`geely_coolray_en_04fa54e6` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When the engine is started, press the seat heating button in the multimedia A/C display interface. When the number 3 is displayed on the switch, it indicates that the seat heating is in a high gear, and the heating gears are 1, 2 and 3; when it is displayed as OFF on the switch, it indicates that the seat heating is off. The seat heating is realized through the electric heating wire inside the seat. After the heating gear is turned on, the seat control module will activate the heating function. When the heating temperature reaches the set temperature range, the temperature sensor will transmit the seat heating temperature signal to the seat control module, and the module will stop heating; when the temperature is lower than the set temperature range, the seat heating function will be turned on again to ensure the comfort of driver and passengers.

### Seat memory
`geely_coolray_en_6d5f302d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The seat memory function can record the seat position adjusted by the driver, which is convenient for the driver to quickly adjust the seat to the desired position.
