### 11.11.7.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_ef24f4c0` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Prior to diagnosis of fault in power seat, refer to Description and Operation and System Working Principle. Understand and get familiar with power seat working principle before starting system diagnosis. This helps to determine the correct fault diagnosis steps when a trouble occurs. More importantly, it also helps to determine whether the situation described by the distributor is normal. Any fault diagnosis of power seat should start with a routine inspection that guides the serviceman to take the next logical step for troubleshooting. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.11.7.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_67f7113f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

• Check after-sales installations that may affect power seat system operation. Make sure these installations cannot affect power seat system operation.
. Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage or there is a situation that may cause a malfunction.
• If all power seat operations fail, check and repair any poor contact or open circuit of the power supply or grounding circuit before inspection.

### 11.11.7.5 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_94c421ed` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected C an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the starting switch to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a2f6e3c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic apparatus.

### 11.11.7.6 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 11.11.7.8 Action test table
`geely_coolray_en_0aec9a81` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

By reading the “action test” on the fault diagnostic apparatus, working statuses of the relay and the actuator controlled by DSCU can be checked with no need to remove any part and component. Before diagnosing the related faults of the control system, the motion test is the prerequisite for troubleshooting, which can shorten the troubleshooting time.

### Note
`geely_coolray_en_3a2fd8db` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Data under normal condition is listed in the following table only for reference. Do not merely judge whether some part is faulty based on these reference values. Under normal conditions, a vehicle operating normally can be used to be compared with a vehicle being diagnosed in the same status to confirm whether the data of the vehicle being diagnosed is normal in current status.

a.Engine should be at normal operating temperature.
b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "OFF".
c.Connect the scan tool.
d.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

e.Select “DSCU”/“action test”.

f. Refer to the following table and conduct active test.

### 11.11.8.1 Replacement of driver power driver seat assembly (Type I)
`geely_coolray_en_0341a450` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

![](images/6c270098f185fd63ede321c2109a4bdd0c5dd9a48b06175750e659728a59a1e6.webp)

1 Move the driver power seat to the rear end, and remove the 2 fixing bolts between the front of the seat guide rail and the vehicle body.

![](images/39c3500432b282b86479c4527df5f0c910ec1e3e9b7933b12e0e91e5ef4bae26.webp)

2 Move the driver power seat to the front end, and remove the 2 fixing bolts between the rear part of the seat guide rail and the vehicle body.

![](images/dea5481e70a779677fbc6f7db56da5b27489ed31ba29a19dcc54e85152b534e8.webp)

4 Disconnect the 2 harness connectors A of the driver power seat. 5 Disconnect the 3 fixing clips B of the harness. 6 Move the driver power seat assembly out of the vehicle.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_bf27e68d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When removing the driver power seat assembly from the vehicle, the cooperation of 2 people is required to prevent scratches on the interior trims.

![](images/1b5d3c11bd347e0fdcc2e22f03379318efe37f3e96b0568af13b03b2b113ed2a.webp)

Move the driver power seat assembly to the installation position.

Caution

When installing the driver power seat assembly from the vehicle, the cooperation of 2 people is required to prevent scratches on the interior trims.

2 Install the 3 fixing clips B of the harness.

3 Connect the 2 harness connectors A of the driver power seat.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_b775d8aa` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.

4 Connect the negative cable of battery.

![](images/f1281d60ecfa585897f1ed0953da7282aeeced6278031d96e62dbf1cf8db1d7e.webp)

5 Move the driver power seat to the front end, and install and tighten the 2 fixing bolts between the rear part of the seat guide rail and the vehicle body.
Torque: 45 N·m

6 Move the driver power seat to the rear end, and install and tighten the 2 fixing bolts between the front of the seat guide rail and the vehicle body. Torque: 45 N·m

### 11.11.8.3 Disassembly and assembly of driver power seat assembly
`geely_coolray_en_805562de` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
2 Remove the driver power seat assembly. Refer to Replacement of driver power seat assembly (Type I)
3 Disconnect the connector A between the seat harness and the driver power seat switch control box.
4 Remove the 1 fixing screw 1 connecting the front of the left front seat outer shield and the seat frame.

![](images/010294b070305a2d8c77f8d3b137ab331949539684ac7b90f0931fea1813c273.webp)

![](images/f9babe73ae697a5085d22bdba6f44611ab8ae98d494f37f4b37774f83fe8f0b9.webp)

5 Remove fixing screw connecting the rear part of the left front seat outer shield with the seat. 6 Take off the left front seat outer shield .

7 Remove the fixing screw connecting the front part of the driver's seat inner shield with the seat.

![](images/5e794c0ba49bedf32acae7719c5e1a026de9447ef49633ea3b98dcdd78a8a9c1.webp)![](images/5a2282b0427d19f2ad62b035e52de173e72956b2534c447e1b488930c2de074d.webp)

8 Remove the 1 fixing screw connecting the rear part of the inner shield of the driver seat with the seat. 9 Take off the inner shield of the driver seat.

10 Disconnect the connector A between the seat harness and the driver power seat adjustment motor.
11 Disconnect the clip B connecting the seat harness and the seat slide rail assembly.

12 Remove the 4 fixing bolts connecting the driver power seat slide rail assembly with the seat frame. 13 Take off the driver power seat slide rail assembly.

Installation procedure

![](images/fcdf991319c9bd45e193c9e30733f35eddae67c1e4289ef8bdfe725d76fd0b02.webp)

1 Move the driver power seat slide rail assembly to the installation position.
2 Install and tighten the 4 fixing bolts connecting the driver power seat slide rail assembly with the seat frame.

![](images/6655e523e4edf836483b24cbe30f75cf76c28f4a5937168b00364138b14d3bfd.webp)

Install the clip B connecting the seat harness and the driver power seat slide rail assembly. 4 Connect the connector A between the seat harness and the driver power seat adjustment motor.

### Caution

### 11.12.2.1 Instructions and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_680b202a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

The main components of the defrosting system are as follows:

Defrosting switch Left and right exterior rear mirror heaters (if they are
equipped )

Rear fixed vehicle window heater

The defrosting switch is set at the central A/C panel of the instrument panel; the tail gate window heater is integrated with the window; rearview mirror heaters are integrated in the left and right rearview mirrors.

### 11.12.3.1 Working principles
`geely_coolray_en_466bcb3d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Rear defroster switch is an inching button switch, which is integrated in A/C panel switch. Press the switch, and BCM receives the defrosting signal and controls the rear defroster relay to close and the rear defroster works.

### 11.12.4 Part Position 11.12.4.1 Part Position

Tail gate antenna grill

2. Rear defrosting braid lead

### 11.12.6.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_11527e0e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before the diagnosis of the defrost system fault Refer to Description and Operation and System Working Principle. Understand and be familiar with the system working principle of the defrosting system before starting system diagnosis. This helps to determine the correct fault diagnosis steps when a fault occurs. More importantly, it can also help to confirm whether the situation described by the customer belongs to normal operation. Any fault diagnosis of the defrosting system should start with a routine inspection that guides the serviceman to take the next logical step for troubleshooting. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.12.6.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_8a95eae9` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Check after-sales installations that may affect defrosting operations to ensure that they do not affect defrosting operations.

Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.

• If the rear windscreen defroster and the rear-view mirror defroster are inoperative, check and repair the power supply or poor contact or open circuit fault at the grounding circuit before repair.

### 11.12.6.5 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the starting switch to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a2f6e3c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diag nostic apparatus.

### 11.12.6.6 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 11.12.7.3 Repair of defrosting braid lead of tail gate glass
`geely_coolray_en_d7b9b8a7` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Open the engine hood
2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
3 Open the tail gate Remove the interior trim panel of the tail gate, refer to Replacement of interior trim panel of tail gate

### Repair program
`geely_coolray_en_3768e829` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

![](images/3355dc0c808128b80c6637486119705d55d25e8cbff9542869e08d1e3d764253.webp)

Repair the defrosting braid lead of the tail gate glass a. Disconnect the harness connectors of both defrosting braid leads of the tail gate glass.
b. Before repairing the weld bus leads, the repaired part must be polished with fine steel wool.
c. Use a brush to apply a small amount of rosin to the repaired part of the wires and bus leads.
d. Dip the soldering iron with solder that is only sufficient for repair.
e. Use only enough heat to melt the solder, and do not overheat the wire when re-soldering the bus leads.
f. Connect the harness connectors of glass defrosting braid leads of both sides of the tail gate.

Installation procedure

1 Install the interior trim panel of tail gate
2 Close the tail gate
3 Connect the negative cable of battery
4 Close engine compartment cover

### 11.13.2.1 Instructions and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_796730bc` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Horns are located inside the engine compartment and fixed on both sides of the radiator assembly at the front of the vehicle. The woofer is at the right side and the tweeter is at the left side. Both are controlled by horn switch on the steering wheel. When the steering wheel horn button is pressed down, the horn circuit is powered so that the horn beeps.

### 11.13.3.1 System working principles
`geely_coolray_en_f44579b4` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The control method of the horn is to control the power supply terminal, that is, the horn switch controls the pull-in of the horn relay, and then the relay supplies power to the horn. The horn is always grounded.

### 11.13.4 Part Position 11.13.4.1 Part Position
`geely_coolray_en_ffb0fc4a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

![](images/d4fe4d92347e6c13a6c5b4e7a9fe94f7fc768852e53c787b798dd1d0b42f9e44.webp)

Right horn

2. Left horn

### 11.13.6.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_d39e17a8` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before fault diagnosis of the horn system is conducted, refer to description and operation and operating and system working principle. Understand and familiarize with the operating principle of the horn system and then carry out the system diagnosis so as to determine the fault diagnosis steps when there is a fault. More importantly, it helps to determine whether the situation described by the distributor is normal operation. Any fault diagnosis of horn system should start with a routine inspection that guides the serviceman to take the next logical step for troubleshooting. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.13.6.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_6613c039` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Check after-sales installations that may affect the operation of the horn to ensure that these devices cannot affect the operation of the horn.
• Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.
• If both horns are inoperative, check and repair the power supply or poor contact or open circuit fault at the grounding circuit before replacing the horns.

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_b8bdac63` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When removing and checking the horn clock spring, strictly follow the safety operation procedures of the airbag system, and refer to the warnings about the airbag system

### 11.13.6.4 Contact adjustment of horn switch
`geely_coolray_en_31cdfe2e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When the horn is intermittently inoperative or the horn switch pressed on the steering wheel side fails to work, it is likely that the contact of the horn switch is poor. At this time, the horn switch contact under the airbag on the driver's side should be adjusted.

### 11.14.4.5 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the starting switch to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a2f6e3c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic apparatus.

### 11.14.4.6 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 11.14.4.9 Sensor fault diagnosis
`geely_coolray_en_5d8157e3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Check the after-sales installation that may affect the power seat, to ensure that these devices cannot affect the power seat.

2. Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage or there is a situation that may cause malfunction.

3. Check the installation of the reverse radar control unit. Check whether the harness connector is correctly installed.

11.14.4.10 Possible reasons that system cannot operate normally

1. The external fittings of sensor are frozen.

2. There is snow, water drop and the like on the sensor surface.

11.14.4.11 The probable cause of the decrease of sensor’s detection ability

1. When snow or water falls on the probe of the sensor.

2. On hot days or very cold days.

3. The obstacle is less than 14 cm (5.5 in) in diameter and less than m (39 in) in length.

### 11.14.4.12 Possible cause of system false alarm
`geely_coolray_en_0140fa89` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

1. On uneven roads, cobblestone roads and grassland.

2. The system is close to other ultrasonic sources, such as vehicle horn, motorcycle engine noise, commercial vehicle air brake interference when braking, etc.

3. Heavy rain and splashing water.

4. Get close to radio equipment such as walkman.

5. When the sensor is covered by snow etc.

11.14.4.13 The system cannot detect:

1. Objects with sharp corners and ropes, etc.

2. Objects that absorb ultrasonic waves such as cotton, snow and sponges.

### 11.14.4.14 Situations that might happen
`geely_coolray_en_8645bb20` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:electrical | p:1

1. The alarm level may not be continuous according to the vehicle speed and the shape of obstacles.
2. False alarms may occur when the sensor height and rear bumper change or when the vehicle's load is located in the detected area.
3. Be careful, the system may not detect objects within 30 cm (11.8 in) from the sensor.
4. When sensor error is detected, check whether the sensor surface is covered with dust, snow, water, etc. Wipe off dust, snow, water, etc. from the surface if any.
5. Avoid the extrusion, impact, scratch, etc. of the sensor surface
6. Inform the user of these precautions if the vehicle is loaned to others.

### 11.14.4.22 360 image calibration procedure
`geely_coolray_en_64f98c2c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

After the 360 around view front and rear cameras and left and right rearview mirrors are replaced, if the camera screen displayed is blurred (as shown below), the camera needs to be upgraded before 360 calibration; if the camera screen displays normally, the camera does not need to be upgraded and the 360 calibration procedure can be performed directly.

![](images/64dea799016f53421bae2981059be6e656a2e01a93dad4b4ae8f44ef127cbe0b.webp)

Camera upgrade program

1. Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode ACC or ON and enter the 360° around view interface; 2. In the left menu bar 1, click to switch to 3D mode; 3. In the upper right corner 2 of the multimedia interface, click 3 times or more continuously to enter the engineering mode.

![](images/e9fbe80a207abdf510c50d17d41fcd0200ec13ebfe26c04faf0cd33b94205f5a.webp)

4. Click camera upgrade in engineering mode, and the upgrade time is up to 80 seconds.

![](images/bf1b826c2206b2e9d4493286e8fadd8d68aaf03e9307b7dcd15131b198969412.webp)

360 calibration procedures

Equipment and site layout

Calibrated cloth (front, rear, left and right).
Lead hammer, tape ruler, laser ruler.
• Flat ground, the size is greater than 6.4X10 m.
There is no light source that exposes the camera through reflection or direct radiation

Vehicles and calibration equipment layout

1. Park the vehicle on the calibration site, and use a hammer to confirm the point A (the point of contact with the ground) where the front wheels of the vehicle are tangent to the ground, and mark it on the ground.

![](images/8825a54fd2dbffc4b3db57c56270be42ec37ed1974b3674a88f6e119e884898f.webp)

2. Arrange the front calibration cloth so that the front wheels are at the position A of the ground cut point and the position D1 of the first black block=1950 mm.

![](images/3046b21ace816d639dc51ef1316a4b3590d74893d2e57a6e0ecbce86b4437dd0.webp)

3. Adjust the front calibration cloth with the help of a laser ruler to align the lower edge of the first black block with the center of the vehicle.

4. Adjust the left and right calibration cloth so that the distance between the inner edge of the calibration cloth and the center position of the vehicle is 1200 mm.

Calibration procedure

1. Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON". 2. On the left menu bar, click to switch to 3D mode. 3. In the upper right corner of the multimedia interface, click 3 times or more to enter engineering mode.

4. Select auto-calibration, and the system performs the program automatically.
5. When completed, the interface prompts that the calibration is successful, select the application, and the calibration procedure is completed.

### Note
`geely_coolray_en_413e5445` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If you prompt that the calibration failed, please check the layout of the calibration cloth and perform the calibration procedure again.

### 11.15.3.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_8ac802ac` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before diagnosing the standby power supply faults, refer to the description and operation and system working principle. Understand and be familiar with the working principle of back-up power supply, and then start system diagnosis. This will help to confirm the correct fault diagnosis steps when the fault occurs. More importantly, it can also help to determine whether the situation described by the customer belongs to normal operation. Any fault diagnosis of the standby power supply should start with routine inspection. The routine inspection will guide maintenance personnel to take the next logical step for fault diagnosis. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.15.3.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_eeab88fc` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

. Check the after-sales installations that may affect the standby power supply, to ensure that these devices cannot affect the normal operation of the standby power supply.
• Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.
• If the standby power supply is inoperative, check and repair a poor contact or open circuit fault at the supply or grounding point of the ACC power supply before troubleshooting.

### 2. System advantages
`geely_coolray_en_31b0d765` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Reduced number of control circuit wires.
Greatly reduced weight of the wiring harness.
Fewer pins in the control plug.
Improved reliability and durability.

### 3. Function overview
`geely_coolray_en_895f609b` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

CAN is short for Controller Area Network. In other words, it controls the mutual connection of equipment for data exchange. It is one of the most widely used site buses all around the world. It is designed as a micro-controller communication bus in the vehicle environment to exchange information between electronic control unit ECUs and to form a vehicle electronic control network.

LIN is a new type of low-cost serial communication system for distributed electronic control system of automobiles, mainly used for serial communication between intelligent sensors and actuators. Characteristics of LIN bus:

Data format based on UART Single master multi slave structure Single line transmission: 0-12V Communication rate: 19.2 kbps

Data Link Control (DLC) is the result of negotiation and adjustment among all automobile manufacturers in the world. When using fault diagnostic apparatus to communicate with vehicle or program the communication system of the vehicle, this connector must be used. This connector must meet the following conditions:

It can connect 16-pin connector of all fault diagnostic apparatus.
Always supply battery power to fault diagnosis tester through Pin No.16.
Always provide grounding point for fault diagnosis tester through Pin No.4.
The other pins are used for serial data communication with vehicle systems. The microprocessor-controlled modules in the vehicle communicate with each other and with the diagnostic apparatus via serial data circuits.

### 1. Description of CAN bus
`geely_coolray_en_5bdb78f5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1

The communication media of CAN bus is the twisted pair with the communication speed of high-speed CAN bus of 500kbps. The twisted pair terminals are two 120 Ω resistances

High-speed CAN bus is differential bus. Serial data bus (H) of high-speed CAN bus and serial data bus (L) of high-speed CAN bus are driven from the still or unused level to the opposite limits. About 2.5V unused level is regarded as implicit data transmission and explained as logic 1. When the line is driven to the limit, the serial data bus (H) of high-speed CAN bus will rise by 1V and serial data bus (L) of high-speed CAN bus will decrease by 1V. Limit voltage difference 2V is regarded as explicit transmission data and explained as logic 0 (as shown in the following figure).

![](images/bff3315a268114f42938f66b0560f7990fc5ec130f15efcf6b5db9b6746608e1.webp)

When a CAN signal is sent, the current flows from the sending end of controller to CAN-H line, then to CAN-L line through the terminal resistance and returns back to the receiving end of controller. Where communication signals are lost, the program will set communication loss fault diagnosis code for all control modules. This fault diagnosis code can be read by the fault diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_904675a1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Fault diagnosis code of serial data loss doesn’t present a fault of module of this fault diagnosis code.

### 2. CAN bus application
`geely_coolray_en_74e1fcf2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

This vehicle has four communication buses, PTCAN, IFCAN,CFCAN and CSCAN.

PTCAN bus network consists of the following components: ECM (engine control module), sound adjustment valve, TCU (transmission control module), gateway etc.

IFCAN bus network consists of the following components: panoramic image module, radio control unit, front monocular camera, T-BOX module, diagnosis interface, vehicle-mounted intelligent monitoring module, gateway, meter instrument etc.

CFCAN bus network consists of the following components: vehicle body control module (BCM), automatic A/C control panel, FL seat module, gateway etc.

CSCAN bus network consists of the following components: front monocular camera, panoramic image module, electronic stability control unit, clock spring, EPS, airbag control module, dateway etc.

### 3. LIN bus application
`geely_coolray_en_f5370ae2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

BCM uses LIN bus and PEPS sensing coil for data communication to verify the validity of remote key.

BCM uses LIN bus for data communication with power window lifting motors of front, rear, left and right doors and sunroof control module.

### 4. K bus description
`geely_coolray_en_8930bec5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The K bus is used for diagnostic communication between the external test equipment and the vehicle-mounted diagnostic interface. The transmission rate is 10.47kbps. When a signal is transmitted, its voltage is switched between 0V and 12V: 12V, logic “1”; 0V, logic “0”.

### 5. K bus application
`geely_coolray_en_a947a3fc` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

The external test equipment can access the diagnostic data of ABS/ESC, meter instrument, A/C panel switch, BCM and other modules through the K bus between the vehicle-mounted diagnostic interfaces.

### 11.16.5.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_09b365d6` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before diagnosing the trouble of the data communication system, refer to Description and Operation. Understand and be familiar with system working principle of the data communication system, and then restart system diagnosis. This helps to confirm the correct fault diagnosis steps when a fault occurs. More importantly, it can also help to confirm whether the situation described by the customer belongs to normal operation. Any fault diagnosis of the data communication system should start with routine inspection. The routine inspection will guide maintenance personnel to take the next logical step for fault diagnosis. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.16.5.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_d5c4c02c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Check the after-sales installations that may affect the operation of the data communication system to ensure that they cannot affect the operation of the data communication system.
• Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.
• If the data communication system is faulty, check and ensure that each control module harness connector connected to the data communication system is properly connected before making repairs.

### 11.16.5.4 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the starting switch to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a2f6e3c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic apparatus.

### 11.16.5.5 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_ed488703` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 11.16.5.7 Bus fault prevention
`geely_coolray_en_61e16590` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. The CAN bus harness should not be stretched.

2. Do not disconnect the CAN bus harness for more than 4cm (1.6in).

3. The CAN bus harness should not be connected with other wires.

4. The fault diagnosis should be conducted with the diagnostic apparatus recommended by manufacturers.

### 11.16.5.8 Bus signal diagnosis
`geely_coolray_en_4b25e32e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

An oscilloscope and its double channel input can be applied to monitor signals transmitted at the CAN field-bus. These signals shall have the following features:

1. The voltage signal on CAN H line is 2.5-3.5V and the voltage signal on the CAN L line is 1.5-2.5V.

2. Signal transmission starts with the turning on of the starting switch, but ends when the starting switch is turned off for 2 s.

3. These two signals are mirror images of each other.

### 11.16.5.9 Bus repair
`geely_coolray_en_0ec1f06f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Wrap the repaired parts with PVC tape after welding the bus.

2. Interwine the two buses during installing. If the buses are not wound, the CAN bus will be vulnerable to noise interference.

3. The length difference between CANL bus and CANH bus should be within 100mm.

4. Don’t place bypass wires between connectors. If bypass wires are used, the protective effect of the wound harnesses will not be exerted.

5. Insert the tester probe from the rear side of the connector (harness side) when checking the resistance with the tester. Check the connector with a service wire if conductivity cannot be checked from the rear of the connector.

6. In case of open circuit failure of CAN bus, the length of wire connection shall not exceed 50mm (1.97in).

7. If there are more than two open circuit points, repair is allowed only when the distance between the two open circuit points is above 100mm (3.94in), otherwise the CAN bus conductor should be replaced.

### 11.17 Cruise control system 11.17.1 Instructions and Operations 11.17.1.1 Instructions and Operation
`geely_coolray_en_6290dd44` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:adas | p:1

Cruise control

Cruise control is used for controlling the speed of the vehicle. Once the vehicle is turned to the cruise status, the oil supply for the engine is controlled by the computer and the oil supply will be adjusted by the computer according to road conditions and the driving resistance of the vehicle to keep the vehicle moving at the set speed without having control the accelerator. Fatigue is reduced and unnecessary speed changes are thus reduced, which saves fuel. Under normal circumstances, when the driver depresses the brake pedal or clutch, the cruise control will be automatically released.

Service Conditions for Cruise Control

1. Used on highway or fully closed roads. Because on nonclosed roads, complex road conditions are not conducive to traffic safety.

2. Forbidden on rainy days or snow-covered days.

3. There are too many mountain roads or curve roads, thus the cruise control should be disabled. Because when we go out of the curved road normally, we must step on the accelerate pedal appropriately to provide greater steering force. Under the status of cruise control, the vehicle automatically maintains a constant speed, and the accelerator is controlled by the on-board computer, which often brings danger to driving on curve roads. Under such conditions, it is necessary to control vehicle speed appropriately.

4. There are too many vehicles on the road to cruise at constant speed.

Automatic emergency brake system (AEB)

The automatic emergency braking system monitors the distance and relative speed of the target ahead. When the driver brakes too late, the braking force is too small, or there is no braking at all, the system will take measures to assist the driver in avoiding or mitigating the collision. The AEB system includes two modules: alarm and emergency braking.

The automatic emergency braking system is a safety system. In every ignition cycle, the function is turned on by default. After the automatic emergency braking system is turned on, the alarm function of the automatic emergency braking system can be turned on and its sensitivity can be selected. The sensitivity will remember the driver's choice. There is no need to make a selection every time you get in the vehicle. When the sensitivity is low, the alarm is relatively late, when the sensitivity is high, the alarm is relatively early, and the medium-sensitivity alarm is between the above two. If the driver thinks that the alarm is too frequent, he can choose a lower sensitivity.

Lane Keeping Assist (LKA)

The lane keeping assist system consists of lane departure warning, lane departure assist, and lane keeping assist. The system uses a front monocular camera to identify the lane lines and calculates the distance between the vehicle and the left and right lane lines. When the vehicle deviates from the lane, the system will provide active correction to prevent it from deviating from the lane, or remind the driver to control the vehicle in the lane. This function is suitable for expressways or similar main roads.

### 1. Lane Departure Warning (LDW)
`geely_coolray_en_472cc1d4` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Lane Departure Warning (LDW) warns the driver when the vehicle deviates from the lane unconsciously. Unconscious lane departure includes the already happened lane departure and the imminent lane departure.

### 2. Lane Departure Prevention (LDP)
`geely_coolray_en_73032756` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

Lane Departure Prevention (LDP) When the vehicle is approaching the lane line and there is a risk of departure, the system will actively control the vehicle back to the lane by applying torque to the steering wheel.

Blind Spot Monitoring System (BSD)

The BSD system can help the driver to be more alert to the blind spot when driving, especially when turning or changing lanes.

The BSD system covers the blind spots next to and behind the vehicle. If the vehicle is in this area, you will be informed by the warning indicator lamp on the exterior mirror and instrument pack, helping you avoid accidents during lane changing.

Blindspot monitoring is about 3 m x 3 m on both sides behind the vehicle.

Adaptive cruise control system

The adaptive cruise control system can control the vehicle speed within the range of 0\~150km/h according to the set speed and the time and distance between the vehicle and the following vehicle. The system can control the vehicle speed based on the set speed and the time and distance between the vehicles. The adaptive cruise control system is mainly to provide driving assistance for the driver on highways or roads in good conditions. The driver needs to maintain control over the vehicle at all times.

Intelligent cruise control (ICC) system

The intelligent navigation system can simultaneously perform cruise control and lane control on the vehicle within the speed range of 0 to 150 km/h. The intelligent navigation system uses the front monocular camera to detect the vehicle ahead and lane lines on both sides, automatically adjusts the vehicle speed to maintain the driver's set speed or distance between it and the following vehicle, and at the same time keeps the vehicle in the middle of the lane. The premise for the intelligent navigation system to provide lane keeping control is that the system recognizes the lane lines on both sides at the same time. If the lane line is lost or unclear, the intelligent navigation system will be downgraded to enter cruise control only, and lane keeping control will no longer be enabled. When the system re-identifies the lane lines on both sides, it will automatically restore the lane keeping control.

The sensors used by the intelligent navigation system include a front monocular camera, which is installed behind the front windshield of the vehicle. It is the core component of intelligent navigation, automatic emergency braking, lane keeping assist system, speed limit reminder system and intelligent high and low beam system.

### 11.17.5.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_50596bf9` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before diagnosing the fault of the cruise control system. Refer to Description and operation and System working principle. Understand and familiarize yourself with the working principle of the cruise control system, and then start system diagnosis. This helps to confirm the correct fault diagnosis steps when a fault occurs. More importantly, it can also help to confirm whether the situation described by the distributor is normal operation. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.

### 11.17.5.4 Diagnosis system
`geely_coolray_en_a7198d79` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

1. Description

When fault elimination of a vehicle equipped with multiplex communication on-board diagnostics (OBD) is carried out, the vehicle must be connected to an intelligent detector. Then various data output by control module can be read.

OBD specifications require the on-board computer to light up the fault lamp when faults in parts and components of system are detected. The corresponding DTC will then be recorded in control module storage. If a fault does not appear again in 3 continuous cycles, the fault lamp will go out automatically. But DTC is still recorded in control module storage.

Connect the cable of fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic interface. It will operate the starting switch to ON status. The diagnostic apparatus is then enabled. If there is a communication error on the display screen, there is a problem either in the vehicle or in the diagnostic apparatus.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a2f6e3c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If communication is normal when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then the diagnostic interface on the previous vehicle should be checked.

If the communication fails when the diagnostic apparatus is connected to another vehicle, then there may be a problem in the diagnostic apparatus. Please consult service department listed in the service manual of the diagnostic apparatus.

### 11.17.5.5 Read and clear of fault diagnosis code
`geely_coolray_en_f98a90e6` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Read DTC
a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the diagnostic inte rface. b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".
c.Read the value of DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

2. Clear DTC

a.Connect the fault diagnostic apparatus to the fault diagnostic interface.

b.Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".

c.Delete DTC according to the prompts on the diagnostic apparatus screen.

### 11.17.5.15 Front monocular camera calibration procedure
`geely_coolray_en_558d65cd` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Equipment and site preparation

1 set of calibration equipment.
Tape measure or laser rangefinder (electronic ruler).
1 set of Multi-Quick fixture.
1 set of laser projector.
• Flat ground.

Adjustment of vehicle and calibration equipment

1. Adjust the distance between the front camera of the vehicle and the calibration board: D3=3000 mm.

2. Adjust the adjusting bolts on the base of the calibration device to ensure that the calibration plate is horizontal and vertical.
3. Adjust the center height of the calibration plate: H3=1,400 mm.

![](images/87fbae64ce39a81a92e49fd40f9ef7ad5c38a6db12f15b4b38cf86749c98e448.webp)

4. Install Mult-Quick clamps with laser projector at both sides of rear wheels of the vehicle, turn on the laser and turn the laser until the laser point falls on the ruler of the reference plate. 5. Move the calibration device left and right until the left and right laser points on the reference plate are in the same position, so as to ensure that the center of the vehicle is aligned with the center of the calibration plate.

![](images/b32450242770e743d671b327f570cba1818fff5916221e23b2701950faec8b91.webp)
Calibration procedure

1. Connect the diagnostic apparatus to the DLC.

2. Operate the starting switch to place the power in mode "ON".
3. Enter the main interface of the diagnostic apparatus and automatically identify or select Geely brand-corresponding model-manual selection system-front camera systemspecial function-service station calibration function.
4. Select "Service station calibration function" and click [Yes] when ensuring that there is no fault.
5. If you want to replace FCS, enter the VIN code; if you don't replace FCS, select No.
6. Write in the four wheel brow heights, click OK and write.

Note

For example, the left front wheel brow height is XX, the right front wheel brow height is XX, the left rear wheel brow height is XX and the right rear wheel brow height is XX.

7. Write in the distance from the calibration board to the front axle (D3 distance is confirmed, D2 needs to be manually measured and input) and click OK.

### Note
`geely_coolray_en_eab5d240` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Hint [Reading the calibration result, please wait…]

8. Hint [Calibration succeeds], and click OK.

9. Calibration is completed.

### 11.18.2.1 General
`geely_coolray_en_27417fef` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The tail gate of the vehicle can be opened in the following ways:

Open the smart key;
Outside tail gate opening switch is turned on;
Instrument panel switch block (interior tail gate opening switch) is activated;
The trunk emergency switch is turned on.

### 11.18.3.1 Description and operation
`geely_coolray_en_33bee3db` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Power tail gate is mainly composed of power tail gate control module, electric stay bar, electric suction motor, switches and so on.

Control module of power rear tail gate

The power tail gate control module is mainly responsible for receiving, processing and outputting control signals.

Electric stay

The main function of the electric stay bar is to drive its internal motor and support or lower the tail gate according to the control commands output by the control module of the power tail gate.

Electric suction motor

The function of electric suction motor is to close the tail gate in place when the power tail gate is close to the lowest position.

Switch

The switches are mainly divided into the exterior trunk opening switch, the interior tail gate unlocking button (instrument panel switch pack), emergency switch, etc. The main function of the exterior trunk opening switch and the interior tail gate unlocking button is to input the tail gate opening signal. The emergency switch is mechanical and can open the tail gate from the inside of the vehicle.

### 11.18.4.1 System working principles
`geely_coolray_en_d2abcdc5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The power tail gate can be opened through the exterior trunk opening switch, smart key, interior tail gate unlocking button (instrument panel switch pack) and emergency switch. After the inside tail gate unlocking button/outside trunk opening switch signal is sent to BCM, and the signal is transmitted by BCM to the power tail gate controller, the tail gate is unlocked. The control module controls the smooth extension motion of the left and right electric stay bars, to open and close the tail gate, and the electric suction motor will finally pull in and lock the tail gate through the far rotation of its internal motor. The control module of power tail gate is responsible for receiving, processing and outputting control signals. The electric stay bar can realize the conversion of electric energy into mechanical energy through the operation of the built-in motor c/w Hall sensor, so that the stay bar retracts and moves. The electric suction motor is to pull in and lock the tail gate through the built-in motor operation to ensure that the tail gate is properly closed. When the vehicle is under power supply, the tail gate can be opened from the vehicle through the emergency switch of the tail gate.

The driver can control the opening of the tail gate through the smart key, the tail gate opening switch on the instrument panel, the exterior trunk opening switch and the tail gate emergency switch, and can control the closing of the tail gate through the interior tail gate switch on the tail gate.

Open through smart key

The driver can press and hold the tail gate unlocking button on the smart key outside the car to unlock the tail gate.

Open throuhg instrument switch block

The tail gate opening switch inside the vehicle is located above the switch block on the instrument panel. The driver can operate this button to open the tail gate. After the signal of the switch block of instrument panel is transmitted to the BCM, the BCM transmits the signal to the power tail gate controller, which controls the unlocking of the power tail gate motor, and then controls the electric stay bar to work to open the power tail gate.

### Open through exterior trunk opening switch
`geely_coolray_en_9ceb17c5` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The exterior trunk opening switch is located outside the tail gate. When operating the exterior trunk opening switch, the opening signal is transmitted to the BCM, which will transmit the signal to the power tail gate controller. The controller will unlock the power tail gate motor, then control the electric stay bar to work and open the power tail gate.

Open through tail gate emergency switch

When the tail gate power opening mechanism or the battery is disconnected, the tail gate can be opened from the inside of the vehicle through the tail gate emergency switch.

Close through interior tail gate switch

The interior tail gate switch is located on the tail gate trim panel. Press this switch when you need to close it, and the power tail gate will be automatically closed. The inside tail gate switch signal is transmitted to the power tail gate controller, and the controller sends out control commands to drive the electric stay bar to work, close the tail gate, and then control the electric suction motor to work to ensure that the tail gate is closed in place.

### 11.18.7.1 Diagnosis description
`geely_coolray_en_b5c6b205` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before diagnosing the fault of the power tail gate system. Refer to Description and operation and System working principle. Understand and be familiar with the working principle of power tail gate system, and then start system diagnosis, which helps to determine the correct fault diagnosis steps when a fault occurs. More importantly, it helps to determine whether the condition described by the customer is normal. Understand and use the diagnosis flow chart correctly to shorten the diagnosis time and avoid misjudgment of fault parts.

### 11.18.7.2 Routine inspection
`geely_coolray_en_ab8b17f3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Check after-sales installations that may affect cruise performance and ensure that these installations do not affect the power tail gate.
Check system components that are easily accessible or can be seen to find out if there is any obvious damage of the component or there is a situation that may cause a fault.

11.18.8.1 Replacement of tail gate control switch assembly Removal procedure 1 Open the engine hood 2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable 3 Open the tail gate 4 Remove tail gate upper-middle interior trim panel, refer to Replacement of tail gate interior trim panel 5 Remove the left upper interior trim panel of the tail gate, refer to Replacement of the interior trim panel of the tail gate 6 Remove the right upper interior trim panel of the tail gate, refer to Replacement of the interior trim panel of the tail gate 7 Remove tail gate interior trim panel, refer to Replacement of tail gate interior trim panel 8 Remove the trim strip of the tail gate, refer to Replacement of the trim strip of the tail gate 9 Remove the tail gate control switch a. Disconnect the 1 harness connector of the tail gate control switch. b. Press the rear tail gate control switch clip. c. Take off the tail gate control switch.

![](images/9c8fb3b812d090059eaf5e71097c5f759d847fafdf675c0f92612c56c02603e9.webp)

Installation procedure

![](images/f6ec2a53159f9ecae6caecc4a5f170fc5db09ac66ba49f8b1a29936e0441755f.webp)

1 Install the tail gate control switch a. Align the tail gate control switch with the slot of the switch panel, and install the tail gate control switch into the switch panel.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_fb23110b` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

After installing the tail gate control switch, check whether the clips are fully installed in place. b. Connect the harness connector of the tail gate control switch.

### Caution

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.

2 Install the tail gate trim strip
3 Install the interior trim panel of tail gate

5 Install the left upper interior trim panel of the tail gate
6 Install tail gate upper-middle interior trim panel

9 Close engine compartment cover

b. Disconnect the 1 harness connector between the electronic support rod harness of the tail gate and the tail gate harness.

c. Remove the fixing clip connecting the power tail gate control module and the tail gate harness.

d. Connect the 2 harness connectors connecting the power tail gate control module and the tail gate harness.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_e7b901c8` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When removing and installing the electric support rod of the tail gate, two people are required to work together to support the tail gate to prevent it from slipping.

1 Open the engine hood

Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

![](images/4eb3dceeb971b04ca5abbe075b468ee1dec6b5e60552de8e93a8fa1a7888cc56.webp)

3 Open the tail gate.
4 Remove tail gate upper-middle interior trim panel, refer to Replacement of tail gate interior trim panel
5 Remove the left upper interior trim panel of the tail gate, refer to Replacement of the interior trim panel of the tail gate
6 Remove the right upper interior trim panel of the tail gate, refer to Replacement of the interior trim panel of the tail gate
7 Remove tail gate interior trim panel, refer to Replacement of tail gate interior trim panel
8 Remove the tail gate right drive support rod assembly a. Disconnect the harness connector connecting the right drive support rod of the tail gate and the tail gate harness.

b. Pull out the harness of the right drive support rod of the tail gate from the tail gate hole.

![](images/c610b9a314f36ea0b768d115691b5202611acc75e792ef9d677c68baa9035be4.webp)

c. Use a straight screwdriver to pry open the end
connecting the right drive support rod of the tail gate with the tail gate.
d. Separate the tail gate right drive support rod connector in the outside direction. e. Use a straight screwdriver to pry open the end at which the right drive support rod of the tail gate is connected with the vehicle body.
f. Separate the tail gate right drive support rod connector in the outside direction.
g. Take off the tail gate right drive support rod assembly.

Installation procedure

![](images/1803c238ee1f43e88ac148c9944541cc48579490acffa8efdc96319abd4234ee.webp)

![](images/b284bd89c9a349c405dacff5932b8e4b5e351883bdf7caea43807b777bdb6ddb.webp)

1 Install the right drive support rod assembly of the tail gate. a. Inward, press the tail gate right drive support rod onto the body ball joint, and confirm that the ball joint is fully pressed into the tail gate right drive support rod.

b. Inward, press the tail gate right drive support rod onto the tail gate ball head, and confirm that the ball head is fully pressed into the tail gate right drive support rod.

c. Pass the harness of the right drive support rod of the tail gate through the tail gate hole.

![](images/a390abf381958237bc998c2467b4650f9d9cfb94cdb8ec91634d90637beb15c5.webp)

d. Connect the 1 harness connector connecting the right drive support rod of the tail gate and the tail gate harness.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_91066728` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.

2 Install the interior trim panel of tail gate
3 Install the right upper interior trim panel of the tail gate
4 Install the left upper interior trim panel of the tail gate
5 Install tail gate upper-middle interior trim panel
6 Closing the Trunk
7 Connect the negative cable of batte ry
8 Close engine compartment cover

1 Open the engine hood

Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

3 Open the tail gate 4 Remove tail gate upper-middle interior trim panel, refer to Replacement of tail gate interior trim panel

![](images/7fb7097d34f047ad41847f621542e4239ec86a699abecd309c65a4574f7d1c7d.webp)

![](images/3572949148a1c0873daf74ae2ce1ffa9e6eae646214a0f03f4c2ce5e4e91f79d.webp)

6 Remove the tail gate left drive support rod assembly a. Disconnect the 1 harness connector connecting the left drive support rod of the tail gate and the tail gate harness.

b. Pull out the harness of the left drive support rod of the tail gate from the tail gate hole.
c. Use a straight screwdriver to pry open the end between the left drive support rod of the tail gate and the vehicle body.

connecting the left drive support rod of the tail gate with the tail gate.
f. Separate the tail gate left drive support rod connector in the outside direction.
g. Take off the left drive support rod assembly of the tail gate.

Installation procedure

![](images/a524f69e38b4bfd8b3eaf328a54cf47c988a9a3332f172da2be938a434eae81b.webp)

![](images/85274ed5ba61e9a36000e25116a5f90ed53ebe8cd12922434fc3a7d165cce27f.webp)

1 Install the tail gate left drive support rod assembly a. Inward, press the tail gate left drive support rod onto the tail gate ball head, and confirm that the ball head is fully pressed into the tail gate left drive support rod.

b. Inward, press the left drive support rod of the tail gate to the ball joint of the vehicle body, and confirm that the ball joint is fully pressed into the left driving support rod of the tail gate.

c. Pass the harness of the left drive support rod of the tail gate through the tail gate hole.

d. Connect the harness connector connecting the left drive support rod of the tail gate and the tail gate harness.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_f7e19c16` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.

2 Install tail gate upper-middle interior trim panel
3 Install the left upper interior trim panel of the tail gate
4 Closing the Trunk
5 Connect the negative cable of battery
6 Close engine compartment cover

### 12.1.1.1 Warnings and Precautions
`geely_coolray_en_28e5d114` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Warning regarding collision and cutting

Warning！

Cutting is carried out in the recommended components, otherwise it will destroy the integrity of the vehicle structure. The vehicle collision may lead to personal injury.

Warning regarding cracked windows

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_a15b00df` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If a window glass is cracked but remains intact, the protective tape should be cross-pasted to the window glass to prevent further damage to the window glass and personal injury.

Warning regarding glass and metal plates treatment

Warning！

When any type of glass or metal plate with sharp edges or burrs is handled, it is needed to wear approved goggles and gloves to reduce the risk of personal injury.

Warning regarding compressed air

### Warning！
`geely_coolray_en_992cc883` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When using compressed air, wear goggles to avoid eye damage.

Important notes on exterior logo removal

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_3ac9ad16` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When removing badges/nameplates, use a plastic flatblade tool to avoid damage to the paint.

Important notes on machining surface damage

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_3341cb15` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The sealing surface is a machining surface, so do not cut, scratch or damage the sealing surface, otherwise the damage to the machining surface will lead to leakage.

Precautions on sealant

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_99de4ff2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:lighting | p:1

Do not let the room temperature hardening sealant enter the tapped bind hole. If the room temperature hardening sealant enters the tapped blind hole, the fastener will produce hydraulic locking effect during tightening, which will cause damage to the fastener and/or other components and will also prevent the fastener from obtaining correct clamping force during tightening. Incorrect clamping forces can prevent components from being properly sealed, resulting in leaks. In this case, the fasteners cannot tighten correctly, which will loosen or separate the components, resulting in serious damage to the vehicle.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_49f8a14f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Avoid damaging vehicle windows due to the impact caused by exposed edges. Vehicle windows must be 1 mm (0.025 in) below sheet metal surface to avoid damage to vehicle windows.

The left and right fender upper trim panels are removed and installed in the same way.

### 12.2.3.2 Replacement of Bonnet interior release cable
`geely_coolray_en_0e79ad34` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

2 Remove the left front wheel arch splash guard. Refer to Replacement of Left Front Wheel Arch

3 Remove the upper trim panel of the front bumper. Refer to Replacement of Upper Trim Plate of the Front Bumper

4 Remove the engine hood lock c/w signal switch assembly. Refer to Replacement of Engine Hood Lock C/w Signal Switch Assembly
5 Remove the left lower fender apron assembly of the dashboard. Refer to Replacement of Left Lower Shield Assembly of Dashboard
6 Remove the engine hood interior release cable a. Disconnect the engine hood interior release cable from the engine cover lock release handle assembly.

![](images/347645ae9890974e61305c8602fe751bf3afbc0d18fb98a6602acbaceeed0fb5.webp)

b. Disconnect the 1 fixing clip of the bonnet lock opening cable and front end module frame.

![](images/19bf554c7a4bb19a0013a04025d55ca39c0d6510c8b6c31af671936c6c9f3c4a.webp)

c. Disconnect the 2 fixing clips A connecting the engine hood lock release cable and the left front combination lamp.
d. Disconnect the fixing clip B of the bonnet lock opening cable and vehicle body.

e. Disconnect the 2 fixing clip A connecting the engine hood lock release cable and the vehicle body. f. Pry out the waterproof plug B on the engine hood lock release cable. g. Remove the bonnet lock opening cable.

Installation procedure

![](images/fb7b3c4cf4088fb924fe8d078d9dd87d242c5967fec8a621435ca8da80783697.webp)

Install the bonnet interior opening

a. Move the engine hood lock release cable to the
installation position.
b. Install the waterproof plug B of the bonnet lock opening cable.
c. Install the 2 fixing clip A connecting the engine hood lock release cable and the vehicle body.

d. Install the 1 fixing clip B of the bonnet lock opening cable and vehicle body. e. Install the 2 fixing clips A connecting the engine hood lock release cable and the left front combination lamp.

![](images/58f24261e41e3789a7c272e7c63b7e7c90e659a630fb0845bd5bd68ae7d52655.webp)

f. Install the fixing clip of the bonnet lock opening cable and front end module frame.

g. Connect the bonnet lock opening cable and the bonnet lock opening handle.

2 Install the left lower shield assembly of the dashboard.
3 Install the engine hood lock c/w signal switch assembly.
4 Install the upper trim panel of the front bumper.
5 Install the left front wheel arch splash guard.
6 Connect the negative cable of battery.

### 12.2.3.3 Replacement of engine hood lock c/w signal switch assembly
`geely_coolray_en_2eb49fcc` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Open the engine hood
2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery, refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

3 To remove the upper trim panel of the front bumper, please refer to Replacement of Upper Trim Panel of the Front Bumper

![](images/c08eb82c00004b76f45b5dbc3ebf14237376a6e6b8dfdabb427645b51047a99e.webp)

Remove the engine hood lock c/w signal switch assembly a. Disconnect the harness connector of the engine compartment cover lock c/w signal switch assembly. b. Remove the 3 fixing bolts 2 connecting the engine compartment cover lock c/w signal switch assembly with the engine compartment cover lock bracket.

c. Disconnect the engine compartment cover lock release cable connecting wire and take off the engin compartment cover lock.

Installation procedure

![](images/f760c64f3ed3fd6c14ac83ad7b96fbeb41206e63c264c29cbff52ce88ab3bc19.webp)

1 Install the engine hood lock c/w signal switch assembly. a. Connect the bonnet lock opening cable connecting cable.

b. After adjusting the lock position, tighten the 2 fixing bolts on the right side of the engine compartment cover lock c/w signal switch assembly.
Torque: 9 N·m

c. Tighten the 1 fixing bolt on the left side of the engine compartment cover lock signal switch assembly.

Torque: 9 N·m

d. Check and confirm whether the lock catch can be smoothly engaged with the engine compartment cover.

e. Connect the harness connector of the engine compartment cover lock c/w signal switch assembly.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a680a13e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Firmly plug in harness in the principle of “first plug, second sounds and third confirmations”.

2 Install the upper trim plate of the front bumper

3 Connect the negative cable of battery

Close engine compartment cover

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_8751eb45` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The removal requires the cooperation of two people, one to remove and the other to hold the bonnet hood.

1 Remove the bonnet body assembly

![](images/49cd2ce163f71c9c054ce1e0635161ee4aa0d3e62784024e58705041e5c3c5f3.webp)![](images/6d4c50cd2ceb2065fcdbb66c6dc9f08d3366591e2fe1e5d334f4950ac7c80771.webp)

a. Open and ask the assistant to support the bonnet body assembly.
b. Before removing the engine hood body assembly, use a marker to mark the left and right hinges of the engine hood body assembly around the hinges around the fixing nut as shown in the figure.

c. Disconnect the front washer hose assembly A. d. Remove the 2 fixing nuts of bonnet body assembly and the right hinge of the bonnet body assembly.

e. Remove the 2 fixing nuts of bonnet body assembly and the left hinge of the bonnet body assembly. f. Remove the bonnet body assembly.

### Installation procedure
`geely_coolray_en_6c15f63a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1 Install the bonnet body assembly

![](images/dad9803b4333e4e0dc10c28e0d9bdfdd30990504ef5c70c14bd07d4e6cd6538a.webp)

a. Move the engine hood body assembly to the installation position.
b. Pre-tighten the 4 fixing nuts of bonnet body assembly and the left and right hinges of the bonnet body assembly, but no torque is applied.
c. Adjust the position of the bonnet hood body assembly until the left and right hinges of the bonnet body assembly engage with the marked positions.

d. Install and tighten the 2 fixing nuts of bonnet body assembly and the left hinge of the bonnet body assembly. Torque: 24N·m

![](images/7bca27971b22a2240f7c81675f3e608b69c429abe7ccb61268e397b730efc73e.webp)

e. Install and tighten the 2 fixing nuts 1 of bonnet body assembly and the right hinge of the bonnet body assembly.

Torque: 24N·m

f. Connect the front washer hose assembly A.

### 12.2.3.8 Replacement of front left fender assembly
`geely_coolray_en_4ccd590f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

4 Remove the left front wheel arch splash guard. Refer to Replacement of Left Front Wheel Arch
5 Remove the upper trim panel of the fender. Refer to Replacement of Upper Trim Panel of Left Front Fender Assembly Remove the upper trim panel of the front bumper. Refer to Replacement of Upper Trim Plate of the Front Bumper
7 Remove the front bumper assembly. Refer to Replacement of Front Bumper Assembly
8 Remove the left front combination lamp. Refer to Replacement of Left Headlamp
9 Remove the left bracket of the front bumper. Refer to Replacement of Front Bumper Left Bracket
10 Remove the left front fender assembly a. Remove the 2 fixing bolts connecting the front end of the left front fender assembly and the lower connecting plate of the left front fender assembly.

![](images/97a36bc13d57df6b7b4b8ea784662a151643f319c5012a88ae4aad9c8b6cbfd0.webp)

![](images/73580418690b95b421077fa37857ab4b09c0dc78e2964bf83eea61ce212b0575.webp)![](images/ec94e5feea51a05ec53d866e81194892d325660ce2db1328105165438cb7ca32.webp)

c. Remove the fixing clip of the left corner trim of the fender and take off the left corner trim of the fender.

d. Remove the left corner trim panel of ventilation cover plate.

e. Remove the fixing bolt 1 connecting the upper part of the left front fender assembly with the motor compartment cover hinge.
f. Remove the 2 fixing bolts 2 of the upper part of the front left fender.assembly.

![](images/cede536d623fea609b9f69da4f68b748743c2665f45005ad011322ab931e03d3.webp)![](images/6d12d60077e96eeb585e00c47124e80df40b6a4dd5e84b0546cc8e2b2a6c1d5b.webp)

g. Pry off the front left triangular window trim panel assembly.

h. Remove the 1 fixing bolt connecting the upper rear end of the left front fender assembly and the vehicle body.

i. Remove the fixing screw connecting the lower part of the left front fender assembly with the left skirt panel assembly 1.
j. Remove the fixing bolt 2 connecting the lower part of the left front fender assembly and the rear lower mounting bracket of the left fender.
k. Remove the fixing nut 3 connecting the left front fender assembly with the fender rear middle mounting bracket, and take off the left front fender assembly.

### Installation procedure
`geely_coolray_en_2017be10` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Torque: 9N·m

b. Install and tighten the 1 fixing bolt 2 connecting the lower part of the left front fender assembly and the rear lower mounting bracket of the left fender.

Torque: 9N·m

c. Install and tighten the fixing screw connecting the lower part of the left front fender assembly with the left skirt panel assembly.
Torque: 9N·m

d. Install and tighten the fixing bolt connecting the upper rear end of the left front fender assembly with the vehicle body.

Torque: 9N·m

![](images/c4d29032e33cfee5190ad56a8208c0602febc6656a94dec7e29ecd110e4664bb.webp)

e. Install the left front triangular window trim panel assembly.

f. Install and tighten the 2 fixing bolts 2 of the upper part of the front left fender.assembly.
Torque: 9N·m
g. Install and tighten the 1 fixing bolt 1 connecting the upper part of the left front fender assembly with the motor compartment cover hinge.
Torque: 9N·m

h. Install the left corner trim panel of the ventilation cover plate.

![](images/ba13f56a0f4af49165ecb2aeb1a859e2e16a93c21cf51e52112bae4085df6a13.webp)![](images/55ce24f7f49be06283b8c1256a5107b9e3d82993ffc39f761a9a977e50ee047c.webp)

i. Move the left corner trim of the fender to the installation position and install the 1 fixing clip of the left corner trim of the fender.

j. Move the left foam block of the ventilation cover plate to the installation position, and install the 1 fixing clip connecting the left foam block of the ventilation cover plate with the ventilation cover plate.

k. Install and tighten the 2 fixing bolts connecting the front end of the left front fender assembly and the lower connecting plate of the left front fender assembly. Torque: 9N·m

2 Install the front bumper left bracket.
3 Install the left front combination lamp.
4 Install the front bumper assembly.
5 Install the upper trim panel of the front bumper.

### 12.3.3.3 Replacement of fuel filler cap unit Removal procedure
`geely_coolray_en_0af2c5b3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

![](images/65a13b580a5d50e52ee9f1b3c2935fc915163c6c66a7b2357e146c692ed10623.webp)

1 Remove the fuel filler cap assembly a. Disconnect the clip 1 of the outer plate of the fuel filler cap, and remove the outer plate of the fuel filler cap. b. Gently screw out the water outlet pipe 2 of the fuel filler cap with the Phillips screwdriver. c. Unscrew the filler cap cock 3. d. Remove the 1 screw 4 outside the fuel filler cap unit. e. Pierce the four access openings 5 with a slotted screwdriver to pry the clamp inside the fuel filler cap unit and remove the filler cap unit.

a. Install the fuel filler cap unit and connect the clamp 5 inside the fuel filler cap unit.
b. Install and tighten the T screw 4 outside the fuel filler cap unit.
Torque: 2N·m
c. Install the fuel filler cap cock 3.
d. Install the water drain pipe 2 of the fuel filler cap. e. Connect the clamp 1 of the outer plate of the fuel filler cap.

5 Disassemble the front bumper assembly a. Disconnect the harness connector A connecting the front bumper harness and the 3 internal radar on the left side. b. Disconnect the harness connector B connecting the front bumper harness and the front camera.
