`geely_coolray_en_18b52466` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

Remove the front bumper assembly. Refer to Replacement of Front Bumper Assembly

![](images/e1f3d489f8d0d8aa903803382f8ccef2efacf789ce792361de5cb45fd985ae7d.webp)

3 Remove the left bracket of the front bumper a. Remove the 3 retaining bolts on the front bumper left bracket. b. Remove the front bumper left bracket.

Installation procedure

![](images/1fadd51f82af8cb2dcd4738850c0f63f20a2608852cd98f48a4cc97cb779bc23.webp)

Install the front bumper left bracket
a. Move the left bracket of the front bumper to the

### 12.4.3.5 Replacement of rear bumper assembly
`geely_coolray_en_97ebad54` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Open the backdoor.
2 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
3 Lift the vehicle. Refer to Lifting and Jacking of Vehicle
4 Remove the rear wheel brow assembly. Refer to Replacement of Left Rear Wheel Brow Trim Panel
5 Remove the rear bumper assembly a. Remove the 1 fixing screw 1 connecting the left and right sides of the rear bumper assembly with the rear fender. b. Remove the 2 fixing screws 2 connecting the left and right sides of the rear bumper assembly with the rear wheel arch.

![](images/ec5ec86277ca165b4465009f5665adbf9feeb3434dac705975676431590bbb04.webp)

![](images/9195fb162a87cf92926aa2b7766788e08f563e6f731e3bc7e7ecd8a9fe51f928.webp)

c. Remove the 3 fixing screws 1 connecting the rear bumper assembly and the mounting bracket of the rear bumper. d. Remove the 2 fixing bolts 2 connecting the rear bumper assembly and thelower mounting bracket. e. Remove the 2 fixing screws 3 connecting the rear bumper assembly and the lower rear wheel arch.

![](images/f24a368652bc3fdc5c122cedadfc583a6355a9086e2575215c98a63e755838a6.webp)

f. Disconnect the harness connector connecting the rear bumper harness with the floor harness. g. Remove the rear bumper assembly.

Installation procedure

![](images/072d47ca06540ae3ba1759a7bd128dac93430e8bcefe77e82e5e56fac04de6e2.webp)

Install the rear bumper assembly
a. Move the rear bumper assembly to the installation position.
b. Install the harness connector connecting the rear bumper harness with the floor harness. c. Install and tighten the 2 fixing screws 3 connecting the rear bumper assembly and the lower rear wheel arch. Torque: 1.5N·m
d. Install and tighten the 2 fixing bolts 2 connecting the rear bumper assembly and the lower mounting bracket. Torque: 5N·m
e. Install and tighten the 3 fixing screws 1 connecting the rear bumper assembly and the mounting bracket of the rear bumper.

![](images/b138ce5cb780f41b72c56c334cc4aa826b9cbd8822468e8618deac99bf5a810a.webp)

Torque: 1.5N·m

f. Install and tighten the 2 fixing screws 2 connecting the left and tight sides of the rear bumper assembly and the rear wheel arch.

Torque: 1.5N·m

g. Install and tighten the fixing screw connecting the left and right sides of the rear bumper assembly and the rear fender.

Torque: 1.5N·m

2 Install the rear wheel brow assembly.
3 Lower the vehicle.
4 Connect the negative cable of battery.
5 Close the backdoor.

### 12.4.3.6 Disassembly and assembly of rear bumper assembly
`geely_coolray_en_4c403e4f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Disassembly procedure

1 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable

2 Remove the rear bumper assembly. Refer to Replacement of Rear Bumper Assembly

3 Decompose rear bumper assembly a. Disconnect the 7 harness fixing clips A connecting the right rear bumper harness with the rear bumper assembly. b. Disconnect the harness connector B connecting the right rear bumper harness with the tail antenna. c. Disconnect the harness connector C connecting the rear bumper harness and the 2 radar on the right.

![](images/e90dd2ee9a4378970d610fe0a701548b7d490b11e652edd59a686c24fb82e02b.webp)![](images/d91bdd7a13a11ea57325cff7a34927d77b0aca9bae4cdcc70d0243de55c65393.webp)

d. Disconnect the 10 harness fixing clips A connecting the left rear bumper harness with the rear bumper assembly, and take down the rear bumper harness. e. Disconnect the harness connector B connecting the left rear rear bumper harness with the rear fog lamp. f. Disconnect the harness connector C connecting the rear bumper harness and the 3 radar on the left.

g. Remove the 2 fixing screws connecting the tail antenna and the rear bumper assembly. h. Disconnect the 1 harness fixing clip A connecting the tail antenna with the rear bumper assembly, and take off the tail antenna.

![](images/08c09f273a46cb9c18ce38520f4354194b7740d2ae8825b7b9ae607e87ac1555.webp)

i. Remove the 3 fixing screws connecting the rear fog lamp with the rear bumper assembly, and take off the rear fog lamp.

j. Disconnect the 6 radar sensors from the rear bumper assembly and take off the 6 radar probe assemblies.

![](images/986c2138c80a3cc1e4dac54c5494e3eaa9a680fd12e0b33e573a4bfd82abce30.webp)

k. Remove the 4 fixing screws connecting the left exhaust pipe trim cover assembly with the rear bumper assembly, and take off the left exhaust pipe trim cover assembly.

### 12.6.2.1 Frame and underbody descriptions
`geely_coolray_en_6ece917f` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:suspension | p:1

The frame is a sub-frame located at the front of the vehicle and separated from the body by rubber bushing, which provides location for the drive train, the lower control arm of front suspension, and the power steering tie rod assembly. Any misplace of the frame will result in the misplacing of the front wheels. The frame is bolted to the body through rubber bushing. The underbody must be correctly positioned to ensure the correct suspension and the correct wheel alignment. All underbody parts directly affect the overall strength of the entire body, and appropriate welding techniques should be used in repair operations.

Parts must be protected against corrosion as long as the body repair operations damage or break the original surface. Refer to the Corrosion Treatment in “Collision Repair” description and operation.

### Check the Underbody
`geely_coolray_en_31e6def9` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

If the dimensions of the underbody do not meet the standards, use the body correction frame to correct the body to ensure that the dimensions of each part of the body meet the requirements.

### Check frame and body alignment
`geely_coolray_en_1db8c9ba` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Carry out the frame installation procedure. If the frame is not correctly mounted on the body, the frame and body are not aligned correctly. Replace the frame after confirming that the body is positioned correctly.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_507a6172` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1

Bolt tightening torque is large, please be careful during removal.

Support front subframe with flat jack

To lift a vehicle, please refer to Lifting and Jacking of Vehicle

2 To remove left and right front wheels please refer to Replacement of Wheels

3 To remove front fender liner, refer to Replacement of Front Fender Liner

4 to remove the engine bottom shield, refer to Replacement of Engine Bottom Shield.

5 To remove the engine side shield, refer to replacement of the Engine Side Shield

6 To remove the rear vibration insulator of the engine, refer to Replacement of Rear Vibration Insulator of the Engine

![](images/2e5591b6766cf5d47230522a0280796bd7f1249dc0fe75f67a8e2eafc9747538.webp)

7 Remove the front sub-frame

a. Remove the 1 cotter pin and nut 1 on each side of the lower swing arm, and disconnect the lower swing arm from the steering knuckle.
b. Remove 1 nut 2 on each side of the front stabilizer bar, and disconnect the front stabilizer bar from the stabilizer bar connecting rod.
c. Remove the 1 cotter pin and nut 3 on each side of the steering tie rod, and disconnect the steering tie rod and the steering knuckle.

d. Remove the bolt connecting the intermediate shaft assembly with the steering input shaft from the vehicle.

![](images/2b74c2cd1f518771767ec40a854137c09521538517e4b439a4fe11805a552f06.webp)

e. Remove the 4 bolts connecting the front subframe with the vehicle body, and take off the front subframe components (including the front suspension lower swing arm, front stabilizer bar, steering gear c/w tie rod assembly).

g. Remove the 4 fixing bolts of the anti-roll bar and take off the anti-roll bar.

![](images/00d8b3b3c5d59bdae81816a82d39ccc8f9a9f4da5a3d739babf6df1634dd2c90.webp)

h. Remove the 2 fixing bolt and nut assemblies of the steering gear tie rod assembly, and take off the steering gear tie rod assembly.

i. Remove 2 fixing bolts on both sides of lower swing arm assembly and take down lower swing arm assembly. j. Take off the front subframe.

Installation procedure

![](images/52d8080767390f2e6ec05042c3c2585c96f64fa73511d1b2945ad3a5a0770aa2.webp)

![](images/8b8d8b36f37104dae631ef32c80183ebfd9a2c34941f44bdd10e32d1432f9fd3.webp)

1 Install the front subframe

a. Install the lower swing arm assembly on the front subframe, and install and tighten the 2 fixing bolts on each side of the lower swing arm assembly.

Torque: First time: 150 N·m Second time: 90°

b. Install the steering gear tie rod assembly on the front subframe, and install and tighten the 2 fixing bolt and nut assemblies of the steering gear tie rod assembly.

Torque:

First time: 140 N·m

Second time: 90°

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_8250c07d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1

When installing the steering gear on the frame and the vehicle body, pay attention to the positioning clip of the steering gear input shaft, and only in the right direction parallel to the rack shaft can pass through the body via hole! Otherwise, the positioning card will be damaged.

c. Install the stabilizer bar on the front subframe, and install and tighten the 4 fixing bolts of the stabilizer bar. Torque: 30 N·m

![](images/aa70ac957a9f6844a72bab17540286f6216f7d5c7fe85b7cc3162216701483ed.webp)

![](images/b00775eb8594fb768f2e89d72249a1673aef9b6f20fba384128ca7b1ae83a098.webp)

d. Install the front subframe unit, install and tighten the 2 bolts connecting the front subframe to the vehicle body. Torque:

First time: 150 N·m

Second time: 60°

e. Install and tighten the 2 fixing bolts 2 connecting the front subframe to the vehicle body.

Torque:

First time: 150 N·m

Second time: 60°

### Support front subframe with flat jack
`geely_coolray_en_8725f6b1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1

f. Install and tighten the 1 bolt connecting the intermediate shaft assembly and the steering gear input shaft. Torque: 45 N·m

g. Install and tighten the cotter pin and nut 3 on each side of the steering tie rod.

Torque: 45 N·m

h. Install and tighten the 1 nut 2 on each side of the front stabilizer bar.

Torque: 70 N·m

i. Install the cotter pin and nut on each side of the lower swing arm.

Torque: 110 N·m

2 Install the rear vibration isolator of the engine hood.

3 Install the engine side shield
4 Install the engine bottom shield
5 Install the front fender liner
6 Install wheels
7 Lower the vehicle on the ground

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_058e1675` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

When removing the dashboard cross member, it is necessary to arrange the harness in advance so as not to affect the removal of the dashboard cross member.

Two people are required to work when removing the cross member of the dashboard to prevent scratches and scratches of the vehicle interior trims.

Installation procedure

![](images/6ed5c2d42745444e77d96eb28ab77f6e2f06d273dfe71ccedc22a2391258dec5.webp)

1 Move the dashboard cross member to the installation position.
2 Fasten the fixing bolt 7 connecting the upper plate for front wall upper and the cross member of dashboard. Torque: 10N·m
3 Install the rubber plug A on the upper plate for front wall.
4 Fasten the 4 fixing bolts 1 connecting the A/C master unit assembly with the cross member of the dashboard. Torque: 6N·m
5 Fasten the 2 fixing bolts 2 connecting the right lower mounting bracket of the middle channel with the cross member of the dashboard. Torque: 24N·m
6 Fasten the 2 fixing bolts 3 connecting the dashboard cross member and the vehicle body. Torque: 24N·m
7 Fasten the 2 fixing bolts connecting the A/C master unit assembly with the cross member of the dashboard. Torque: 6N·m
8 Fasten the 2 fixing bolts 2 connecting t he right lower mounting bracket of the middle channel with the cross member of the dashboard. Torque: 24N·m
9 Fasten the 2 fixing bolts 3 connecting the dashboard cross member and the vehicle body. Torque: 24N·m

![](images/5390874c28fd982535143028fa3a0836d80023105d1f2fc116b64eb328f7c6a8.webp)

![](images/3c0c7ef1a31e5d0e8329f79df3ba71968dad14cf06b043de9f5cadf9cf5e0591.webp)

13 Install the 8 harness fixing clips A connecting the dashboard harness with the cross member of the dashboard.
14 Install and tighten the 2 harness fixing bolts 3 connecting the dashboard harness with the cross member of the dashboard. Torque: 10N·m
15 Install and tighten the 1 harness fixing bolts 2 connecting the dashboard harness with the cross member of the dashboard. Torque: 10N·m

### 12.9.2.1 Replacement of left A-pillar upper trim panel assembly (Type I)
`geely_coolray_en_b8d83713` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Disconnect the negative cable of battery. Refer to Procedures for Disconnecting and Connecting Battery Cable
2 Remove the left A-pillar upper trim panel assembly a. Disconnect the door frame sealing strip at the A-pillar upper trim panel.

Disconnect the 3 fixing clips connecting the left A-pillar upper trim panel assembly with the A-pillar.

c. Disconnect the 1 harness connector connecting the dashboard harness assembly and the interior camera. d. Remove the left A-pillar upper trim panel assembly.

![](images/3deab9fd865afbde747e202a77d1680f79544e9f1573802f52f6e48f79b5025d.webp)

Installation procedure

Install the A-pillar upper trim panel assembly a. Move the upper trim panel assembly of the left A-pillar to the installation position. c. Connect the harness connector connecting the dashboard harness assembly and the interior camera.

![](images/ee0afe9bb649a7d69e7540d2ca04bded7966d0b82e01dc4ebef18e41d3f017d7.webp)

![](images/fe436f97591a03ee349292b6592c256c200c48909889afe10e51f56b5b0eed54.webp)

c. Install the 3 fixing clips connecting the left A-pillar upper trim panel assembly with the A-pillar.

d. Install the door frame sealing strip at the A-pillar upper trim panel.

2 Connect the negative cable of battery.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_b4281fd4` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

The removal and installation methods of left and right A-pillar upper trim panel assemblies are the same.

1 Remove the left A-pillar upper trim panel assembly a. Open the left front door sealing strip downward.

![](images/cad9763aa320a3ab9bf0c7040a4ced873ec894d9004b154a8d6883dce8f4c4e1.webp)

b. Disconnect the fixing clip A connecting the left A-pillar upper trim panel assembly with the vehicle body. c. Disconnect the 2 fixing clips B connecting the left Apillar upper trim panel assembly with the vehicle body.

d. Remove the left A-pillar upper trim panel assembly.

### Installation procedure
`geely_coolray_en_7f8fe2d1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

![](images/c605f94267a130967b391743b31958d15b81b016fff5f28c68a19c1604cbb7ce.webp)

1 Install the A-pillar upper trim panel assembly a. Move the upper trim panel assembly of the left A-pillar to the installation position.

![](images/dda8151f293b8fd27d805794dfec032f9ea388bd02a5e765b5d4c4c6d46bfbe7.webp)

b. Install the 2 fixing clips B connecting the left A-pillar upper trim panel assembly with the vehicle body. c. Install the fixing clip A connecting the left A-pillar upper trim panel assembly with the vehicle body.

d. Install the front left door inner side seal.

### 12.9.2.3 Replacement of right A-pillar upper trim panel assembly

1 Install the right A-pillar upper trim panel assembly a. Move the upper trim panel assembly of the right A-pillar to the installation position. b. Install the 3 fixing clips connecting the right A-pillar upper trim panel assembly with the A-pillar.

c. Install the door frame sealing strip at the A-pillar upper trim panel.

### 12.9.2.7 Replacement of Central Pillar Upper Trim Panel Assembly
`geely_coolray_en_48c5a30d` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

1 Open doors 2 To remove B-pillar lower trim panel assembly, refer to Replacement of B-pillar Lower Trim Panel Assembly.

![](images/cae5b06dd90d2394286656061e5f2a68d7759a4090244b42846fe482b7106298.webp)

b. Install and tighten the lower bolt of the front seat belt to cover the lower bolt cover of the front seat belt. Torque: 45 N·m

2 Install B-pillar lower trim panel assembly

3 Close doors

`geely_coolray_en_80a186e2` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Open doors

2 To remove the front rocker panel interior trim panel, refer to Replacement of Front Rocker Panel Interior Trim Panel Assembly

a. Connect the clamp of the lower trim panel of B-pillar, and install the lower trim panel assembly of B-pillar. b. Install the door sealing strip at the lower trim panel of the B-pillar.
c. Return the front seat backwards.

2 Install the rear door sill interior trim panel assembly
3 Install the front door sill inner trim panel assembly

### 12.9.2.12 Replacement of trunk side trim panel and rear pillar middle trim panel assembly
`geely_coolray_en_7e545534` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

Open doors

2 To remove the left rear pillar lower trim panel assembly, refer to Replacement of Rear-pillar Lower Trim Panel Assembly

3 Open the backdoor

4 To remove the door sill trim panel assembly of the trunk refer to Replacement of the Door Sill Trim Panel Assembly of the Trunk

5 To remove the trunk lamp, please refer to Replacement of Trunk Lamp

6 To remove the standby power supply, please refer to Replacement of Standby Power Supply

![](images/cc6178049fb54510b999646935e18f698729ff42b23df0222575dd01cb209fc3.webp)

`geely_coolray_en_440534c1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The removal of the trunk right trim panel and right rear pillar middle trim panel assembly does not contain the steps of removing the trunk lamps and removing the backup power supply.

Install the door sealing strips of the left trim panel of the trunk and the left C-pillar middle trim panel assembly.

b. Install and tihgten the fixing screw connecting the left trim panel of trunk and the lower part of the left rear pillar middle trim panel assembly.

Torque: 4 N·m

Caution

The installation of the trunk right trim panel and right rear pillar middle trim panel assembly does not contain the steps of installing the trunk lamps and installing the backup power supply.

2 Install the standby power supply.

4 Install the trunk door sill trim panel assembly

### 12.9.2.14 Replacement of interior trim panel of backdoor
`geely_coolray_en_8f0fd451` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Removal procedure

![](images/40ac8c8f54b35893f36ad2053531d0c109c899a05a8955d1534f7fa9aad93d70.webp)

1 Open the backdoor
2 Remove the upper interior trim panel assembly of the backdoor a. Disconnect the clamping of the interior trim panel on the backdoor and take off the interior trim panel assembly on the backdoor.
3 Remove the interior trim panel assemblies at both sides of the backdoor. a. Remove the 1 screw of assembly of the left interior trim panel of the backdoor. b. Disconnect the clamping of the left interior trim panel on the backdoor and take off the left interior trim panel assembly on the backdoor. c. Remove the screw of assembly of right interior trim panel of the backdoor. d. Disconnect the clamping of the right interior trim panel on the backdoor and take off the right interior trim panel assembly on the backdoor.
4 Remove the inner lower trim panel assembly of the backdoor a. Remove screw on each side of the upper part of the lower interior trim panel of the backdoor.

![](images/ba2fbfb1d0d5786a4d3ddabe4237500a46e376db6fcec7dadb38c9aecc39f37c.webp)

Remove the 2 fixing clips A connecting the middle part of the left front wheel arch splash guard with the left front fender assembly.
e. Remove the 4 fixing clips B connecting the middle part of the left front wheel arch splash guard and the vehicle body. f. Remove the 2 fixing clips A connecting the rear part of the left front wheel arch splash guard with the left front fender assembly.

Install the 3 fixing clips B connecting the rear part of the left front wheel arch splash guard and the vehicle body. d. Install the 2 fixing clip A connecting the rear part of the left front wheel arch splash guard with the left front fender assembly.

h. Install the fixing clip A connecting the left front wheel arch splash guard and the left front wheel arch front splash guard.

i. Install and tighten the 3 fixing screws 1 connecting the left front wheel arch splash guard and the front bumper. Torque: 1.5N·m

### 12.11.1.1 Description and Operations
`geely_coolray_en_135a8390` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:brakes | p:1

At present, the surface materials of interior and exterior trims are mainly modified PP, ABS, PC+ABS, PVC (artificial leather materials), all of which are thermoplastic and modified materials. Materials including POM, PA type, HDPE and etc. are also used for non-surface covers of trims. Thermosetting plastics are rarely used for interior and exterior trims, and only phenolic plastics are used for ashtrays.

Thermosetting plastics are mainly used as structural parts in electronic appliances and safety components. Thermoplastic parts should best be repaired by using hot soldering iron plastic material filling welder, but are usually repaired by replacement. To repair parts made of thermosetting plastics, epoxy resin or other harder two-component repair materials can be used. This chapter only briefly introduces their repair methods, and repairs are not recommended.

Classification of plastic materials: thermosetting plastic refers to the plastics which are solidified in heating or other conditions, or featured with insoluble (infusible) properties, such as phenolic plastic, and epoxy plastics. Thermoplastics refer to plastics that can be repeatedly heated, softened and cooled to harden within a specific temperature range, such as polyethylene, teflon, etc. Thermoplastics and thermosetting plastics can be hard plastics or soft plastics.

### 12.11.2.1 Plastic Part Repair Notices
`geely_coolray_en_90995127` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1 Apply protective cream to exposed skin to prevent irritation.
2 Wear rubber gloves.
3 Wear safety glasses when using compressed air and sanding.
4 Immediately remove any mixture that comes in contact with the skin, because the mixture cures quickly.
5 Wear a dust mask and safety glasses when grinding or sanding.
6 Clean the skin with cold water to reduce the slight irritation of resin dust on the skin.
7 Do not stick maintenance materials to clothes.
8 Use maintenance materials in a well-ventilated environment, as the dust particulate from maintenance materials is toxic.
9 Close all service material containers after use. Dust or moisture will pollute the repair materials and reduce the repair effect.

### 12.11.2.2 Repair of Thermosetting Plastic Dent
`geely_coolray_en_cca171fd` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1 Clean and dry parts to be repaired.
2 Heat the pit area with a hot air blower until the pit is flattened with suitable tools.
3 Sand the pit area with sandpaper/emery paper.
4 Then clean the repair part with cleaner and dry in the air for 5 min.
5 Apply a thin layer of binder and dry in the air for 10 min.
6 Fill the uneven surface with adhesive and smooth it with spatula.
7 Accelerate the curing process with an infrared lamp, and adjust the temperature to 60-70℃ (140-158 ºF). Heat for 15 minutes.
8 Sand the pit area with sandpaper.
9 Remove dust and debris.
10 Apply a thin layer of binder and dry in the air for 10 min.
11 Restore the paint surface according to the paint repair procedure on the surface of plastic parts.

### 12.11.2.3 Maintenance of thermosetting plastic scratch
`geely_coolray_en_ad1b075c` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1 Clean and dry parts to be repaired.
2 Use sandpaper to remove protruding mater ial.
3 Then clean the repair part with cleaner and dry in the air for 5 min.
4 Apply a layer of binder and dry in the air for 10 min.
5 Fill the uneven surface with adhesive and smooth it with a spatula.
6 Accelerate the curing process with an infrared lamp, and adjust the temperature to 60- 70 ℃ (140-158 ºF). Heat for 15 minutes.
7 Sand the pit area with sandpaper.
8 Remove dust/debris.
9 Apply a thin layer of binder and dry in the air for 10 min.
10 Restore the paint surface according to the paint repair procedure on the surface of plastic parts.

### 12.11.2.4 Maintenance of thermosetting plastic crack
`geely_coolray_en_e631b5fc` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1 Clean and dry parts to be repaired.
2 Use sandpaper to remove protruding material.
3 Then clean the repair part with cleaner and dry in the air for 5 min.
4 Apply a layer of binder and dry in the air for 10 min.
5 Fill the uneven surface with adhesive and smooth it with a spatula.
6 Accelerate the curing process with an infrared lamp, and adjust the temperature to 60- 70 ℃ (140-158 ºF). Heat for 15 minutes.
7 Sand the pit area with sandpaper.
8 Remove dust/debris.
9 Apply a thin layer of binder and dry in the air for 10 min.
10 Restore the paint surface according to the paint repair procedure on the surface of plastic parts.

### 12.12.1.1 Collision repair materials
`geely_coolray_en_a6ec6be3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

In a vehicle body collision accident, the structure deformation, steel plate cracking, welding failure, and other phenomena will be generally caused. Sometimes it also causes local damage of the power synthesis box, chassis, and other assembly parts.

During the body collision repair, bonders, sealants, anti-loosing agents, surface protection materials, anti-corrosion materials, chemical materials may be used. Please operate strictly in accordance with the purpose, scope of use, and application in the product instructions. In the process of body repair, repair materials of the same functions should be selected and used according to the functional requirements of parts and materials. reference to Adhesive and sealant.

### 12.12.2.1 Safety precautions
`geely_coolray_en_f10afb44` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

The following safety precautions must be strictly observed during the maintenance and operation of body sheet metal:

1. During the operation of welding, cutting and polishing body sheet metal, the protective suit, goggles, gloves and work shoes must be worn.
2. The welding area must be well ventilated.
3. Before welding, the battery must be disconnected and the wiring terminal must be covered.
4. If sparks may be generated when working near the battery, the battery must be removed.
5. Before removing the components of the complete vehicle, the vehicle must be fixed on the vehicle lifting frame to avoid the change of gravity of the complete vehicle center, thus affecting operational safety.
6. Directly connect the grounding wire of the welding set to the part to be welded. Make sure that there is no conductive part between the grounding point and the welding point during operation.
7. The grounding wire or welding electrode cannot be connected with the electronic control unit and the wire.
8. Unprotected vehicle cannot be parked in the body maintenance area, because shattering sparks may cause the fire and damage lacquer surface and glass.

9. Any component of the A/C system containing refrigerant cannot be welded, brazed or soldered. Any other components in the vehicle that may cause the A/C system component temperature to rise shall not be welded, because they may cause the A/C system to explode. If welding must be conducted near the refrigerant hosepipe, the refrigerant must be recycled, because the invisible ultraviolet ray generated during welding penetrating the refrigerant hosepipe may cause the refrigerant to decay.

10. The battery grounding line must be disconnected during the airbag system operation or the body calibration. The environment temperature around the airbag component should not exceed 100 °C (212 °F).

### 12.12.2.2 Status of parts and components
`geely_coolray_en_f12287c9` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Before repaired automobile or components are delivered to painting hall for painting, their surface must be smooth and seam-filled, and must be polished with sandpaper. The preparation procedure is completed by panel beater. Body and floor components are mainly formed by steel plate cold stamping.

Therefore, same method should be adopted for parts damaged in accident. If damaged components cannot be restored and neighbor parts are corrected, damaged part should be removed and replaced according to the integrity of parts. Do not carry out monomer cutting for parts. The rigidity of complete vehicle, driving safety and convenience of maintenance will be influenced after cutting and melting.

### 12.12.2.3 Description of welding types
`geely_coolray_en_3b41076e` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Common welding types include spot welding, gas shielded welding and brazing. The number of welding spots shall not be reduced during spot welding. Usually, when the spot-welding device cannot be operated, the plug welding can be carried out through gas shielded welding after drilling. When spot welding is adopted, if it is a connection of three-layer plates and only the outer plate is replaced, the solder joint shall be placed on the original one. When spot welding is adopted, single-row weld, double-row weld and double-row offset weld can be generated. When gas shielded welding is adopted, overlapping weld, continuous weld and continuous weld (intermittent) can be generated. Brazing is commonly used to weld and repair areas with low tensile strength and relatively small component thickness.

### 12.12.2.4 Anti-corrosion treatment
`geely_coolray_en_156092df` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. Recognized materials must be used to restore the standard anti-corrosion later after repair.
2. Both sides of all welds must be coated with the primer before sealing.
3. Sheet metal coated with primer must be coated with sealant.
4. Lap plates, metal edges, butt welds and welds must be sealed with sealant.
5. The bottom plate must be coated with long-term bottom plate protection agent.
6. After surface coating spraying, empty cavity protection materials must be used to treat the empty cavities within repair area.
7. Clean the outlet after the empty cavity protection materials dry.

### 12.12.2.5 Scrapped Components Environmentally Friendly Disposal Approach
`geely_coolray_en_f8f709f3` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1. After the maintenance or repair of an automobile, the waste materials must be collected by type.

2. Sort waste materials and check for reusability.

### 12.13.2.1 Paint coating description
`geely_coolray_en_f3521bb6` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Paint is a kind of mixed liquid and can be coated on multiple substrates. The paint forms a solid paint film after drying, thus realizing the targets of substrate protection and attractive appearance. The following 4 paints have already been painted when vehicles leave the factory to provide good anti-corrosion performance and gloss.

1. Electrophoresis primer
2. Middle paint
3. Color paint
4. Celluloid paint (transparent outer coating)

### Main effects of celluloid paint:
`geely_coolray_en_15b298aa` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Celluloid paint is at the outermost layer of the whole lacquer and have the following main effects:

1. Including anti-ultraviolet ray materials to resist the ultraviolet ray in sunshine.
2. Resisting the corrosion effect of ambient dust (acid rain) on lacquer.
3. Allowing the lacquer to have friction resistance performance.
4. Providing better gloss for the lacquer.

Paint spraying is required to restore the repaired parts; spraying process specified by the manufacturer must be strictly complied with during repair. Please refer to Paint Spraying Process for Rigid Surface

### 12.13.2.2 Routine vehicle paint maintenance
`geely_coolray_en_ad2129fd` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

Please follow the following principles during the routine vehicle paint maintenance:

1. Please notice not to touch body paint with oily hands or scrub the paint with oily cloth during the vehicle repair and maintenance. Do not place the oily tools or the cleaning cloth with organic solvent on the body to avoid chemical reactions.

2. Do not carry out the secondary painting if there is no clear scratch to avoid improper paint color or poor combination.

3. Vehicles parking for a long time should be parked in a garage or well-ventilated areas. Vehicles should be covered with a dedicated body cover in winter. Cool places should be selected for temporary parking.

4. Avoid severe impacts, collisions and scratches of the body paint film. Damaged, sunken or fallen paint should be repaired timely, better in the maintenance stations authorized by Geely.

5. High-quality detergent should be applied for body decoration cleaning. Do not scrub the body heavily during waxing and avoid paint layer penetration and exposure of original body. Clean the special traces with strong corrosion (e.g. asphalt, birds droppings, insects, etc.) timely. For this purpose, dedicated detergent must be used. Do not use a knife to scrape the traces or use gasoline to eliminate them to avoid paint damages.

6. Before, during and after vehicle utilization, it is required to clean dust on the body timely and reduce the dust adhesion due to static electricity of the body as possible.

7. Flush the body timely after rain. The rain stains on the body after rain will gradually decrease, but the concentration of acid materials in rainwater gradually increases. If the body is not flushed with clean water timely, the surface coating will be damaged after a long term.

8. Wait until the power synthesis box cools down and then wash the vehicle. Do not wash the vehicle under burning sun or at high temperature to prevent traces of detergent after drying up. The dedicated detergent must be used when customers wash vehicles by themselves, but do not use the high alkaline washing powder, suds or detergents to avoid washing away the grease in paint and accelerating the paint aging. When your vehicle is washed in a car washing station, please pay attention to prevent the washer from using the dewaxing detergent and avoid paint damages. Especially the vehicles running in coastal or heavily polluted areas should be flushed once per day.

9. Clean and soft cloth or sponge should be used to wipe and wash the vehicle. Prevent metal filings and sand inside and do not dry cloth, towel or sponge to polish the vehicle to avoid scratches. During the scrubbing process, scrub the vehicle from top to bottom along the direction of water flow and do not make circles or scrub it horizontally.

10. Carry out waxing protection on the paint irregularly and go to the Geely authorized maintenance stations for care regularly (once a quarter) to timely restore the gloss of body paint. In addition, body paint protection film is also available. 3M paint protection film (invisible vehicle clothing) is a kind of water white paint protection film with super strong toughness. Can be used to protect body bumper, engine cover, front and rear doors, rearview mirror and other coated paints to protect the body paint from scratches or paint peeling due to slight collision.

### Warning！ ！
`geely_coolray_en_6029a6ae` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

During paint mixing and painting operations, diffuse solvents can cause serious respiratory illnesses. Operation must be in strict accordance with the manufacturer's instructions for paint, equipment and safety devices. During operations in accordance with this procedure, wear special protective equipment such as gas masks, anti-static clothing, protective eyewear and gloves to prevent injury.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_7fc14b70` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Do not mix paint systems or alternative products from different manufacturers. Mixing of incompatible products may result in:

1. Primer peeling.
2. Poor inter-coat bonding.
3. Insufficient curing.
4. Reduced gloss.
5. Poor color accuracy.
6. Damage to coating (pits, bubbles, orange peel, and loss of
gloss).

### 12.13.2.4 Cautions during finishing varnish maintenance and repair
`geely_coolray_en_f0346377` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Caution

1. Avoid washing the vehicle under direct sunlight.

2. Avoid using the strong soap and chemical detergent.

3. Use brushless automatic vehicle cleaning equipment.

4. Avoid using products containing acid or alkali.

5. Do not use the brush or broom to remove snow or ice

6. After cleaning thoroughly, the remaining rinse water should be wiped dry immediately, and do not let it dry in air on the surface. It is recommended to wipe dry with soft chamois leather.

7. Only when the defect on the surface can be eliminated by the method of polishing, can the vehicle be polished.

8. If the surface condition is not serious, the maintenance part should be narrowed as much as possible.

9. Avoid removing too much clear paint or it will cause premature paint damage.

10. Use electric polishing equipment in strict accordance with the requirements of polishing manufacturers. Do not use wax or silicone products to cover vortex blot (the user will not be satisfied with the blot reappearing soon).

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_449f0000` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:body | p:1

1. When sound-proof or anti-corrosion materials are sprayed, preventive measures must be taken to avoid spraying into component openings (such as door locks, vehicle window lift slots, vehicle window regulators, and seat belt retractors) and any moving, rotating parts, especially the parking brake cable. After spraying the material, ensure that all vent holes on the body are open.

2. When the body is repaired with an open flame, the foamed sound insulation material must be removed from the repair part. When reinstalling the soundproofing material, avoid inhaling harmful dust.

3. When the procedure is performed, it is needed to wear dedicated protective glasses and gloves to prevent injury.

4. When the vehicle leaves the factory, the body metal plates have been treated with electrophoretic coating primer. After parts are repaired and/or replaced, all exposed metal surfaces must be treated with a rustproof primer.

5. If the original coating or anti-corrosion material is damaged during welding or heating operation, it needs clean and anti-corrosion treatment.

6. When collision repairs are conducted, the metal will be exposed, and these surfaces must be re-sprayed with dedicated anti-corrosion materials.

7. The role of the sealant is to prevent water and dust from entering the vehicle, and it also has an anticorrosion effect. The original seal joints are obvious. If these seals are damaged, they should be corrected by resealing. The joint of the newly replaced plate should be resealed. The sealant used must remain flexible after curing and painting. Seal open joints closed with sealant by high-consistency filler. Follow the descriptions for the selected materials.

8. The sound insulation material can control the general noise level in the vehicle. When the sound insulation layer is damaged due to maintenance operations or replacement of new panels, the same material must be used.

### Caution

2 Apply a proper amount of polishing paste to the paint surface to be polished and adjust the speed of the polishing machine.

3 Put the wool ball on the paint surface and then turn on the machine. The speed should be 2500 - 3000 r/mi.

### Caution

Keep the machine moving smoothly and gently as well as avoid excessive grinding. Ensure as-shortas-possible time for grinding and as-small-aspossible grinding area.

4 Fully moisten the sponge first, squeeze out the excessive water. Apply a small amount of glazing wax to the paint surface to be polished, attach the sponge onto the paint surface and then turn on the machine at a speed of 2500- 3000 r/min. Then lightly press for 3-5 s for glazing.

### Caution

### 12.13.4.3 Deep polishing treatment example
`geely_coolray_en_04b1b7e0` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

1 Use 2000 # waterproof abrasive paper to grind and process the damaged lacquer surface. Carry out the circular polish in the direction parallel and close to the lacquer surface to be polished.

2 Clean up the surface and polish dust.
3 Apply a proper amount of polishing paste to the paint surface to be polished and adjust the speed of the polishing machine.

![](images/9396d5b846853b202608c0dd7e2f29d6bb5579d9c684aede7771df26f8fe9d20.webp)

4 Affix the wool ball to the lacquer surface before starting the machine, with the revolving speed being 2,500 3,000 r/min.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_02ce30c1` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Keep the machine moving smoothly and gently as well as avoid excessive grinding. Keep the grinding time as short as possible (3-5s) and keep the grinding area as small as possible.

5 Fully moisten the sponge first, squeeze out the excessive water. Apply a small amount of glazing wax to the paint surface to be polished, attach the sponge onto the paint surface and then turn on the machine at a speed of 2500- 3000 r/min. Then gently press 3-5s to proceed with glazing processing.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_a590cec8` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Hold the machine moving gently and steadily during operation. Don’t take too long to avoid overheating and burning the paint.

### Caution
`geely_coolray_en_8f941743` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

All paint repairs on rigid surfaces must meet Geely standards. Confirm the repair area and select the repair range. For example: partial repair, whole repair and complete vehicle repair. In case of the damage caused by a collision, perform the corresponding repair after the sheet metal repair according to the damage situation or spray paint after replacing the parts.

![](images/487d1ab3ae69073589dcd7d3ed7a91fff19508b430dd25b258e22b526c0b92c8.webp)

1 If the fenders has serious scratches, adopt the partial spraying (paint touch-up) process.

2 Use P500# wet (water) sandpaper to polish the damaged paint surface (circular polishing).

3 After polishing, use degreaser to remove oil and clean.

4 When spraying the middle coating, it is important to control the range of the spray primer. In addition, the edge position of the coating shall be gradual and not stepped.

5 Flash dry for 4-5 min, then dry for 20-30 min. The temperature of the paint-bake room is 70-80 ℃ (158-176 F).

7 Use 2000# finewaterproof abrasive paper to polish and expand the polishing range.

### 12.13.4.5 Spray paint procedure on the repaired rigid sheet metal surface
`geely_coolray_en_39f4298a` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

Spray paint procedure on the repaired rigid sheet metal surface is similar to rigid surface spray paint process. It’s only added with the following steps after primer grinding and before spraying primer color paint: 1 Apply poly-putty base. 2 Grind poly-putty base.

3 Dust blowing, oil removing, cleaning.
4 Apply the filling putty.
5 Sanding the surface of old coating film. Clean, oil removing, and cover areas not painted. For specific operation steps, please refer to Rigid Surface Spray Paint Process.

### 12.13.4.6 Plastic surface paint repair process
`geely_coolray_en_56286918` | coolray | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1

There are three basic requirements for plastic surface paint repair
1 Paint has a certain adhesion to plastics without losing the mechanical properties.
2 The paint film should be flexible enough to make sure it will not break as the plastic distortion.
3 The original grain and rough texture of some plastic surface can be reflected. Plastic surface paint repair process: The plastic surface paint repair can refer to the above local spray paint process, and notice low temperature baking. The baking conditions are 70\~80 ℃ (158\~176 °F), 20\~30 min.
